7.s: atha mukhyamantroddhāro nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ
7.d: अथ मुख्यमन्त्रोद्धारो नाम षष्ठः पटलः
7.m: Now begins the sixth chapter, titled 'Extraction of the Principal Mantra'.

7.s: nāradaḥ
7.d: नारदः

7.s:
tvatprasādena bhagavansaṃvillabdhā mayā parā |
manasaścañcalatvācca nahi me sthiratāṃ vrajet || 1 ||
7.d:
त्वत्प्रसादेन भगवन्संविल्लब्धा मया परा |
मनसश्चञ्चलत्वाच्च नहि मे स्थिरतां व्रजेत् || 1 ||
7.m: By your grace, O Blessed One, supreme consciousness has been attained by me; / but due to the restlessness of the mind, it does not attain stability for me. // 1

7.s:
ataḥ pūrvoditānsarvānupāyānkathayasva me |
aśeṣāṃśca krameṇaiva bhogamokṣaphalapradān || 2 ||
7.d:
अतः पूर्वोदितान्सर्वानुपायान्कथयस्व मे |
अशेषांश्च क्रमेणैव भोगमोक्षफलप्रदान् || 2 ||
7.m: Therefore, tell me all the means spoken of earlier, / without exception, in proper sequence, which bestow the fruits of enjoyment and liberation. // 2

7.s: [mantranirūpaṇārambhaḥ]
7.d: [मन्त्रनिरूपणारम्भः]
7.m: [Commencement of the exposition of mantras]

7.s: śrībhagavān
7.d: श्रीभगवान्

7.s:
sādhu nārada pṛṣṭo'haṃ sārabhūtamidaṃ tvayā |
mantrapūrvaṃ hi vai sarvaṃ yattvayā paricoditam || 3 ||
7.d:
साधु नारद पृष्टोऽहं सारभूतमिदं त्वया |
मन्त्रपूर्वं हि वै सर्वं यत्त्वया परिचोदितम् || 3 ||
7.m: Well asked, O Nārada! This question asked by you is the very essence; / for everything about which you have inquired begins with mantra. // 3

7.s:
tasmānmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham |
sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpeṇa nānāsiddhiphalapradam || 4 ||
7.d:
तस्मान्मन्त्रं प्रवक्ष्यामि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शुभम् |
स्थूलसूक्ष्मस्वरूपेण नानासिद्धिफलप्रदम् || 4 ||
7.m: Therefore, I shall proclaim the auspicious mantra that grants worldly enjoyment and liberation, / in its gross and subtle forms, bestowing the fruit of various attainments, // 4

7.s: śaktyaṅgāvaraṇopetamanekādbhutadarśanam |
7.d: शक्त्यङ्गावरणोपेतमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् |
7.m: endowed with powers, ancillary mantras, and enclosures, showing many wonders.

7.s: [mātṛkāpīṭhaparikalpanāprakāraḥ]
7.d: [मातृकापीठपरिकल्पनाप्रकारः]
7.m: [The procedure for preparing the seat of the mātṛkā]

7.s: bhūmibhāge same śuddhe mṛdgomayasulepite || 5 ||
7.d: भूमिभागे समे शुद्धे मृद्गोमयसुलेपिते || 5 ||
7.m: On an even, clean piece of ground, smeared well with clay and cow dung, // 5

7.s:
pañcagavyena saṃsikte candanādyupalepite |
nivāte ca susaṃcchanne dhūpairapyadhivāsite || 6 ||
7.d:
पञ्चगव्येन संसिक्ते चन्दनाद्युपलेपिते |
निवाते च सुसंच्छन्ने धूपैरप्यधिवासिते || 6 ||
7.m: sprinkled with the five products of the cow, smeared with sandalwood and other [pastes], / windless, well-covered, and perfumed with incenses, // 6

7.s:
mṛdukalhārakusumaiḥ kevalaiḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
praṇavādinamontena svanāmnā pūjya vai purā || 7 ||
7.d:
मृदुकल्हारकुसुमैः केवलैः कुसुमैः शुभैः |
प्रणवादिनमोन्तेन स्वनाम्ना पूज्य वै पुरा || 7 ||
7.m: having first worshipped with soft white water lilies alone, [or] with pure flowers, / using his own name preceded by praṇava and ending with 'namaḥ', // 7

7.s:
parijapyātha bahuśo mṛdaṃ bhūmau prasārya ca |
caturaśraṃ suvṛttaṃ ca dvihastaṃ hastameva vā || 8 ||
7.d:
परिजप्याथ बहुशो मृदं भूमौ प्रसार्य च |
चतुरश्रं सुवृत्तं च द्विहस्तं हस्तमेव वा || 8 ||
7.m: and having recited repeatedly, and spreading clay on the ground, / square or well-rounded, two cubits or one cubit in size, // 8

7.s: p. 42) susamaṃ mātṛkāpīṭhaṃ kṛtvā prastārya tāmapi |
7.d: प्. 42) सुसमं मातृकापीठं कृत्वा प्रस्तार्य तामपि |
7.m: having made a very even seat of the mātṛkā, and also having laid it out: // p. 42

7.s: [akṣareṣu vibhāvyo bhagavataḥ sthitibhedaḥ]
7.d: [अक्षरेषु विभाव्यो भगवतः स्थितिभेदः]
7.m: [The distinct modes of the Blessed One's presence in the letters]

7.s: ekaiva bhinnavargā ca vargānte'pyasamākṣarāḥ || 9 ||
7.d: एकैव भिन्नवर्गा च वर्गान्तेऽप्यसमाक्षराः || 9 ||
7.m: It is single, yet has different groups, and the letters at the end of the groups are unequal. // 9

7.s:
ṣoḍaśākṣara ādyastu akārādyo dvijottama |
visargāntasthitastasminnagnīṣomātmakaḥ prabhuḥ || 10 ||
7.d:
षोडशाक्षर आद्यस्तु अकाराद्यो द्विजोत्तम |
विसर्गान्तस्थितस्तस्मिन्नग्नीषोमात्मकः प्रभुः || 10 ||
7.m: The first group consists of sixteen letters, beginning with 'a', O best among the twice-born; / ending with the visarga, in it the Lord abides, consisting of Agni and Soma. // 10

7.s:
pañcārṇānāṃ tu pañcānāṃ vargāṇāṃ parameśvaraḥ |
susthitaḥ kādimāntānāṃ tattvātmatvena sarvadā || 11 ||
7.d:
पञ्चार्णानां तु पञ्चानां वर्गाणां परमेश्वरः |
सुस्थितः कादिमान्तानां तत्त्वात्मत्वेन सर्वदा || 11 ||
7.m: In the five groups of five letters beginning with 'ka' and ending with 'ma', the Supreme Lord / is well-established at all times as the nature of the tattvas. // 11

7.s:
jāgradādikrameṇaiva sthito'vasthātmanātra vai |
yādivānte caturvarṇe varge viprendra sattame || 12 ||
7.d:
जाग्रदादिक्रमेणैव स्थितोऽवस्थात्मनात्र वै |
यादिवान्ते चतुर्वर्णे वर्गे विप्रेन्द्र सत्तमे || 12 ||
7.m: Abiding indeed here as the nature of the states, in the sequence of waking and the rest, / in the four-letter group beginning with 'ya' and ending with 'va', O excellent sage, best of Brahmins; // 12

7.s:
turyātītātmarūpeṇa śādikṣānteṣu saṃsthitaḥ |
ālokastīkṣṇatā vyāptirgrahaṇaṃ kṣepaṇeraṇe || 13 ||
7.d:
तुर्यातीतात्मरूपेण शादिक्षान्तेषु संस्थितः |
आलोकस्तीक्ष्णता व्याप्तिर्ग्रहणं क्षेपणेरणे || 13 ||
7.m: in those beginning with 'śa' and ending with 'kṣa', he is established as the nature of that which transcends the fourth [state]. / Light, sharpness, pervasion, grasping, throwing, urging, // 13

7.s:
pākaḥ prāptiriti hyaṣṭau sūryabhāge vyavasthitāḥ |
akārādiṣu hrasveṣu varṇeṣveteṣvanukramāt || 14 ||
7.d:
पाकः प्राप्तिरिति ह्यष्टौ सूर्यभागे व्यवस्थिताः |
अकारादिषु ह्रस्वेषु वर्णेष्वेतेष्वनुक्रमात् || 14 ||
7.m: cooking, and attainment: these eight are indeed established in the solar portion / among these short letters beginning with 'a', in proper order. // 14

7.s:
dravatā śaityabhāvāśca tṛptiḥkāntiḥ prasannatā |
rasatā'hlāda ānando hyaṣṭau cāndrāstvimā matāḥ || 15 ||
7.d:
द्रवता शैत्यभावाश्च तृप्तिःकान्तिः प्रसन्नता |
रसताऽह्लाद आनन्दो ह्यष्टौ चान्द्रास्त्विमा मताः || 15 ||
7.m: Fluidity, coldness, satisfaction, radiance, serenity, / sapidity, gladness, and bliss: these eight are considered lunar. // 15

7.s:
ākārādiṣu dīrgheṣu saṃsthitā mātṛkātmanā |
avinābhāvarūpeṇa anyonyena sadaiva hi || 16 ||
7.d:
आकारादिषु दीर्घेषु संस्थिता मातृकात्मना |
अविनाभावरूपेण अन्योन्येन सदैव हि || 16 ||
7.m: They reside in the long vowels beginning with 'ā' in the form of the mātṛkā, / through mutual, invariable concomitance, eternally indeed. // 16

7.s:
aṣṭānāmapi cāṣṭau tu saṃsthitā bahirantare |
kṣmāditattvasamūhastu puruṣāntaḥ krameṇa tu || 17 ||
7.d:
अष्टानामपि चाष्टौ तु संस्थिता बहिरन्तरे |
क्ष्मादितत्त्वसमूहस्तु पुरुषान्तः क्रमेण तु || 17 ||
7.m: The eight of both [solar and lunar sets] abide externally and internally. / The collection of tattvas, however, beginning with earth and ending with puruṣa, in order, // 17

7.s:
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptaṃ ca turyamūrdhve'tra vartate |
saṃsthitaḥ paramālokaśabdo nityoditaḥ paraḥ || 18 ||
7.d:
जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तं च तुर्यमूर्ध्वेऽत्र वर्तते |
संस्थितः परमालोकशब्दो नित्योदितः परः || 18 ||
7.m: and waking, dreaming, deep sleep, and the fourth [state] dwell above here. / Abiding as the supreme light and sound, eternally risen, supreme, // 18

7.s:
parānandaśca samatā vedyavedakavarjitaḥ |
svarūpametatkathitaṃ turyātītātmano vibhoḥ || 19 ||
7.d:
परानन्दश्च समता वेद्यवेदकवर्जितः |
स्वरूपमेतत्कथितं तुर्यातीतात्मनो विभोः || 19 ||
7.m: supreme bliss and equanimity, free from the known and the knower: / this is proclaimed as the intrinsic form of the all-pervading Lord whose nature transcends the fourth [state]. // 19

7.s:
[evaṃ bhagavataḥ sthitiṃ vibhāvyollikhyamānānāmakṣarāṇaṃ
bhagavanmātṛkādeharūpatā]
7.d:
[एवं भगवतः स्थितिं विभाव्योल्लिख्यमानानामक्षराणं
भगवन्मातृकादेहरूपता]
7.m: [The letters, being inscribed while meditating thus on the Lord's presence, have the form of the Lord's mātṛkā-body]

7.s:
iti varṇaprabhāvaṃ ca vyāpakaṃ cānubhūtigam |
budhvā ca lipirūpeṇa saṃlikhedyena kenacit || 20 ||
7.d:
इति वर्णप्रभावं च व्यापकं चानुभूतिगम् |
बुध्वा च लिपिरूपेण संलिखेद्येन केनचित् || 20 ||
7.m: Having understood thus the power of the letters, all-pervading and within experience, / one should write them down in the form of script with whatever [implement]; // 20

7.s:
saṃvedyo'pi janenaiva na lipirvipra mātṛkāḥ |
paramaḥ puruṣo divyo yo'nubhūtaḥ purā tvayā || 21 ||
7.d:
संवेद्योऽपि जनेनैव न लिपिर्विप्र मातृकाः |
परमः पुरुषो दिव्यो योऽनुभूतः पुरा त्वया || 21 ||
7.m: for the mātṛkās are to be known by people not merely as script, O Brahmin. / That supreme, divine Puruṣa who was experienced by you of old— // 21

7.s: tasyāyaṃ mātṛkādehaḥ caturdhā saṃvyavasthitaḥ |
7.d: तस्यायं मातृकादेहः चतुर्धा संव्यवस्थितः |
7.m: this is his mātṛkā-body, established in four ways.

7.s: p. 43) [mātṛkāyāḥ svavigrahe nyāsakramaḥ]
7.d: प्. 43) [मातृकायाः स्वविग्रहे न्यासक्रमः]
7.m: p. 43) [The order of nyāsa of the mātṛkā upon one's own body]

7.s: sūtreṇa maṇayo yadvatprotāstvekena nārada || 22 ||
7.d: सूत्रेण मणयो यद्वत्प्रोतास्त्वेकेन नारद || 22 ||
7.m: Just as gems are strung upon a single thread, O Nārada, // 22

7.s:
tadvadvarṇā mayā tantusvarūpeṇāvyayātmanā |
iti cetasi vai kṛtvā mantrānuddharate ca yaḥ || 23 ||
7.d:
तद्वद्वर्णा मया तन्तुस्वरूपेणाव्ययात्मना |
इति चेतसि वै कृत्वा मन्त्रानुद्धरते च यः || 23 ||
7.m: so the letters are [strung] by me in the form of a thread whose nature is imperishable. / Having kept this in mind, he who extracts the mantras // 23

7.s:
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaprāptistasya mantrātprajāyate |
evaṃ svavigrahe nyasya mātṛkāṃ mantramātrakām || 24 ||
7.d:
दृष्टादृष्टफलप्राप्तिस्तस्य मन्त्रात्प्रजायते |
एवं स्वविग्रहे न्यस्य मातृकां मन्त्रमात्रकाम् || 24 ||
7.m: attains the seen and unseen fruits born from that mantra. / Having thus applied the mātṛkā, consisting of mantras, to his own body, // 24

7.s:
vastupūrṇeṣu tattveṣu sveṣu sveṣūditeṣu ca |
snātvā śuklāmbaradharassrakcandanavibhūṣitaḥ || 25 ||
7.d:
वस्तुपूर्णेषु तत्त्वेषु स्वेषु स्वेषूदितेषु च |
स्नात्वा शुक्लाम्बरधरस्स्रक्चन्दनविभूषितः || 25 ||
7.m: when each of his own tattvas has arisen full of reality, / having bathed, wearing white garments, adorned with garlands and sandalwood paste, // 25

7.s: [mantramātṛkoddhārakramaḥ]
7.d: [मन्त्रमातृकोद्धारक्रमः]
7.m: [The procedure for extracting the mantra-mātṛkā]

7.s:
tāmeva prastarenmantrī aṣṭavargāṃ pṛthaksthitām |
aṣṭāre tu mahācakre madhyataḥ suvibhūṣite || 26 ||
7.d:
तामेव प्रस्तरेन्मन्त्री अष्टवर्गां पृथक्स्थिताम् |
अष्टारे तु महाचक्रे मध्यतः सुविभूषिते || 26 ||
7.m: the mantrin should lay out that very [mātṛkā] standing separately in eight groups / upon a great eight-spoked cakra, well-adorned in the middle, // 26

7.s:
prāgarādi kṣakārāntamavargādikrameṇa tu |
madhyataḥ praṇavaṃ likhya varṇacakraṃ prabhuṃ param || 27 ||
7.d:
प्रागरादि क्षकारान्तमवर्गादिक्रमेण तु |
मध्यतः प्रणवं लिख्य वर्णचक्रं प्रभुं परम् || 27 ||
7.m: beginning with the eastern spoke and ending with 'kṣa', in the order of the 'a'-group and the rest. / Having written the praṇava in the center—the cakra of letters, the supreme Lord— // 27

7.s:
ekaikaṃ tu svasaṃjñābhiścakrāreṣvakṣaraṃ likhet |
yāvanniṣpadyate vargasshitaḥ svaissvairarāntare || 28 ||
7.d:
एकैकं तु स्वसंज्ञाभिश्चक्रारेष्वक्षरं लिखेत् |
यावन्निष्पद्यते वर्गस्स्हितः स्वैस्स्वैररान्तरे || 28 ||
7.m: he should write each letter upon the spokes of the cakra with their own names / until the group is completed, established in their respective spoke-intervals. // 28

7.s: svaravyañjanasaṃyuktāṃ mātṛkāmagrato yajet |
7.d: स्वरव्यञ्जनसंयुक्तां मातृकामग्रतो यजेत् |
7.m: He should worship the mātṛkā endowed with vowels and consonants in front.

7.s: [mātṛkāpūjanaprakāraḥ]
7.d: [मातृकापूजनप्रकारः]
7.m: [The manner of worshipping the mātṛkā]

7.s: pādyārghyapuṣpadhūpena dīpena ca vilepanaiḥ || 29 ||
7.d: पाद्यार्घ्यपुष्पधूपेन दीपेन च विलेपनैः || 29 ||
7.m: With water for the feet, respectful offering, flowers, incense, a lamp, and unguents, // 29

7.s:
phalamūlādinaivedyairoṃnamomantramātṛke |
saṃpūjyaśca tato bhaktyā mātṛkāvigrahaḥ pumān || 30 ||
7.d:
फलमूलादिनैवेद्यैरोंनमोमन्त्रमातृके |
संपूज्यश्च ततो भक्त्या मातृकाविग्रहः पुमान् || 30 ||
7.m: with food-offerings such as fruits and roots, with "oṃ namo mantramātṛke", / the Puruṣa whose body is the mātṛkā should then be worshipped with devotion. // 30

7.s:
prāguktena svanāmnā vai praṇatyā praṇavena ca |
svābhidhābhiḥ krameṇāto hyekaikaṃ cākṣaraṃ yajet || 31 ||
7.d:
प्रागुक्तेन स्वनाम्ना वै प्रणत्या प्रणवेन च |
स्वाभिधाभिः क्रमेणातो ह्येकैकं चाक्षरं यजेत् || 31 ||
7.m: Then he should worship each single letter in order by its own appellations, / with its own previously stated name, with bowings, and with the praṇava, // 31

7.s: madhyāhnabhāskarākāraṃ prasphurantaṃ vicintya ca |
7.d: मध्याह्नभास्कराकारं प्रस्फुरन्तं विचिन्त्य च |
7.m: meditating on it as flashing forth, having the appearance of the midday sun.

7.s: [bhagavadrūpāṇāmakṣarāṇāmakārādikrameṇābhidhābhedaḥ]
7.d: [भगवद्रूपाणामक्षराणामकारादिक्रमेणाभिधाभेदः]
7.m: [The different names of the forms of the Lord in the order of the letters beginning with 'a']

7.s: akāraścāprameyaśca prathamo (bhavo ?) vyāpakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 32 ||
7.d: अकारश्चाप्रमेयश्च प्रथमो (भवो ?) व्यापकः स्मृतः || 32 ||
7.m: The letter 'a' is remembered as the Immeasurable, the First, the All-Pervading. // 32

7.s:
ādidevastathā'kāra ānando gopanaḥ smṛtaḥ |
rāmasaṃjña ikāraśca iṣṭa iddhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 33 ||
7.d:
आदिदेवस्तथाऽकार आनन्दो गोपनः स्मृतः |
रामसंज्ञ इकारश्च इष्ट इद्धः प्रकीर्तितः || 33 ||
7.m: The letter 'ā' is remembered as the Primal God, Bliss, the Concealer. / The letter 'i' is named Rāma, proclaimed as the Desired, the Kindled. // 33

7.s:
īkāraḥ pañca bindurvai viṣṇormāyā dvijādhipa |
ukāro bhuvanākhyaśca uddāma udayastathā || 34 ||
7.d:
ईकारः पञ्च बिन्दुर्वै विष्णोर्माया द्विजाधिप |
उकारो भुवनाख्यश्च उद्दाम उदयस्तथा || 34 ||
7.m: The letter 'ī' is indeed the Five-Fold Bindu, the Māyā of Viṣṇu, O lord among the twice-born. / The letter 'u' is named the World, the Unrestrained, and the Arising. // 34

7.s:
p. 44) ūkāra ūrjo lokeśaḥ prajñādhārastathaiva ca |
satyaśca ṛttadhāmā ca ṛkārassa tu cāṅkuśaḥ || 35 ||
7.d:
प्. 44) ऊकार ऊर्जो लोकेशः प्रज्ञाधारस्तथैव च |
सत्यश्च ऋत्तधामा च ऋकारस्स तु चाङ्कुशः || 35 ||
7.m: p. 44) The letter 'ū' is Vigour, Lord of the World, and the Support of Wisdom. / The letter 'ṛ' is Truth, having Rta as Abode, and the Goad. // 35

7.s:
ṛkāraṃ viṣṭaraṃ viddhi jvālā saiva prasāraṇam |
liṅgātmā bhagavānprokto ḷkārastārakassmṛtaḥ || 36 ||
7.d:
ऋकारं विष्टरं विद्धि ज्वाला सैव प्रसारणम् |
लिङ्गात्मा भगवान्प्रोक्तो ऌकारस्तारकस्स्मृतः || 36 ||
7.m: Know the letter 'ṝ' to be the Seat, the Flame, and Expansion. / The Lord is taught as having the nature of the Liṅga; the letter 'ḷ' is remembered as the Rescuer. // 36

7.s:
ḷkāro dīrghaghoṇaśca devadatto virāṭ sa tu |
tryaśra ekārasaṃjñastu jagadyoniravigrahaḥ || 37 ||
7.d:
ऌकारो दीर्घघोणश्च देवदत्तो विराट् स तु |
त्र्यश्र एकारसंज्ञस्तु जगद्योनिरविग्रहः || 37 ||
7.m: The letter 'ḹ' is Long-Nosed, Devadatta, and Virāṭ. / That named the letter 'e' is the Triangle, the Womb of the World, the Bodiless. // 37

7.s:
aiśvaryaṃ yogadhātā ca ai samairāvaṇassmṛtaḥ |
okāra otadehaśca odanassa ca vikramī || 38 ||
7.d:
ऐश्वर्यं योगधाता च ऐ समैरावणस्स्मृतः |
ओकार ओतदेहश्च ओदनस्स च विक्रमी || 38 ||
7.m: The letter 'ai' is remembered as Sovereignty, Giver of Yoga, and Airāvaṇa with the Gods. / The letter 'o' has an Interwoven Body, is Nourishment, and the Valorous. // 38

7.s:
aurvo'tha bhūdharākhyaśca aussmṛto hyauṣadhātmakaḥ |
trailokyaiśvaryado vyāpī vyomeśo'ṅkāra eva ca || 39 ||
7.d:
और्वोऽथ भूधराख्यश्च औस्स्मृतो ह्यौषधात्मकः |
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदो व्यापी व्योमेशोऽङ्कार एव च || 39 ||
7.m: The letter 'au' is remembered as Aurva, named the Earth-Bearer, and consisting of Herbs. / The letter 'aṃ' is the Giver of Sovereignty over the Three Worlds, the All-Pervading, and the Lord of Ether. // 39

7.s:
visargaḥ sṛṣṭikṛtkhyāto hyakāraḥ parameśvaraḥ |
kamalaśca karālaśca kakāraḥ prakṛtiḥ parā || 40 ||
7.d:
विसर्गः सृष्टिकृत्ख्यातो ह्यकारः परमेश्वरः |
कमलश्च करालश्च ककारः प्रकृतिः परा || 40 ||
7.m: The visarga is known as the Creator; the letter 'aḥ' is the Supreme Lord. / The letter 'ka' is the Lotus, the Dreadful, and the Supreme Prakṛti. // 40

7.s:
khakāraḥ kharvadehaśca vedātmā viśvabhāvanaḥ |
gadadhvaṃsī gakāraśca govindassa gadādharaḥ || 41 ||
7.d:
खकारः खर्वदेहश्च वेदात्मा विश्वभावनः |
गदध्वंसी गकारश्च गोविन्दस्स गदाधरः || 41 ||
7.m: The letter 'kha' has a Stunted Body, consists of the Veda, and is the Originator of the Universe. / The letter 'ga' is the Destroyer of Affliction, Govinda, and the Bearer of the Mace. // 41

7.s:
ghakāraścaiva dharmāṃśustejasvī dīptimānsmṛtaḥ |
ṅakāra ekadaṃṣṭraśca bhūtātmā viśvabhāvakaḥ || 42 ||
7.d:
घकारश्चैव धर्मांशुस्तेजस्वी दीप्तिमान्स्मृतः |
ङकार एकदंष्ट्रश्च भूतात्मा विश्वभावकः || 42 ||
7.m: The letter 'gha' is remembered as the Sun, Splendid, and Luminous. / The letter 'ṅa' has a Single Tusk, is the Self of Beings, and Creator of the Universe. // 42

7.s:
cakāraścaṃcalaścakrī candrāśussa ca kathyate |
chakāraḥ chalavidhvaṃsī chandaśchandaḥpatiḥ smṛtaḥ || 43 ||
7.d:
चकारश्चंचलश्चक्री चन्द्राशुस्स च कथ्यते |
छकारः छलविध्वंसी छन्दश्छन्दःपतिः स्मृतः || 43 ||
7.m: The letter 'ca' is spoken of as Fickle, Bearer of the Discus, and having Moonbeams. / The letter 'cha' is remembered as Destroyer of Deceit, Metre, and Master of Metre. // 43

7.s:
ajito janmahantā ca jakārassa ca śāśvataḥ |
jhaṣo jhakāraḥ kathitaḥ samātmā sāmapāṭhakaḥ || 44 ||
7.d:
अजितो जन्महन्ता च जकारस्स च शाश्वतः |
झषो झकारः कथितः समात्मा सामपाठकः || 44 ||
7.m: The letter 'ja' is the Unconquered, the Slayer of Birth, and the Eternal. / The letter 'jha' is taught as Fish, Even-Minded, and Reciter of the Sāman. // 44

7.s:
uttamastvīśvarākhyaśca jñakārastattvadhārakaḥ |
cāndrī ṭakāra āhlādo viśvāpyāyakaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 45 ||
7.d:
उत्तमस्त्वीश्वराख्यश्च ज्ञकारस्तत्त्वधारकः |
चान्द्री टकार आह्लादो विश्वाप्यायकरः स्मृतः || 45 ||
7.m: The letter 'ña' is the Highest, named the Ruler, and Upholder of the Tattvas. / The letter 'ṭa' is remembered as Lunar, Joy, and Gladdener of the Universe. // 45

7.s:
ṭhakāraḥ kaustubhaḥ prokto nemirdhārādharastathā |
ḍakāro daṇḍadhāraśca mausalo'khaṇḍavikramaḥ || 46 ||
7.d:
ठकारः कौस्तुभः प्रोक्तो नेमिर्धाराधरस्तथा |
डकारो दण्डधारश्च मौसलोऽखण्डविक्रमः || 46 ||
7.m: The letter 'ṭha' is proclaimed as the Kaustubha, the Felley, and Cloud. / The letter 'ḍa' is the Staff-Bearer, Wielder of the Pestle, and of Unbroken Valour. // 46

7.s:
ḍhakāro viśvarūpaśca vṛṣakarmā pratardanaḥ |
ṇakāro'bhayadaśśāstā vaikuṇṭhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 47 ||
7.d:
ढकारो विश्वरूपश्च वृषकर्मा प्रतर्दनः |
णकारोऽभयदश्शास्ता वैकुण्ठः परिकीर्तितः || 47 ||
7.m: The letter 'ḍha' has All Forms, Performs Righteous Deeds, and is Pratardana. / The letter 'ṇa' is celebrated as Giver of Fearlessness, Teacher, and Vaikuṇṭha. // 47

7.s:
tālalakṣmā takāraśca vairājassragdharassmṛtaḥ |
dhanvī bhuvanāpālaśca thakārassarvarodhakaḥ || 48 ||
7.d:
ताललक्ष्मा तकारश्च वैराजस्स्रग्धरस्स्मृतः |
धन्वी भुवनापालश्च थकारस्सर्वरोधकः || 48 ||
7.m: The letter 'ta' is marked by a Palm Tree, is Virāj, and Wearer of Garlands. / The letter 'tha' is the Bowman, Protector of the World, and Restrainer of All. // 48

7.s:
p. 45) dattāvakāśo damano dakāraśśāntidaḥ smṛtaḥ |
dhakāraḥ śārṅgadhṛddhartā mādhavaśca prakīrtitaḥ || 49 ||
7.d:
प्. 45) दत्तावकाशो दमनो दकारश्शान्तिदः स्मृतः |
धकारः शार्ङ्गधृद्धर्ता माधवश्च प्रकीर्तितः || 49 ||
7.m: p. 45) The letter 'da' is remembered as Giver of Space, Subduer, and Bestower of Peace. / The letter 'dha' is celebrated as Holder of Śārṅga, Supporter, and Mādhava. // 49

7.s:
naro nārāyaṇaḥ panthā nakārassamudāhṛtaḥ |
pakāraḥ padmanābhaśca pavitraḥ paścimānanaḥ || 50 ||
7.d:
नरो नारायणः पन्था नकारस्समुदाहृतः |
पकारः पद्मनाभश्च पवित्रः पश्चिमाननः || 50 ||
7.m: The letter 'na' is declared to be Nara, Nārāyaṇa, and the Path. / The letter 'pa' is Padmanābha, Pure, and West-Facing. // 50

7.s:
phakāraḥ phullanayano lāṅgalī śvetasaṃjñikaḥ |
bakāro vāmano hrasvaḥ pūrṇāṅgassa ca gīyate || 51 ||
7.d:
फकारः फुल्लनयनो लाङ्गली श्वेतसंज्ञिकः |
बकारो वामनो ह्रस्वः पूर्णाङ्गस्स च गीयते || 51 ||
7.m: The letter 'pha' has Blossoming Eyes, Holds a Plough, and is named White. / The letter 'ba' is sung as Vāmana, Short, and of Complete Limbs. // 51

7.s:
bhallāyudho bhakāraśca jñeyassiddhiprado dhruvaḥ |
makāro mardanaḥ kālaḥ pradhānaḥ paripaṭhyate || 52 ||
7.d:
भल्लायुधो भकारश्च ज्ञेयस्सिद्धिप्रदो ध्रुवः |
मकारो मर्दनः कालः प्रधानः परिपठ्यते || 52 ||
7.m: The letter 'bha' should be known as Armed with a Spear, Bestower of Attainment, and the Constant. / The letter 'ma' is recited as the Crusher, Time, and Pradhāna. // 52

7.s:
caturgatiryakārastu sa sūkṣmaśśaṅkha ucyate |
aśeṣabhuvanādhāro ro'nalaḥ kālapāvakaḥ || 53 ||
7.d:
चतुर्गतिर्यकारस्तु स सूक्ष्मश्शङ्ख उच्यते |
अशेषभुवनाधारो रोऽनलः कालपावकः || 53 ||
7.m: The letter 'ya' has Fourfold Movement, is Subtle, and called the Conch. / 'Ra' is the Support of Endless Worlds, Fire, and the Fire of Time. // 53

7.s:
lakāro vibudhākhyastu dhareśaḥ puruṣeśvaraḥ |
varāhaścāmṛtādhāro vakāro varuṇassmṛtaḥ || 54 ||
7.d:
लकारो विबुधाख्यस्तु धरेशः पुरुषेश्वरः |
वराहश्चामृताधारो वकारो वरुणस्स्मृतः || 54 ||
7.m: The letter 'la' is named the Wise, Lord of the Earth, and Lord of Men. / The letter 'va' is remembered as Varāha, Receptacle of Nectar, and Varuṇa. // 54

7.s:
śakāraḥ śaṅkaraḥ śāntaḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
nṛsihmaścāgnirūpaśca ṣakāro bhāskarastathā || 55 ||
7.d:
शकारः शङ्करः शान्तः पुण्डरीकः प्रकीर्तितः |
नृसिह्मश्चाग्निरूपश्च षकारो भास्करस्तथा || 55 ||
7.m: The letter 'śa' is proclaimed as Śaṅkara, Peaceful, and the Lotus. / The letter 'ṣa' is Narasiṃha, having the nature of Fire, and the Sun. // 55

7.s:
sakāraścāmṛtaṃ tṛptissomastu paripaṭhyate |
sūryo hakāraḥ prāṇastu paramātmā prakīrtitaḥ || 56 ||
7.d:
सकारश्चामृतं तृप्तिस्सोमस्तु परिपठ्यते |
सूर्यो हकारः प्राणस्तु परमात्मा प्रकीर्तितः || 56 ||
7.m: The letter 'sa' is recited as Nectar, Contentment, and Soma. / The letter 'ha' is proclaimed as the Sun, Prāṇa, and the Supreme Self. // 56

7.s:
ananteśaḥ kṣakārastu vargānto garuḍassmṛtaḥ |
aśeṣasaṃjñā varṇānāmityetāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 57 ||
7.d:
अनन्तेशः क्षकारस्तु वर्गान्तो गरुडस्स्मृतः |
अशेषसंज्ञा वर्णानामित्येताः परिकीर्तिताः || 57 ||
7.m: The letter 'kṣa' is remembered as the Lord of Ananta, the End of the Class, and Garuḍa. / Thus have these endless designations of the letters been proclaimed. // 57

7.s:
anulomavilomena varṇādvarṇasya vai punaḥ |
saṃkhyā saṃjñā ca yā samyaksāmānyā sā mahāmate || 58 ||
7.d:
अनुलोमविलोमेन वर्णाद्वर्णस्य वै पुनः |
संख्या संज्ञा च या सम्यक्सामान्या सा महामते || 58 ||
7.m: In direct and reverse order from letter to letter, / that enumeration and designation which is correct is general, O highly intelligent one. // 58

7.s:
[bhagavadaṃśabhūtānāmakṣarāṇāmaṅgāṅgibhāvena
mithaḥasaṅgatānāṃ mantrotpattihetutā]
7.d:
[भगवदंशभूतानामक्षराणामङ्गाङ्गिभावेन
मिथःअसङ्गतानां मन्त्रोत्पत्तिहेतुता]
7.m: [Letters being portions of the Lord, mutually connected as principal and subordinate parts, are the cause of the arising of mantras]

7.s:
ete bhagavadaṃśāśca śabdā bhāsvaravigrahāḥ |
kāraṇaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ bhagavacchaktibṛṃhitāḥ || 59 ||
7.d:
एते भगवदंशाश्च शब्दा भास्वरविग्रहाः |
कारणं सर्वमन्त्राणां भगवच्छक्तिबृंहिताः || 59 ||
7.m: These words, having radiant forms, are portions of the Lord; / bolstered by the power of the Lord, they are the cause of all mantras. // 59

7.s:
parasparāṅgabhāvena mantrotpattiṃ vrajanti ca |
carācare'smiṃstannāsti yadamībhirna bhāvitam || 60 ||
7.d:
परस्पराङ्गभावेन मन्त्रोत्पत्तिं व्रजन्ति च |
चराचरेऽस्मिंस्तन्नास्ति यदमीभिर्न भावितम् || 60 ||
7.m: Through mutual relation as subordinate parts, they attain the status of mantras. / There is nothing in this moving and unmoving [world] that is not pervaded by them. // 60

7.s: kṛtvaivaṃ bhāvagāṃ vyāptiṃ varṇānāṃ pūjanakriyā |
7.d: कृत्वैवं भावगां व्याप्तिं वर्णानां पूजनक्रिया |
7.m: Having thus effected the mental pervasion of the letters, the rite of worship [follows]:

7.s: [mantroddhārakramaḥ]
7.d: [मन्त्रोद्धारक्रमः]

7.s: svahṛccakre'tha bhūmiṣṭhe tato mantrānsamuddharet || 61 ||
7.d: स्वहृच्चक्रेऽथ भूमिष्ठे ततो मन्त्रान्समुद्धरेत् || 61 ||
7.m: One should then extract the mantras within the cakra of one's own heart situated on the ground. // 61

7.s:
vargāntamādyaṃ bījaṃ tu saptavargādvibheditam |
p. 46) pañcabinduyutaṃ mūrdhni vyomeśena niyojitam || 62 ||
7.d:
वर्गान्तमाद्यं बीजं तु सप्तवर्गाद्विभेदितम् |
प्. 46) पञ्चबिन्दुयुतं मूर्ध्नि व्योमेशेन नियोजितम् || 62 ||
7.m: The first seed-syllable is the end of the class, distinguished from the seven classes, / endowed with five bindus on the head, conjoined with the Lord of the Void. // 62

7.s:
idaṃ bījavaraṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
ananteśāttṛtīyaṃ tu svaravargāntayojitam || 63 ||
7.d:
इदं बीजवरं दिव्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् |
अनन्तेशात्तृतीयं तु स्वरवर्गान्तयोजितम् || 63 ||
7.m: This divine, excellent seed-syllable grants the fruit of all desires. / The third from the Lord of Ananta, conjoined with the end of the vowel class, // 63

7.s:
dvitīyaṃ tasya tadbījaṃ jarāmṛtyubhayāpaham |
svarādyaṃ pañcamaṃ caiva pañcaviṃśena yojitam || 64 ||
7.d:
द्वितीयं तस्य तद्बीजं जरामृत्युभयापहम् |
स्वराद्यं पञ्चमं चैव पञ्चविंशेन योजितम् || 64 ||
7.m: is its second seed-syllable, removing the fear of old age and death. / The first vowel and the fifth, conjoined with the twenty-fifth— // 64

7.s:
tayorādyaṃ likhedbījaṃ bhogamokṣapradaṃ śubham |
namaskārapadopetaṃ sarvaśaktyāśrayaṃ prabhum || 65 ||
7.d:
तयोराद्यं लिखेद्बीजं भोगमोक्षप्रदं शुभम् |
नमस्कारपदोपेतं सर्वशक्त्याश्रयं प्रभुम् || 65 ||
7.m: one should write the first seed-syllable of the two, auspicious, bestowing enjoyment and liberation, / endowed with the word of obeisance, resting on all powers, the Lord. // 65

7.s:
etadvarṇatrayaṃ dehaḥ sthūlabhāso mama dvija |
bhūtadehavyapekṣāyāṃ kiñcitsūkṣmaśca nārada || 66 ||
7.d:
एतद्वर्णत्रयं देहः स्थूलभासो मम द्विज |
भूतदेहव्यपेक्षायां किञ्चित्सूक्ष्मश्च नारद || 66 ||
7.m: This triad of letters is my gross-manifesting body, O twice-born one, / yet in comparison to the elemental body, it is somewhat subtle, O Nārada. // 66

7.s:
paramūrttyantareṇaiva sthūla eva vibhāti ca |
atyutkṛṣṭaguṇairyukto hyadṛśyo yasya kasyacit || 67 ||
7.d:
परमूर्त्त्यन्तरेणैव स्थूल एव विभाति च |
अत्युत्कृष्टगुणैर्युक्तो ह्यदृश्यो यस्य कस्यचित् || 67 ||
7.m: Through another supreme form, it shines as gross indeed; / endowed with exceedingly eminent qualities, it is invisible to anyone whatsoever. // 67

7.s:
api cetkevalassarvāmarthasiddhiṃ prayacchati |
kiṃ punarmūrttimantreṇa dvādaśārṇena saṃyutaḥ || 68 ||
7.d:
अपि चेत्केवलस्सर्वामर्थसिद्धिं प्रयच्छति |
किं पुनर्मूर्त्तिमन्त्रेण द्वादशार्णेन संयुतः || 68 ||
7.m: Even alone, it grants the attainment of all aims; / how much more so when conjoined with the twelve-syllabled icon-mantra! // 68

7.s:
padaṃ nārāyaṇāyeti kuryādviśvātmane tataḥ |
hrīṃ svāhākārasaṃyukto mūrttimantro hyayaṃ smṛtaḥ || 69 ||
7.d:
पदं नारायणायेति कुर्याद्विश्वात्मने ततः |
ह्रीं स्वाहाकारसंयुक्तो मूर्त्तिमन्त्रो ह्ययं स्मृतः || 69 ||
7.m: Then, to the Self of All, one should add the word 'nārāyaṇāya'; / conjoined with 'hrīṃ' and the word 'svāhā', this is remembered as the icon-mantra. // 69

7.s: [mantramahimānuvarṇanam]
7.d: [मन्त्रमहिमानुवर्णनम्]
7.m: [Description of the greatness of the mantra]

7.s:
saṅkalpākalparūpastu tryarṇasyādyoditasya ca |
aṇimādiguṇādhāraḥ pātālotthānasiddhidaḥ || 70 ||
7.d:
सङ्कल्पाकल्परूपस्तु त्र्यर्णस्याद्योदितस्य च |
अणिमादिगुणाधारः पातालोत्थानसिद्धिदः || 70 ||
7.m: The three-syllabled [mantra] first declared, whose nature is imagination and non-imagination, / is the foundation of qualities such as atomicity, and bestows the attainment of emerging from Pātāla. // 70

7.s:
mokṣado mokṣakāmasya bhogakāmasya bhogadaḥ |
rājyado rājyakāmasya dhanakāmasya bhūtidaḥ || 71 ||
7.d:
मोक्षदो मोक्षकामस्य भोगकामस्य भोगदः |
राज्यदो राज्यकामस्य धनकामस्य भूतिदः || 71 ||
7.m: It gives liberation to one desiring liberation, and gives enjoyment to one desiring enjoyment; / it gives kingship to one desiring kingship, and gives prosperity to one desiring wealth. // 71

7.s:
yānyānprārthayate kāmānsarvānvai sādhakāya ca |
da(dā)tyuccāramātreṇa samyaktadbhāvitātmane || 72 ||
7.d:
यान्यान्प्रार्थयते कामान्सर्वान्वै साधकाय च |
द(दा)त्युच्चारमात्रेण सम्यक्तद्भावितात्मने || 72 ||
7.m: Whatever desires he prays for, all of them indeed to the practitioner / it gives by mere utterance, to one whose mind is thoroughly contemplated on it. // 72

7.s: [devatādhyānam]
7.d: [देवताध्यानम्]

7.s:
anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ jagatsraṣṭāramīśvaram |
dhyāyeccaturbhuja vipra śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 73 ||
7.d:
अनादिनिधनं देवं जगत्स्रष्टारमीश्वरम् |
ध्यायेच्चतुर्भुज विप्र शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् || 73 ||
7.m: One should meditate, O vipra, on the God without beginning or end, the creator of the world, the Lord, / having four arms, bearing the conch, discus, and mace, // 73

7.s:
caturvaktraṃ sunayanaṃ sukāntaṃ padmapāṇinam |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ narasihmāsyaṃ vārāhaṃ kapilānanam || 74 ||
7.d:
चतुर्वक्त्रं सुनयनं सुकान्तं पद्मपाणिनम् |
वैकुण्ठं नरसिह्मास्यं वाराहं कपिलाननम् || 74 ||
7.m: having four faces, beautiful eyes, lovely, with a lotus in hand: / Vaikuṇṭha, man-lion-faced, boar-faced, and Kapila-faced, // 74

7.s:
śuklaṃ khageśvarārūḍhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ mālyāmbaradharaṃ vibhum || 75 ||
7.d:
शुक्लं खगेश्वरारूढं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् |
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नं माल्याम्बरधरं विभुम् || 75 ||
7.m: white, mounted upon the Lord of Birds, adorned with all ornaments, / endowed with all auspicious marks, wearing garlands and garments, the all-pervading Lord, // 75

7.s:
p. 47) kirīṭakaustubhadharaṃ karpūrāliptavigraham |
sūryāyutasahasrābhaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam || 76 ||
7.d:
प्. 47) किरीटकौस्तुभधरं कर्पूरालिप्तविग्रहम् |
सूर्यायुतसहस्राभं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् || 76 ||
7.m: bearing a diadem and the Kaustubha, his body smeared with camphor, / shining like hundreds of thousands of suns, revered by all the gods. // 76

7.s: [lakṣmyādīnāṃ bhagavadrūpe nityasānnidhyam]
7.d: [लक्ष्म्यादीनां भगवद्रूपे नित्यसान्निध्यम्]
7.m: [The eternal presence of Lakṣmī and the others in the Lord's form]

7.s:
lakṣmīḥ kīrttirjayā māyā devyastasyāśritāssadā |
svaśaktinicayopetā nirākārāstu niṣkalāḥ || 77 ||
7.d:
लक्ष्मीः कीर्त्तिर्जया माया देव्यस्तस्याश्रितास्सदा |
स्वशक्तिनिचयोपेता निराकारास्तु निष्कलाः || 77 ||
7.m: Lakṣmī, Kīrti, Jayā, and Māyā are the goddesses eternally taking refuge in Him; / endowed with the multitude of their own powers, yet formless and unqualified. // 77

7.s:
sūryasya raśmayo yadvadūrmayaścāmbudheriva |
sarvaiśvaryaprabhāvena kamalā śrīpatestathā || 78 ||
7.d:
सूर्यस्य रश्मयो यद्वदूर्मयश्चाम्बुधेरिव |
सर्वैश्वर्यप्रभावेन कमला श्रीपतेस्तथा || 78 ||
7.m: Just as rays belong to the sun, and waves to the ocean, / so does Kamalā belong to the Lord of Śrī through the power of all sovereignty. // 78

7.s:
nānāviśeṣalakṣmībhiḥ koṭisaṅkhyābhirāvṛtā |
kīrttistathāvidherdeva (naiva ?) vidhinā vigrahe vibhoḥ || 79 ||
7.d:
नानाविशेषलक्ष्मीभिः कोटिसङ्ख्याभिरावृता |
कीर्त्तिस्तथाविधेर्देव (नैव ?) विधिना विग्रहे विभोः || 79 ||
7.m: Surrounded by diverse particular Lakṣmīs numbered in the millions, / in like manner is Kīrti, by that rule, in the body of the all-pervading Lord. // 79

7.s:
tannāsti yanna hi tayā vyāptaṃ sāmānyadehayā |
yasya yā ca yadā kīrttissvasāmaryātprajāyate || 80 ||
7.d:
तन्नास्ति यन्न हि तया व्याप्तं सामान्यदेहया |
यस्य या च यदा कीर्त्तिस्स्वसामर्यात्प्रजायते || 80 ||
7.m: There is nothing that is not pervaded by her, whose body is universal. / Whatever fame arises for whoever, whenever, through one's own capability, // 80

7.s:
sā sā vipra smṛtā sarvā viśeṣapratipattibhiḥ |
jayā jayeśvarasyaivaṃ  vyāptibhāvena saṃsthitā || 81 ||
7.d:
सा सा विप्र स्मृता सर्वा विशेषप्रतिपत्तिभिः |
जया जयेश्वरस्यैवं  व्याप्तिभावेन संस्थिता || 81 ||
7.m: all that, O vipra, is remembered through particular apprehensions. / Jayā likewise abides in the state of pervasion belonging to the Lord of Victory. // 81

7.s:
yā kācidvidyate māyā jagatyasmin surādiṣu |
bhagavanmāyayodbhūtāṃ tāṃ viddhi paramāṃ tu vai || 82 ||
7.d:
या काचिद्विद्यते माया जगत्यस्मिन् सुरादिषु |
भगवन्माययोद्भूतां तां विद्धि परमां तु वै || 82 ||
7.m: Whatever māyā exists in this world among gods and others, / know that to be arisen from the māyā of the Lord, supreme indeed. // 82

7.s:
tadīyaṃ niṣkalaṃ rūpaṃ muktvā vai paramārthikam |
ko'smiṃstattvodadhau cāsti caturdhā munisattama || 83 ||
7.d:
तदीयं निष्कलं रूपं मुक्त्वा वै परमार्थिकम् |
कोऽस्मिंस्तत्त्वोदधौ चास्ति चतुर्धा मुनिसत्तम || 83 ||
7.m: Leaving aside His unqualified, absolute form, / what is there in this ocean of tattvas that is fourfold, O best of sages? // 83

7.s:
bhagavacchaktibhissamyagābhiryogavibhāgataḥ |
svālokajñānasāmarthyātsākāratvamupāgatāḥ || 84 ||
7.d:
भगवच्छक्तिभिस्सम्यगाभिर्योगविभागतः |
स्वालोकज्ञानसामर्थ्यात्साकारत्वमुपागताः || 84 ||
7.m: Through these powers of the Lord, by division through yoga, / by the power of their own luminous knowledge, they have assumed embodied form. // 84

7.s: [lakṣmyādīnāṃ dhyānaprakāraḥ]
7.d: [लक्ष्म्यादीनां ध्यानप्रकारः]
7.m: [The manner of meditation on Lakṣmī and the others]

7.s:
dhyātavyāssādhakendreṇa yasya strīśca(striyaścāsya ?)svasiddhaye |
ekavaktrā dvinetrāśca dvibhujāścārukuṇḍalāḥ || 85 ||
7.d:
ध्यातव्यास्साधकेन्द्रेण यस्य स्त्रीश्च(स्त्रियश्चास्य ?)स्वसिद्धये |
एकवक्त्रा द्विनेत्राश्च द्विभुजाश्चारुकुण्डलाः || 85 ||
7.m: His women should be meditated upon by the eminent practitioner for his own attainment: / single-faced, two-eyed, two-armed, with charming earrings, // 85

7.s:
padmagarbhanibhāḥ kāntā mekhalādāmamaṇḍitāḥ |
śvetamālyāmbaradharā hārakeyūrabhūṣitāḥ || 86 ||
7.d:
पद्मगर्भनिभाः कान्ता मेखलादाममण्डिताः |
श्वेतमाल्याम्बरधरा हारकेयूरभूषिताः || 86 ||
7.m: resembling the interior of a lotus, lovely, adorned with girdle-bands, / wearing white garlands and garments, adorned with necklaces and armlets, // 86

7.s:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāḥ pīnonnatapayodharāḥ |
prabuddhotpalavistīrṇalocanāśca smitānanāḥ || 87 ||
7.d:
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नाः पीनोन्नतपयोधराः |
प्रबुद्धोत्पलविस्तीर्णलोचनाश्च स्मिताननाः || 87 ||
7.m: endowed with all auspicious marks, with full and raised breasts, / their eyes wide like blossomed blue lotuses, with smiling faces, // 87

7.s:
caladdvirephapaṭalatulyairyuktāstathā'lakaiḥ |
lalāṭatilakaiścitrairvividhaiḥ parimaṇḍitāḥ || 88 ||
7.d:
चलद्द्विरेफपटलतुल्यैर्युक्तास्तथाऽलकैः |
ललाटतिलकैश्चित्रैर्विविधैः परिमण्डिताः || 88 ||
7.m: endowed with curls resembling swarms of hovering black bees, / embellished with various brilliant forehead marks, // 88

7.s:
āraktādhararaktāśca vaṃśamuktāphaladvijāḥ |
ardhacandralalāṭāśca ślakṣṇakuñcitamūrdhajāḥ || 89 ||
7.d:
आरक्ताधररक्ताश्च वंशमुक्ताफलद्विजाः |
अर्धचन्द्रललाटाश्च श्लक्ष्णकुञ्चितमूर्धजाः || 89 ||
7.m: with reddish lower lips, teeth like bamboo pearls, / foreheads like the crescent moon, and smooth, curled hair on the head, // 89

7.s:
p. 48) pāśāṅkuśadharā devyaḥ sarvakāmārthasādhakāḥ |
pūrvādidigvibhāgasthāḥ kesarāreṣu nārada || 90 ||
7.d:
प्. 48) पाशाङ्कुशधरा देव्यः सर्वकामार्थसाधकाः |
पूर्वादिदिग्विभागस्थाः केसरारेषु नारद || 90 ||
7.m: the goddesses holding a noose and a goad, accomplishing all desires and aims, / situated in the directions beginning with the east, upon the filament-spokes, O Nārada, // 90

7.s: baddhapadmāsanāścaiva devadevasya saṃukhāḥ |
7.d: बद्धपद्मासनाश्चैव देवदेवस्य संउखाः |
7.m: seated in the lotus posture, facing the God of gods. // 91ab

7.s: [lakṣmyādimantranirūpaṇopakramaḥ]
7.d: [लक्ष्म्यादिमन्त्रनिरूपणोपक्रमः]
7.m: [Introduction to the exposition of the mantras of Lakṣmī and the others]

7.s: mantrāṃstāsāṃ pravakṣyāmi pūjārthaṃ vividhānatha || 91 ||
7.d: मन्त्रांस्तासां प्रवक्ष्यामि पूजार्थं विविधानथ || 91 ||
7.m: I shall now declare their various mantras for the purpose of worship, // 91cd

7.s:
yaissamārādhitāḥ śaśvadabhīṣṭaṃ sādhayanti ca |
mūlamantrāddvitīyaṃ yatkevalaṃ bījanāyakam || 92 ||
7.d:
यैस्समाराधिताः शश्वदभीष्टं साधयन्ति च |
मूलमन्त्राद्द्वितीयं यत्केवलं बीजनायकम् || 92 ||
7.m: worshipped by which they constantly accomplish what is desired. / That which is the second, single lord of seed-syllables from the root-mantra // 92

7.s:
sāmānyaṃ hṛdayaṃ hyetatsarvāsāṃ parikīrtitam |
mūrtimantracatuṣkaṃ tu krameṇāsāṃ pṛthakśṛṇu || 93 ||
7.d:
सामान्यं हृदयं ह्येतत्सर्वासां परिकीर्तितम् |
मूर्तिमन्त्रचतुष्कं तु क्रमेणासां पृथक्शृणु || 93 ||
7.m: is proclaimed as the common heart for all of them. / Listen individually to their quartet of icon-mantras in order: // 93

7.s: [lakṣmīmantraḥ]
7.d: [लक्ष्मीमन्त्रः]

7.s:
praṇavaṃ coddharetpūrvaṃ hṛdbījaṃ tadanantaram |
dvirakṣare padaṃ lakṣmyai prāṅgamontaṃ niveśya ca || 94 ||
7.d:
प्रणवं चोद्धरेत्पूर्वं हृद्बीजं तदनन्तरम् |
द्विरक्षरे पदं लक्ष्म्यै प्राङ्गमोन्तं निवेश्य च || 94 ||
7.m: One should first extract the praṇava, and immediately after that the heart-seed; / having placed the word 'lakṣmyai' in two syllables ending with the principal limb, // 94

7.s:
tataḥ paramaśabdaṃ tu tadante puruṣeśvaram |
vargāntamāsvaropetaṃ vasthitāyai padaṃ nyaset || 95 ||
7.d:
ततः परमशब्दं तु तदन्ते पुरुषेश्वरम् |
वर्गान्तमास्वरोपेतं वस्थितायै पदं न्यसेत् || 95 ||
7.m: then the word 'parama', and after it 'puruṣeśvara'; / one should set down the end of the class endowed with the vowel 'ā', [then] the word 'vasthitāyai', // 95

7.s:
bhūyastaddhṛdayaṃ bījaṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ bījadvayaṃ tataḥ |
svāhāsamanvitaṃ vipra praṇavādyaṃ ca mantrarāṭ || 96 ||
7.d:
भूयस्तद्धृदयं बीजं श्रीं ह्रीं बीजद्वयं ततः |
स्वाहासमन्वितं विप्र प्रणवाद्यं च मन्त्रराट् || 96 ||
7.m: again that heart-seed, then the pair of seed-syllables 'śrīṃ' and 'hrīṃ', / conjoined with 'svāhā', O vipra, beginning with the praṇava: [such is] the king of mantras. // 96

7.s: mūrttimantrasametastu lakṣmyākhyo dvidaśākṣaraḥ |
7.d: मूर्त्तिमन्त्रसमेतस्तु लक्ष्म्याख्यो द्विदशाक्षरः |
7.m: Joined with the icon-mantra, [the mantra] named after Lakṣmī consists of twenty syllables.

7.s: [kīrttimantraḥ]
7.d: [कीर्त्तिमन्त्रः]

7.s: hṛdbījaṃ praṇavādyaṃ tu padaṃ kīrttyai tato namaḥ || 97 ||
7.d: हृद्बीजं प्रणवाद्यं तु पदं कीर्त्त्यै ततो नमः || 97 ||
7.m: The heart-seed beginning with the praṇava, then the word 'kīrtyai', then 'namaḥ', // 97

7.s:
sadoditānandapadaṃ vigrahāyai padaṃ tvanu |
hrīṃ klīṃ svāhāsametastu prāksaṃkhyaṃ kīrtimantrarāṭ || 98 ||
7.d:
सदोदितानन्दपदं विग्रहायै पदं त्वनु |
ह्रीं क्लीं स्वाहासमेतस्तु प्राक्संख्यं कीर्तिमन्त्रराट् || 98 ||
7.m: the word 'sadoditānanda', and immediately following, the word 'vigrahāyai'; / joined with 'hrīṃ', 'klīṃ', and 'svāhā', having the previous number of syllables, is the king of Kīrti-mantras. // 98

7.s: [jayāmantraḥ]
7.d: [जयामन्त्रः]

7.s:
hṛdbījaṃ praṇavopetaṃ jayāyai tryakṣaraṃ namaḥ |
svarādyaṃ jitaśabdaśca dhāmā varṇadvayaṃ tataḥ || 99 ||
7.d:
हृद्बीजं प्रणवोपेतं जयायै त्र्यक्षरं नमः |
स्वराद्यं जितशब्दश्च धामा वर्णद्वयं ततः || 99 ||
7.m: The heart-seed conjoined with the praṇava, 'jayāyai', the three-syllabled 'namaḥ' [with seed]; / the initial vowel, the word 'jita', then the two syllables 'dhāmā', // 99

7.s:
vasthitāyai padaṃ kṛtvā taddhṛdbījaṃ nyasetpunaḥ |
aśeṣabhuvanādhārāvasthitaṃ ca tṛtīyakam || 100 ||
7.d:
वस्थितायै पदं कृत्वा तद्धृद्बीजं न्यसेत्पुनः |
अशेषभुवनाधारावस्थितं च तृतीयकम् || 100 ||
7.m: having formed the word 'vasthitāyai', one should place that heart-seed again; / and the third [seed], 'aśeṣabhuvanādhārāvasthitaṃ', // 100

7.s:
vyomeśapañcabindussyātsvāhā tadanu nārada (vai padam) |
varṇādvidaśasaṃkhyaśca jayākhyo mantra uttamaḥ || 101 ||
7.d:
व्योमेशपञ्चबिन्दुस्स्यात्स्वाहा तदनु नारद (वै पदम्) |
वर्णाद्विदशसंख्यश्च जयाख्यो मन्त्र उत्तमः || 101 ||
7.m: there should be the Lord of the Void with five bindus, followed by 'svāhā', O Nārada; / counting twenty syllables, this is the supreme mantra named after Jayā. // 101

7.s: p. 49) [māyāmantraḥ]

prāgbījaṃ praṇavādyaṃ ca māyāyai ca tato namaḥ |
mohātītapadaṃ cātha nāntaṃ tadanu yojayet || 102 ||
7.d:
प्राग्बीजं प्रणवाद्यं च मायायै च ततो नमः |
मोहातीतपदं चाथ नान्तं तदनु योजयेत् || 102 ||
7.m: The prior seed beginning with the praṇava, and 'māyāyai', then 'namaḥ'; / then one should join the word 'mohātīta', followed by that ending in 'n', // 102

7.s:
dvitīyasvarasaṃyuktaṃ dakāraṃ tadanantaram |
śṛtāyai tryakṣaraśśabdo māyābījaṃ tato bhavet || 103 ||
7.d:
द्वितीयस्वरसंयुक्तं दकारं तदनन्तरम् |
शृतायै त्र्यक्षरश्शब्दो मायाबीजं ततो भवेत् || 103 ||
7.m: immediately after, the syllable 'da' joined with the second vowel; / the three-syllable word 'śritāyai', and then there should be the Māyā-seed: // 103

7.s:
pradhānamanalārūḍhaṃ caturthasvarabhūṣitam |
trailokyaiśvaryadenaiva yuktaṃ svāhāntamuddharet || 104 ||
7.d:
प्रधानमनलारूढं चतुर्थस्वरभूषितम् |
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेनैव युक्तं स्वाहान्तमुद्धरेत् || 104 ||
7.m: the pradhāna mounted on fire, adorned with the fourth vowel, / joined with the granter of dominion over the three worlds, ending in 'svāhā'—one should extract it. // 104

7.s: māyāmantraśca pūrveṣāṃ varṇasaṃkhyāsamassmṛtaḥ |
7.d: मायामन्त्रश्च पूर्वेषां वर्णसंख्यासमस्स्मृतः |
7.m: And the Māyā-mantra is taught to have the same number of syllables as the preceding ones.

7.s: [hṛdādyaṅgamantranirūpaṇam]
7.d: [हृदाद्यङ्गमन्त्रनिरूपणम्]
7.m: [Description of the Limb-Mantras Beginning with the Heart]

7.s: aṅgāni devadevasya kathayiṣyāmi tattvataḥ || 105 ||
7.d: अङ्गानि देवदेवस्य कथयिष्यामि तत्त्वतः || 105 ||
7.m: I shall describe in truth the limbs of the God of gods, // 105

7.s:
sannaddhaḥsādhako yaistu avadhyastridaśairapi |
sādhayetsarvakāryāṇi yānyāyussukhadāni ca || 106 ||
7.d:
सन्नद्धःसाधको यैस्तु अवध्यस्त्रिदशैरपि |
साधयेत्सर्वकार्याणि यान्यायुस्सुखदानि च || 106 ||
7.m: equipped with which a practitioner cannot be slain even by the thirty [gods], / and can accomplish all works that bestow longevity and happiness, // 106

7.s: bhaktastadbhāvitātmā ca yadi mantrakriyāparaḥ |
7.d: भक्तस्तद्भावितात्मा च यदि मन्त्रक्रियापरः |
7.m: if he is devoted, has his mind concentrated on Him, and is intent on ritual action with mantras.

7.s: [hṛnmantraḥ]
7.d: [हृन्मन्त्रः]

7.s: anantapūrvaṃ yadbījaṃ bindubhūṣitamuddharet || 107 ||
7.d: अनन्तपूर्वं यद्बीजं बिन्दुभूषितमुद्धरेत् || 107 ||
7.m: One should extract that seed preceded by Ananta, adorned with the bindu; // 107

7.s:
namo'ntaṃ praṇavādyaṃ tu hṛnmantraṃ viddhi niṣkalam |
asyaiva mūrttimantro yastaṃ te vacmi yathāsthitam || 108 ||
7.d:
नमोऽन्तं प्रणवाद्यं तु हृन्मन्त्रं विद्धि निष्कलम् |
अस्यैव मूर्त्तिमन्त्रो यस्तं ते वच्मि यथास्थितम् || 108 ||
7.m: ending in 'namaḥ' and beginning with the praṇava, know this unqualified heart-mantra. / What is the icon-mantra of this very [heart], that I speak to you as it stands: // 108

7.s:
praṇavo bindusaṃbhinnassūryassomo visargadhṛk |
śuciśabdaṃ tataḥ kuryādagnirūpamathoddharet || 109 ||
7.d:
प्रणवो बिन्दुसंभिन्नस्सूर्यस्सोमो विसर्गधृक् |
शुचिशब्दं ततः कुर्यादग्निरूपमथोद्धरेत् || 109 ||
7.m: The praṇava divided by a bindu, the Sun, the Moon bearing the visarga; / then one should make the word 'śuci', then extract the form of Agni, // 109

7.s:
dakāravarṇaṃ tadanu praṇavenāpyalaṅkṛtam |
hṛdayāya namaskuryāt hṛnmantro mūrtisaṃyutaḥ || 110 ||
7.d:
दकारवर्णं तदनु प्रणवेनाप्यलङ्कृतम् |
हृदयाय नमस्कुर्यात् हृन्मन्त्रो मूर्तिसंयुतः || 110 ||
7.m: immediately after, the syllable 'da' adorned also with the praṇava; / one should offer homage to the heart: [this is] the heart-mantra conjoined with the icon[-mantra], // 110

7.s: saptādaśākṣaro vipra sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ |
7.d: सप्तादशाक्षरो विप्र सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकः |
7.m: consisting of seventeen syllables, O vipra, granting all attainments.

7.s: [śiromantraḥ]
7.d: [शिरोमन्त्रः]

7.s: dvitīyasvarasaṃyuktaṃ tadeva śirasi nyaset || 111 ||
7.d: द्वितीयस्वरसंयुक्तं तदेव शिरसि न्यसेत् || 111 ||
7.m: One should place that very [seed] conjoined with the second vowel on the head; // 111

7.s:
evamuddhṛtya ca tatastasyādau praṇavaṃ nyaset |
praṇatiṃ cāvasāne tu mūrdhānaṃ viddhi niṣkalam || 112 ||
7.d:
एवमुद्धृत्य च ततस्तस्यादौ प्रणवं न्यसेत् |
प्रणतिं चावसाने तु मूर्धानं विद्धि निष्कलम् || 112 ||
7.m: having extracted it thus, one should then place the praṇava at its beginning, / and a salutation at the end: know this unqualified head[-mantra]. // 112

7.s:
mūrttimantramatho vakṣye asyaivānucarastu yaḥ |
proddharetpadmanābhākhyaṃ kevalaṃ tādṛśaṃ tvanu || 113 ||
7.d:
मूर्त्तिमन्त्रमथो वक्ष्ये अस्यैवानुचरस्तु यः |
प्रोद्धरेत्पद्मनाभाख्यं केवलं तादृशं त्वनु || 113 ||
7.m: Now I shall state the icon-mantra that attends this very [head]: / one should extract the [seed] named Padmanābha alone, and immediately after that, one of like kind, // 113

7.s:
aśeṣabhuvanādhāraṃ phalaṃ tasyāvasānagam |
p. 50) kālapāvakasaṃsthaṃ vai taṃ ca phāntaṃ dvijottama || 114 ||
7.d:
अशेषभुवनाधारं फलं तस्यावसानगम् |
प्. 50) कालपावकसंस्थं वै तं च फान्तं द्विजोत्तम || 114 ||
7.m: the support of all the worlds, having 'phala' at its end, / situated on the fire of time, and that [syllable] ending in 'pha', O best of the twice-born. // 114

7.s:
athoddharetprāṇasaṃjñaṃ madanenopari sthitam |
śirase ca padaṃ paścātsvāhā śabdastadantagaḥ || 115 ||
7.d:
अथोद्धरेत्प्राणसंज्ञं मदनेनोपरि स्थितम् |
शिरसे च पदं पश्चात्स्वाहा शब्दस्तदन्तगः || 115 ||
7.m: Then one should extract [the syllable] called 'prāṇa', situated above with Madana; / and thereafter the word 'śirase', with the word 'svāhā' at its end. // 115

7.s: trayodaśākṣaraṃ viddhi śiromantraṃ tu nārada |
7.d: त्रयोदशाक्षरं विद्धि शिरोमन्त्रं तु नारद |
7.m: Know the head-mantra to have thirteen syllables, O Nārada.

7.s: [śikhāmantraḥ]
7.d: [शिखामन्त्रः]

7.s: praṇavaṃ prathamaṃ dadyātsūryākhyaṃ tadanantaram || 116 ||
7.d: प्रणवं प्रथमं दद्यात्सूर्याख्यं तदनन्तरम् || 116 ||
7.m: One should first provide the praṇava, immediately after it the [seed] named the Sun, // 116

7.s:
viṣṇunā'laṅkṛtaṃ mūrdhnā trailokyaiśvaryadena ca |
namaścāsyāvasāne vai śikhāmantraśca niṣkalaḥ || 117 ||
7.d:
विष्णुनाऽलङ्कृतं मूर्ध्ना त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेन च |
नमश्चास्यावसाने वै शिखामन्त्रश्च निष्कलः || 117 ||
7.m: adorned at the head with Viṣṇu, and with the granter of dominion over the three worlds; / and 'namaḥ' at its end: [such is] the unqualified śikhā-mantra. // 117

7.s:
mūrttimantramathāsyaiva vacmi sarvārthasiddhidam |
padmanābhaśca (bhaṃ ca ?)rārūḍhaṃ dakāraṃ śaṅkhamūrdhvagam ||
118 ||
7.d:
मूर्त्तिमन्त्रमथास्यैव वच्मि सर्वार्थसिद्धिदम् |
पद्मनाभश्च (भं च ?)रारूढं दकारं शङ्खमूर्ध्वगम् ||
118 ||
7.m: Now I shall tell its icon-mantra, granting the accomplishment of all aims: / Padmanābha mounted on 'ra', the syllable 'da', Śaṅkha standing above, // 118

7.s:
kuryāttamotadehena protaṃ yatnena nārada |
kevalastālalakṣmāto rāmopeto narastataḥ || 119 ||
7.d:
कुर्यात्तमोतदेहेन प्रोतं यत्नेन नारद |
केवलस्ताललक्ष्मातो रामोपेतो नरस्ततः || 119 ||
7.m: one should carefully weave it together with the body of Tamas, O Nārada; / alone, marked by Tāla, then Nara conjoined with Rāma, // 119

7.s:
śikhāyai vauṣaḍantaśca śikhāmantro hyayaṃ smṛtaḥ |
sārdhatrayodaśārṇaśca nānāsiddhiphalapradaḥ || 120 ||
7.d:
शिखायै वौषडन्तश्च शिखामन्त्रो ह्ययं स्मृतः |
सार्धत्रयोदशार्णश्च नानासिद्धिफलप्रदः || 120 ||
7.m: and ending with 'śikhāyai vauṣaṭ': this is taught as the śikhā-mantra; / having thirteen and a half syllables, it yields the fruits of various attainments. // 120

7.s: [kavacamantraḥ]
7.d: [कवचमन्त्रः]

7.s:
natipraṇavamadhye tu prāṇaṃ vyomavibhūṣitam |
pañcamasvarasaṃyuktaṃ kavacārṇaṃ vinirdiśet || 121 ||
7.d:
नतिप्रणवमध्ये तु प्राणं व्योमविभूषितम् |
पञ्चमस्वरसंयुक्तं कवचार्णं विनिर्दिशेत् || 121 ||
7.m: Between the salutation and the praṇava, Prāṇa adorned with the void, / conjoined with the fifth vowel: one should prescribe this syllable of the armor. // 121

7.s:
kṛṣṇasya mūrttimantre tu bhuktimuktyarthasiddhidam |
proddharecchaṅkārākhyaṃ tu ānandenābhyalaṅkṛtam || 122 ||
7.d:
कृष्णस्य मूर्त्तिमन्त्रे तु भुक्तिमुक्त्यर्थसिद्धिदम् |
प्रोद्धरेच्छङ्काराख्यं तु आनन्देनाभ्यलङ्कृतम् || 122 ||
7.m: In the icon-mantra of Kṛṣṇa, granting the accomplishment of the ends of enjoyment and liberation: / one should extract the [seed] named Śaṅkara, adorned with Ānanda, // 122

7.s:
varāhasthaṃ tamevātha vairājaṃ kevalaṃ tataḥ |
kevalaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ tu kevalaṃ kālapāvakam || 123 ||
7.d:
वराहस्थं तमेवाथ वैराजं केवलं ततः |
केवलं पुण्डरीकं तु केवलं कालपावकम् || 123 ||
7.m: then that same [seed] standing on Varāha, then Vairāja alone, / Puṇḍarīka alone, the fire of time alone, // 123

7.s:
caturgatisamārūḍhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ proddharettataḥ |
kavacāya padaṃ kuryāddhuṅkāreṇa vibhūṣitam || 124 ||
7.d:
चतुर्गतिसमारूढं वैकुण्ठं प्रोद्धरेत्ततः |
कवचाय पदं कुर्याद्धुङ्कारेण विभूषितम् || 124 ||
7.m: then one should extract Vaikuṇṭha mounted on the four paths; / one should formulate the word 'kavacāya', adorned with the syllable 'huṃ'. // 124

7.s: ubhayātmaiṣa uktastu mantraḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ |
7.d: उभयात्मैष उक्तस्तु मन्त्रः पञ्चदशाक्षरः |
7.m: This mantra, of double nature, is taught to have fifteen syllables.

7.s: [netramantraḥ]
7.d: [नेत्रमन्त्रः]

7.s: namontaḥ praṇavādyaśca prāṇo vyomavibhūṣitaḥ || 125 ||
7.d: नमोन्तः प्रणवाद्यश्च प्राणो व्योमविभूषितः || 125 ||
7.m: Ending in 'namaḥ' and beginning with the praṇava, Prāṇa adorned with the void, // 125

7.s:
aukārasvarasaṃyukto netramantrastu niṣkalaḥ |
pavitramanalārūḍhaṃ kamalaṃ gopanāṅkitam || 126 ||
7.d:
औकारस्वरसंयुक्तो नेत्रमन्त्रस्तु निष्कलः |
पवित्रमनलारूढं कमलं गोपनाङ्कितम् || 126 ||
7.m: conjoined with the vowel 'au': this is the unqualified eye-mantra. / Pavitra mounted on fire, Kamala marked by concealment, // 126

7.s:
p. 51) kevalaṃ śaṅkaraścānte rārūḍhaṃ paścimānanam |
ajitaścāmṛtādhārassaṃsthitaṃ proddharettataḥ || 127 ||
7.d:
प्. 51) केवलं शङ्करश्चान्ते रारूढं पश्चिमाननम् |
अजितश्चामृताधारस्संस्थितं प्रोद्धरेत्ततः || 127 ||
7.m: alone, and Śaṅkara at the end mounted on 'ra' facing west; / Ajita, the support of nectar, situated—one should then extract it; // 127

7.s:
dhareśaṃ kevalaṃ dadyānnetrāya tryakṣaraṃ padam |
tadante ca vauṣaṭ kuryānnetramantro hyayaṃ smṛtaḥ || 128 ||
7.d:
धरेशं केवलं दद्यान्नेत्राय त्र्यक्षरं पदम् |
तदन्ते च वौषट् कुर्यान्नेत्रमन्त्रो ह्ययं स्मृतः || 128 ||
7.m: one should supply Dhareśa alone, the three-syllable word 'netrāya', / and at its end one should make 'vauṣaṭ': this is taught as the eye-mantra; // 128

7.s: tripañcavarṇasaṃkhyastu sārddhārṇo dvija siddhidaḥ |
7.d: त्रिपञ्चवर्णसंख्यस्तु सार्द्धार्णो द्विज सिद्धिदः |
7.m: numbering fifteen and a half syllables, O twice-born, it grants attainments.

7.s: [astramantraḥ]
7.d: [अस्त्रमन्त्रः]

7.s: namaḥ praṇavamadhyasthaḥ paramātmā hyanantaram || 129 ||
7.d: नमः प्रणवमध्यस्थः परमात्मा ह्यनन्तरम् || 129 ||
7.m: Between 'namaḥ' and the praṇava stands the Supreme Self immediately after; // 129

7.s:
savisargaḥsa evāstraṃ mūrttimantrasamanvitam |
dattāvakāśasaṃjñaṃ vai māyābhūṣitavigraham || 130 ||
7.d:
सविसर्गःस एवास्त्रं मूर्त्तिमन्त्रसमन्वितम् |
दत्तावकाशसंज्ञं वै मायाभूषितविग्रहम् || 130 ||
7.m: with a visarga, that is the weapon, conjoined with the icon-mantra; / named Dattāvakāśa, its body adorned with Māyā, // 130

7.s:
pavitraṃ sragdharārūḍhaṃ tadūrdhve codanaṃ nyaset |
madanaṃ satyasaṃsthaṃ ca pavitraṃ tālalakṣmagam || 131 ||
7.d:
पवित्रं स्रग्धरारूढं तदूर्ध्वे चोदनं न्यसेत् |
मदनं सत्यसंस्थं च पवित्रं ताललक्ष्मगम् || 131 ||
7.m: Pavitra mounted on Sragdhara, above it one should place Codana; / Madana situated on Satya, and Pavitra gone to the mark of Tāla, // 131

7.s:
bhūyastamanalastha ca kevalaṃ ca dhruvaṃ tataḥ |
tadante cāprameyaṃ tu somākhyaṃ coddharettataḥ || 132 ||
7.d:
भूयस्तमनलस्थ च केवलं च ध्रुवं ततः |
तदन्ते चाप्रमेयं तु सोमाख्यं चोद्धरेत्ततः || 132 ||
7.m: again that [seed] on fire, and then Dhruva alone, / and at its end Aprameya, then one should extract that named Soma, // 132

7.s:
vairājasthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha so'pi cānalasaṃsthitaḥ |
gopanenāṅkayettaṃ vai piṇḍo'yaṃ caturakṣaraḥ || 133 ||
7.d:
वैराजस्थं द्विजश्रेष्ठ सोऽपि चानलसंस्थितः |
गोपनेनाङ्कयेत्तं वै पिण्डोऽयं चतुरक्षरः || 133 ||
7.m: standing on Vairāja, O best of the twice-born, and that too situated on fire; / one should mark it with concealment: this is a four-syllable cluster, // 133

7.s:
kevalaṃ ca tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ phaṭkārapadabhūṣitam |
caturdaśasvaraṃ hyastramarddhākṣaramanvitam || 134 ||
7.d:
केवलं च ततः सूक्ष्मं फट्कारपदभूषितम् |
चतुर्दशस्वरं ह्यस्त्रमर्द्धाक्षरमन्वितम् || 134 ||
7.m: and then Sūkṣma alone, adorned with the word 'phaṭ'; / the weapon indeed has fourteen vowels, conjoined with a half-syllable. // 134

7.s: [pūrvaṃ caturvaktratayoktasya devasya nṛsihmādyāsyatrayamantrāḥ]
7.d: [पूर्वं चतुर्वक्त्रतयोक्तस्य देवस्य नृसिह्माद्यास्यत्रयमन्त्राः]
7.m: [The Mantras of the Three Faces, Beginning with Nṛsiṃha, of the God Previously Described as Four-Faced]

7.s: sthitā nṛsihmapūrveṣu tānvakṣyāmi samāsataḥ || 135 ||
7.d: स्थिता नृसिह्मपूर्वेषु तान्वक्ष्यामि समासतः || 135 ||
7.m: I shall describe in brief those residing in [the faces] beginning with Nṛsiṃha, // 135

7.s:
sadehāśca pṛthagbhāge sāṅgāssaparivārakāḥ |
devasya vaktramātreṇa dhyeyāḥ pūjyāśca yatnataḥ || 136 ||
7.d:
सदेहाश्च पृथग्भागे साङ्गास्सपरिवारकाः |
देवस्य वक्त्रमात्रेण ध्येयाः पूज्याश्च यत्नतः || 136 ||
7.m: with bodies in separate parts, with limbs and with retinues, / which are to be meditated upon and worshipped with care merely as faces of the God. // 136

7.s:
viśvāpyāyayutaṃ vipra praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddharet |
ajitañcānalasthaṃ ca odanena samanvitam || 137 ||
7.d:
विश्वाप्याययुतं विप्र प्रणवं पूर्वमुद्धरेत् |
अजितञ्चानलस्थं च ओदनेन समन्वितम् || 137 ||
7.m: One should first extract the praṇava joined with Viśvāpyāyā, O vipra, / and Ajita standing on fire, conjoined with cooked food [i.e., 'o'], // 137

7.s:
candriṇañcordhvataḥ kṛtvā vyāpanastasya copari |
proddharejjanmahantāraṃ tadadhassāmapāṭhakam || 138 ||
7.d:
चन्द्रिणञ्चोर्ध्वतः कृत्वा व्यापनस्तस्य चोपरि |
प्रोद्धरेज्जन्महन्तारं तदधस्सामपाठकम् || 138 ||
7.m: having placed Candrin above, and Vyāpana upon it; / one should extract the slayer of birth, and beneath it the chanter of the Sāman, // 138

7.s:
kuryāccānalasaṃsthaṃ ca r-urjaṃ vai tadadhaḥ punaḥ |
ūrdhve vyāpī tathā hyādau bhūdharaśca bhavetkramāt || 139 ||
7.d:
कुर्याच्चानलसंस्थं च र्-उर्जं वै तदधः पुनः |
ऊर्ध्वे व्यापी तथा ह्यादौ भूधरश्च भवेत्क्रमात् || 139 ||
7.m:
And one should place it on fire, and further [place] ūrj beneath it;
above is vyāpin, and at the beginning should be the mountain-bearer (bhūdhara) in order. // 139

7.s:
piṇḍākṣaramidaṃ vipra dvitīyasya namontagam |
jvalanāyutaśabdaṃ ca dīptaye tryakṣaraṃ padam || 140 ||
7.d:
पिण्डाक्षरमिदं विप्र द्वितीयस्य नमोन्तगम् |
ज्वलनायुतशब्दं च दीप्तये त्र्यक्षरं पदम् || 140 ||
7.m:
This is the conjunct syllable, O vipra, ending in 'namaḥ' for the second;
and the word 'jvalanāyuta', [then] the three-syllable word 'dīptaye', // 140

7.s:
p. 52) nṛsihmāyeti ca padaṃ svāhā tadanu yojayet |
ūnaviṃśākṣaro mantro mūrtāmūrte nṛkesarī || 141 ||
7.d:
प्. 52) नृसिह्मायेति च पदं स्वाहा तदनु योजयेत् |
ऊनविंशाक्षरो मन्त्रो मूर्तामूर्ते नृकेसरी || 141 ||
7.m:
and the word 'nṛsiṃhāya', then one should join 'svāhā';
this is the nineteen-syllable mantra of Nṛkesarin in the manifest and unmanifest [aspects]. // 141

7.s:
pūjitassaṃsmṛto dhyātassañjaptaśca tato dvija |
nihanyātsāmayāndoṣāṃstathā bhūtagrahānapi || 142 ||
7.d:
पूजितस्संस्मृतो ध्यातस्सञ्जप्तश्च ततो द्विज |
निहन्यात्सामयान्दोषांस्तथा भूतग्रहानपि || 142 ||
7.m:
Worshipped, remembered, meditated upon, and repeated, O twice-born,
it destroys the faults of [broken] vows as well as spirits and grahas. // 142

7.s:
proddharetpraṇavañcādau sūryākhyaṃ tadanantaram |
tameva lokeśagataṃ vyoma cāndrī tadūrdhvataḥ || 143 ||
7.d:
प्रोद्धरेत्प्रणवञ्चादौ सूर्याख्यं तदनन्तरम् |
तमेव लोकेशगतं व्योम चान्द्री तदूर्ध्वतः || 143 ||
7.m:
One should first extract the praṇava, and immediately after, that named sūrya;
that very [syllable] gone into lokeśa, the void, and cāndrī above it; // 143

7.s:
rephabījamathādāya dharmāṃśuṃ tadadho nyaset |
tadadho hyanalaṃ bhūyaḥ prajñādhāropari sthitam || 144 ||
7.d:
रेफबीजमथादाय धर्मांशुं तदधो न्यसेत् |
तदधो ह्यनलं भूयः प्रज्ञाधारोपरि स्थितम् || 144 ||
7.m:
then taking the repha-seed, one should place the sun (dharmāṃśu) beneath it;
beneath that, fire again, situated above the base of wisdom (prajñādhāra); // 144

7.s:
auṣadhātmā'sya cordhve tu cāndrī vyāpī kramādbhavet |
asya piṇḍadvayasyānte namaskāraṃ niyojayet || 145 ||
7.d:
औषधात्माऽस्य चोर्ध्वे तु चान्द्री व्यापी क्रमाद्भवेत् |
अस्य पिण्डद्वयस्यान्ते नमस्कारं नियोजयेत् || 145 ||
7.m:
above it should be the essence of herbs (auṣadhātman), then cāndrī and vyāpin in order;
at the end of this pair of conjunct syllables one should join the salutation [namaḥ]; // 145

7.s:
anantabhāsāya padaṃ kapilāya tato bhavet |
svāhāsamanvitaṃ kuryānmantraṃ saptadaśākṣaram || 146 ||
7.d:
अनन्तभासाय पदं कपिलाय ततो भवेत् |
स्वाहासमन्वितं कुर्यान्मन्त्रं सप्तदशाक्षरम् || 146 ||
7.m:
then should be the word 'anantabhāsāya', [then] 'kapilāya';
one should make the seventeen-syllable mantra accompanied by 'svāhā'. // 146

7.s:
atyugraṃ kapilaṃ nāmnā sarvadvandopaśāntidam |
prāyaścittavidhau nityaṃ japtavyassiddhihetukaḥ || 147 ||
7.d:
अत्युग्रं कपिलं नाम्ना सर्वद्वन्दोपशान्तिदम् |
प्रायश्चित्तविधौ नित्यं जप्तव्यस्सिद्धिहेतुकः || 147 ||
7.m:
Extremely fierce, Kapila by name, bestowing pacification of all dualities,
it should be recited constantly in expiatory rites, bringing about success, // 147

7.s:
tathā'pavargaprāptyarthamacireṇa tu nārada |
prāgoṅkāramathādāya govindākhyamathoddharet || 148 ||
7.d:
तथाऽपवर्गप्राप्त्यर्थमचिरेण तु नारद |
प्रागोङ्कारमथादाय गोविन्दाख्यमथोद्धरेत् || 148 ||
7.m:
and also for attaining liberation without delay, O Nārada.
First taking the oṅkāra, one should then extract that called govinda, // 148

7.s:
puruṣeśvaramasyātha otadehaṃ tadūrdhvagam |
tryailokyaiśvaryadopetaṃ ṭakārastasya copari || 149 ||
7.d:
पुरुषेश्वरमस्याथ ओतदेहं तदूर्ध्वगम् |
त्र्यैलोक्यैश्वर्यदोपेतं टकारस्तस्य चोपरि || 149 ||
7.m:
[then] puruṣeśvara of this, then the body woven (ota) going above it,
endowed with the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds, and the letter 'ṭa' upon it; // 149

7.s:
amṛtākhyaṃ varāhasthamūkāraṃ tadadho dvija |
okārāntaṃ tadūrdhve tu tryailokyaiśvaryadaṃ tataḥ || 150 ||
7.d:
अमृताख्यं वराहस्थमूकारं तदधो द्विज |
ओकारान्तं तदूर्ध्वे तु त्र्यैलोक्यैश्वर्यदं ततः || 150 ||
7.m:
beneath it the letter 'ū' called amṛta, situated on the boar, O twice-born;
above it ending in the letter 'o', then the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds, // 150

7.s:
viśvāpyāyasamāyuktamasyānte vinyasennamaḥ |
kṛṣṇavarṇadvayaṃ dadyātpiṅgalāya padaṃ tataḥ || 151 ||
7.d:
विश्वाप्यायसमायुक्तमस्यान्ते विन्यसेन्नमः |
कृष्णवर्णद्वयं दद्यात्पिङ्गलाय पदं ततः || 151 ||
7.m:
conjoined with viśvāpyāyā; at the end of this one should deposit 'namaḥ';
one should supply the two black letters, then the word 'piṅgalāya', // 151

7.s:
varāhāya padaṃ svāhā mantrassaptadaśākṣaraḥ |
śānti śrīpuṣṭimārogyaṃ kuryādāpyāyanaṃ smṛtam || 152 ||
7.d:
वराहाय पदं स्वाहा मन्त्रस्सप्तदशाक्षरः |
शान्ति श्रीपुष्टिमारोग्यं कुर्यादाप्यायनं स्मृतम् || 152 ||
7.m:
[then] the word 'varāhāya' [and] 'svāhā'; this is the seventeen-syllable mantra.
It produces peace, prosperity, nourishment, and health; it is taught as invigorating. // 152

7.s: goptavyaścaiva japtavyo vārāho bhuktimuktidaḥ |
7.d: गोप्तव्यश्चैव जप्तव्यो वाराहो भुक्तिमुक्तिदः |
7.m: The [mantra] of Varāha is to be guarded and recited, granting enjoyment and liberation.

7.s: [atha kaustubhādimantraḥ]
7.d: [अथ कौस्तुभादिमन्त्रः]
7.m: [Now the mantras of Kaustubha and others]

7.s: kaustubhādyaṅkuśāntāṃśca mantrānsarvānyathā śṛṇu || 153 ||
7.d: कौस्तुभाद्यङ्कुशान्तांश्च मन्त्रान्सर्वान्यथा शृणु || 153 ||
7.m: Now hear properly all the mantras beginning with Kaustubha and ending with the goad, // 153

7.s: yeṣāmanantavibhavaḥśaśvadārādhanādbhavet |
7.d: येषामनन्तविभवःशश्वदाराधनाद्भवेत् |
7.m: from the constant worship of which endless power arises.

7.s: [kaustubhamantraḥ]
7.d: [कौस्तुभमन्त्रः]

7.s: p. 53) kaustubho vyomasaṃbhinnaḥ paramātmā tato dvija || 154 ||
7.d: प्. 53) कौस्तुभो व्योमसंभिन्नः परमात्मा ततो द्विज || 154 ||
7.m: Kaustubha is pierced by the void; then the Supreme Self (paramātman), O twice-born; // 154

7.s:
ūrdhvādho'nalasaṃbhinnaṃ kuryāttadanu nārada |
akāreṇāṅkitaṃ taṃ vai taṃ tamūrjena kārayet || 155 ||
7.d:
ऊर्ध्वाधोऽनलसंभिन्नं कुर्यात्तदनु नारद |
अकारेणाङ्कितं तं वै तं तमूर्जेन कारयेत् || 155 ||
7.m:
one should then make it pierced above and below by fire, O Nārada;
marked with the letter 'a', one should indeed combine that with ūrj; // 155

7.s:
tato vyomānvito nemī namaskṛtiranantaram |
prabhātmane padaṃ dadyātkaustubhāya padaṃ tataḥ || 156 ||
7.d:
ततो व्योमान्वितो नेमी नमस्कृतिरनन्तरम् |
प्रभात्मने पदं दद्यात्कौस्तुभाय पदं ततः || 156 ||
7.m:
then nemi conjoined with the void; immediately after, the salutation [namaḥ];
one should supply the word 'prabhātmane', then the word 'kaustubhāya', // 156

7.s:
svāhānvitassapraṇavaḥ kaustubhasya prakīrttitaḥ |
ṣoḍaśārṇo mahāmantro nāsti tadyanna sādhayet || 157 ||
7.d:
स्वाहान्वितस्सप्रणवः कौस्तुभस्य प्रकीर्त्तितः |
षोडशार्णो महामन्त्रो नास्ति तद्यन्न साधयेत् || 157 ||
7.m:
accompanied by 'svāhā' along with the praṇava: [this] is proclaimed as [the mantra] of Kaustubha.
It is a great sixteen-syllable mantra; there is nothing which it may not accomplish. // 157

7.s: [mālāmantraḥ]
7.d: [मालामन्त्रः]

7.s:
proddharetpraṇavānte tu dhareśaṃ tadadho nyaset |
tṛptisaṃjñaṃ ca tasyādho varuṇaṃ viniveśya ca || 158 ||
7.d:
प्रोद्धरेत्प्रणवान्ते तु धरेशं तदधो न्यसेत् |
तृप्तिसंज्ञं च तस्याधो वरुणं विनिवेश्य च || 158 ||
7.m:
At the end of the praṇava one should extract dhareśa, and place underneath it
that named tṛpti, and having placed Varuṇa beneath it, // 158

7.s:
māyāvyomānvitaḥ piṇḍo namaskārasamanvitaḥ |
sthalavarṇadvayaṃ dadyājjalodbhūtapadaṃ tataḥ || 159 ||
7.d:
मायाव्योमान्वितः पिण्डो नमस्कारसमन्वितः |
स्थलवर्णद्वयं दद्याज्जलोद्भूतपदं ततः || 159 ||
7.m:
the conjunct syllable conjoined with māyā and the void, accompanied by the salutation [namaḥ];
one should supply the two land-letters, then the word 'jalodbhūta', // 159

7.s:
bhūṣite vanamāle svāhā sametaṃ padaṃ tataḥ |
ekonaviṃśavarṇastu mālāmantra udāhṛtaḥ || 160 ||
7.d:
भूषिते वनमाले स्वाहा समेतं पदं ततः |
एकोनविंशवर्णस्तु मालामन्त्र उदाहृतः || 160 ||
7.m:
then the word 'bhūṣite vanamāle' together with 'svāhā';
the nineteen-syllable garland-mantra has been declared, // 160

7.s: abhīṣṭasiddhido vipra nityamārādhakasya ca |
7.d: अभीष्टसिद्धिदो विप्र नित्यमाराधकस्य च |
7.m: bestowing the attainment of desires, O vipra, for the perpetual worshipper.

7.s: [padmamantraḥ]
7.d: [पद्ममन्त्रः]

7.s: praṇavasyāvasāne tu vāmanākhyaṃ niyojayet || 161 ||
7.d: प्रणवस्यावसाने तु वामनाख्यं नियोजयेत् || 161 ||
7.m: At the end of the praṇava, one should join that named vāmana, // 161

7.s:
somākhyaṃ tadadho yojya uddāmopari saṃsthitaḥ |
tryailokyaiśvaryadopetaḥ piṇḍo natisamanvitaḥ || 162 ||
7.d:
सोमाख्यं तदधो योज्य उद्दामोपरि संस्थितः |
त्र्यैलोक्यैश्वर्यदोपेतः पिण्डो नतिसमन्वितः || 162 ||
7.m:
and having joined that named soma beneath it, situated upon uddāma,
the conjunct syllable endowed with the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds, accompanied by obeisance [namaḥ]; // 162

7.s:
śrīnivāsapadaṃ dadyātpadmāya tadanantaram |
svāhānvitastu padmasya mantraḥ syāttridaśākṣaraḥ || 163 ||
7.d:
श्रीनिवासपदं दद्यात्पद्माय तदनन्तरम् |
स्वाहान्वितस्तु पद्मस्य मन्त्रः स्यात्त्रिदशाक्षरः || 163 ||
7.m:
one should supply the word 'śrīnivāsa', immediately after that 'padmāya';
accompanied by 'svāhā', the mantra of the lotus shall have thirteen syllables; // 163

7.s: prayacchatyatulāṃ bhūtiṃ bhaktānāmakṣayāṃ dvija |
7.d: प्रयच्छत्यतुलां भूतिं भक्तानामक्षयां द्विज |
7.m: it grants peerless and imperishable power to devotees, O twice-born.

7.s: [śaṅkhamantraḥ]
7.d: [शङ्खमन्त्रः]

7.s: praṇavaṃ pūrvamādāya paramātmānamuddharet || 164 ||
7.d: प्रणवं पूर्वमादाय परमात्मानमुद्धरेत् || 164 ||
7.m: First taking the praṇava, one should extract the Supreme Self (paramātman); // 164

7.s:
bhedayedbhuvanāntena tryailokyaiśvaryadena tu |
namaskāraṃ kramaṃ kuryādetadevākṣaraṃ tridhā || 165 ||
7.d:
भेदयेद्भुवनान्तेन त्र्यैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेन तु |
नमस्कारं क्रमं कुर्यादेतदेवाक्षरं त्रिधा || 165 ||
7.m:
one should pierce it with the end of the worlds and with the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds;
one should make the salutation in order; this very syllable three times, // 165

7.s:
mahāśaṅkhāya ca svāhā śaṅkhākhyastridaśākṣaraḥ |
yantraśśubhataraḥ prokto dhiyaṃ vidyāṃ prayacchati || 166 ||
7.d:
महाशङ्खाय च स्वाहा शङ्खाख्यस्त्रिदशाक्षरः |
यन्त्रश्शुभतरः प्रोक्तो धियं विद्यां प्रयच्छति || 166 ||
7.m:
'mahāśaṅkhāya' and 'svāhā': the [mantra] named conch has thirteen syllables;
this most auspicious yantra is declared; it bestows intellect and knowledge. // 166

7.s: p. 54) [cakramantraḥ]
7.d: प्. 54) [चक्रमन्त्रः]

7.s:
śāśvataḥ praṇavānte tu rārūḍhassiddhikṛdyutaḥ |
tādṛśaścāpi kamalaḥ praphullanayanastataḥ || 167 ||
7.d:
शाश्वतः प्रणवान्ते तु रारूढस्सिद्धिकृद्युतः |
तादृशश्चापि कमलः प्रफुल्लनयनस्ततः || 167 ||
7.m:
At the end of the praṇava is śāśvata mounted on 'ra', joined with siddhikṛt;
and likewise kamala, then praphullanayana; // 167

7.s:
kevalassyāttadante tu hlādassvaravivarjitaḥ |
paramātmānamuddhṛtya aṅkuśādyena saṃyutam || 168 ||
7.d:
केवलस्स्यात्तदन्ते तु ह्लादस्स्वरविवर्जितः |
परमात्मानमुद्धृत्य अङ्कुशाद्येन संयुतम् || 168 ||
7.m:
at its end should be alone hlāda devoid of vowels;
extracting the Supreme Self (paramātman), conjoined with the first of the goads, // 168

7.s:
aurvāntenāṅkitaṃ mūrdhnā tadante yojayennamaḥ |
phaṭkāratritayaṃ paścādviṣṇucakrāya vai padam || 169 ||
7.d:
और्वान्तेनाङ्कितं मूर्ध्ना तदन्ते योजयेन्नमः |
फट्कारत्रितयं पश्चाद्विष्णुचक्राय वै पदम् || 169 ||
7.m:
marked at the top with the end of Aurva, at its end one should join 'namaḥ';
afterward the triad of 'phaṭ', and indeed the word 'viṣṇucakrāya', // 169

7.s:
svāhārṇadvitayaṃ cānte cākraṃ saptadaśākṣaram |
ardhākṣaracatuṣkena yuktaṃ sarvamidaṃ jagat || 170 ||
7.d:
स्वाहार्णद्वितयं चान्ते चाक्रं सप्तदशाक्षरम् |
अर्धाक्षरचतुष्केन युक्तं सर्वमिदं जगत् || 170 ||
7.m:
and at the end the pair of syllables 'svāhā': the discus [mantra] has seventeen syllables;
endowed with four half-syllables, this entire universe [is pervaded by it]. // 170

7.s: [gadāmantraḥ]
7.d: [गदामन्त्रः]

7.s:
uddharetpraṇavaṃ tvādau tadante ca gadādharam |
pradhānoparisaṃsthaṃ ca tadadhaḥ puruṣeśvaram || 171 ||
7.d:
उद्धरेत्प्रणवं त्वादौ तदन्ते च गदाधरम् |
प्रधानोपरिसंस्थं च तदधः पुरुषेश्वरम् || 171 ||
7.m:
One should extract the praṇava first, and at its end the mace-bearer (gadādhara);
and situated upon pradhāna, and beneath it puruṣeśvara; // 171

7.s:
jagadyoniyutaṃ mūrdhnā vyomeśamupari nyaset |
tato jakāramādāya viṣṭaropari saṃsthitam || 172 ||
7.d:
जगद्योनियुतं मूर्ध्ना व्योमेशमुपरि न्यसेत् |
ततो जकारमादाय विष्टरोपरि संस्थितम् || 172 ||
7.m:
conjoined at the crown with the womb of the world, one should place the Lord of the Void above;
then taking the letter 'ja', situated upon the seat (viṣṭara), // 172

7.s:
visargādyena saṃbhinnaṃ namaskāravibhūṣitam |
sahasrāśrigade svāhā gadākhyastridaśākṣaraḥ || 173 ||
7.d:
विसर्गाद्येन संभिन्नं नमस्कारविभूषितम् |
सहस्राश्रिगदे स्वाहा गदाख्यस्त्रिदशाक्षरः || 173 ||
7.m:
pierced by the first of the visargas, adorned with the salutation [namaḥ];
'sahasrāśrigade svāhā': the [mantra] named mace has thirteen syllables; // 173

7.s: abhīṣṭado mahāmantro vighnajālakṣayaṃkaraḥ |
7.d: अभीष्टदो महामन्त्रो विघ्नजालक्षयंकरः |
7.m: the great mantra grants desires and brings about the destruction of the net of obstacles.

7.s: [garuḍamantraḥ]
7.d: [गरुडमन्त्रः]

7.s: praṇavaṃ pūrvamādāya ananteśamataḥ param || 174 ||
7.d: प्रणवं पूर्वमादाय अनन्तेशमतः परम् || 174 ||
7.m: First taking the praṇava, and after this the Lord of Ananta (ananteśa), // 174

7.s:
ūrdhvā'dhonalasaṃbhinnaṃ satyādyaṃ tadadho nyaset |
tryailaukyaiśvaryadā dānatrailokyaiśvaryadena ca || 175 ||
7.d:
ऊर्ध्वाऽधोनलसंभिन्नं सत्याद्यं तदधो न्यसेत् |
त्र्यैलौक्यैश्वर्यदा दानत्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेन च || 175 ||
7.m:
pierced above and below by fire; one should place the first of satya beneath it;
with the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds and the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds by gifts, // 175

7.s:
śirasā bhūṣitaṃ kuryādvedātmānamathoddharet |
so'pyananteśavatkāryassvaravyañjanabhūṣitaḥ || 176 ||
7.d:
शिरसा भूषितं कुर्याद्वेदात्मानमथोद्धरेत् |
सोऽप्यनन्तेशवत्कार्यस्स्वरव्यञ्जनभूषितः || 176 ||
7.m:
one should make it adorned on the head, and then extract the Self of the Vedas (vedātman);
that too is to be made like ananteśa, adorned with vowels and consonants; // 176

7.s:
sṛṣṭikṛtsahitaṃ bhūyaḥ kūṭaṃ dadyānnamontagam |
padañcānte'nantagate svāhāntaṃ garuḍāya ca || 177 ||
7.d:
सृष्टिकृत्सहितं भूयः कूटं दद्यान्नमोन्तगम् |
पदञ्चान्तेऽनन्तगते स्वाहान्तं गरुडाय च || 177 ||
7.m:
again one should supply the kūṭa accompanied by the creator of emission (sṛṣṭikṛt), ending in 'namaḥ';
and at the end the word 'anantagate', and 'garuḍāya' ending in 'svāhā'. // 177

7.s:
saptadaśākṣaro mantraḥ kīrttito garuḍasya ca |
yasya saṃsmaraṇātsamyaksamastāpallayaṃ vrajet || 178 ||
7.d:
सप्तदशाक्षरो मन्त्रः कीर्त्तितो गरुडस्य च |
यस्य संस्मरणात्सम्यक्समस्तापल्लयं व्रजेत् || 178 ||
7.m:
The mantra of Garuḍa is proclaimed to have seventeen syllables;
by whose proper remembrance all misfortune goes to dissolution. // 178

7.s: p. 55) [pāśamantraḥ]

ādāyādau tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ tasyārūḍhaṃ ca raṃ nyaset |
vyomānandasametaṃ ca kaḍhḍhakaḍhḍhapadaṃ tataḥ || 179 ||
7.d:
आदायादौ तु वैकुण्ठं तस्यारूढं च रं न्यसेत् |
व्योमानन्दसमेतं च कढ्ढकढ्ढपदं ततः || 179 ||
7.m:
First taking vaikuṇṭha, one should place 'ra' mounted upon it,
and accompanied by the bliss of the void (vyomānanda); then the word 'kaḍhḍhakaḍhḍha', // 179

7.s:
dhārādharadvayopetaṃ varapāśāya vai padam |
svāhā caiva tu tasyānte kuryāt saptadaśākṣaraḥ || 180 ||
7.d:
धाराधरद्वयोपेतं वरपाशाय वै पदम् |
स्वाहा चैव तु तस्यान्ते कुर्यात् सप्तदशाक्षरः || 180 ||
7.m:
endowed with two cloud-letters (dhārādhara), indeed the word 'varapāśāya',
and at its end one should make 'svāhā': it has seventeen syllables; // 180

7.s: sa tārako hyayaṃ mantraḥ pāśākhyaḥ kṣiprasiddhikṛt |
7.d: स तारको ह्ययं मन्त्रः पाशाख्यः क्षिप्रसिद्धिकृत् |
7.m: this mantra named noose is indeed a savior, bringing about swift attainment.

7.s: [aṅkuśamantraḥ]
7.d: [अङ्कुशमन्त्रः]

7.s: praṇavānte tataḥ kuryādvirāṭsaṃjñaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ || 181 ||
7.d: प्रणवान्ते ततः कुर्याद्विराट्संज्ञं तदूर्ध्वतः || 181 ||
7.m: Then, after the praṇava, one should place the one named Virāṭ; above that, // 181

7.s:
vyomaviprānalopetaṃ kamalaṃ tadanantaram |
ṛtadhāmoparisthaṃ ca vyoma tasyopari nyaset || 182 ||
7.d:
व्योमविप्रानलोपेतं कमलं तदनन्तरम् |
ऋतधामोपरिस्थं च व्योम तस्योपरि न्यसेत् || 182 ||
7.m: immediately following, lotus (kamala) endowed with ether (vyoma), brāhmaṇa (vipra), and fire (anala); / and one should place ether resting above the abode of Ṛta (ṛtadhāman) upon that; // 182

7.s:
padaṃ niśitaghoṇāya aṅkuśāya padaṃ tataḥ |
svāhānvitastripañcārṇo mantrarāḍaṅkuśasya ca || 183 ||
7.d:
पदं निशितघोणाय अङ्कुशाय पदं ततः |
स्वाहान्वितस्त्रिपञ्चार्णो मन्त्रराडङ्कुशस्य च || 183 ||
7.m: then the word 'niśitaghoṇāya', then the word 'aṅkuśāya', / endowed with 'svāhā': the fifteen-syllabled king of mantras of the goad // 183

7.s: śīghrakarmakaraḥ prokto nityamicchāntalakṣaṇaḥ |
7.d: शीघ्रकर्मकरः प्रोक्तो नित्यमिच्छान्तलक्षणः |
7.m: is declared to be swift in accomplishing acts, constantly characterized by the limit of desire.

7.s: [upāṅgapañcakanirūpaṇārambhaḥ]
7.d: [उपाङ्गपञ्चकनिरूपणारम्भः]
7.m: [Beginning of the Description of the Five Minor Angas]

7.s: upāṅgapañcakaṃ cātha satyādīnāṃ hi vācakam || 184 ||
7.d: उपाङ्गपञ्चकं चाथ सत्यादीनां हि वाचकम् || 184 ||
7.m: And now the five minor aṅgas, which indeed express Satya and the others, // 184

7.s:
brahmasvarūpamamalaṃ vyāpakaṃ sarvasiddhidam |
samyakśṛṇuṣva devarṣe sarahasyaṃ vadāmi te || 185 ||
7.d:
ब्रह्मस्वरूपममलं व्यापकं सर्वसिद्धिदम् |
सम्यक्शृणुष्व देवर्षे सरहस्यं वदामि ते || 185 ||
7.m: having the nature of Brahman, immaculate, all-pervading, granting all attainments: / listen carefully, divine sage; I will tell you [them] with their secret. // 185

7.s:
yadvinyāsātsādhakasya siddho vai yatra kutracit |
phalado mantramūrtissyādacirāttanmayasya ca || 186 ||
7.d:
यद्विन्यासात्साधकस्य सिद्धो वै यत्र कुत्रचित् |
फलदो मन्त्रमूर्तिस्स्यादचिरात्तन्मयस्य च || 186 ||
7.m: From whose nyāsa the practitioner becomes perfected anywhere whatsoever; / the mantra-body will before long grant fruit to one who has become identified with it. // 186

7.s:
syāddeveśasamo mantrī tannyāsādvyāptibhāvanāt |
yāgāhutasya mantrasya śaktyaṅgādyāvṛtasya ca || 187 ||
7.d:
स्याद्देवेशसमो मन्त्री तन्न्यासाद्व्याप्तिभावनात् |
यागाहुतस्य मन्त्रस्य शक्त्यङ्गाद्यावृतस्य च || 187 ||
7.m: From its nyāsa and from contemplating [its] pervasiveness, the mantrin becomes equal to the Lord of gods. / For the mantra summoned in sacrifice and surrounded by [mantras of] the power, aṅgas, and the rest, // 187

7.s:
samyaṅnirodhasiddhyarthaṃ yojanīyaṃ sadaiva hi |
tathātmanaḥ kṛte nyāse nyaste copāṅgapañcake || 188 ||
7.d:
सम्यङ्निरोधसिद्ध्यर्थं योजनीयं सदैव हि |
तथात्मनः कृते न्यासे न्यस्ते चोपाङ्गपञ्चके || 188 ||
7.m: it should always be applied for the sake of attaining complete restraint. / Likewise, when nyāsa is made on oneself and the five minor aṅgas are placed, // 188

7.s: śaśvatsyāccittavṛttīnāṃ vikṣiptānāṃ ca saṃyamaḥ |
7.d: शश्वत्स्याच्चित्तवृत्तीनां विक्षिप्तानां च संयमः |
7.m: there is constant restraint of distracted mental fluctuations.

7.s: [satyādyupāṅgapañcakabījamantraḥ]
7.d: [सत्याद्युपाङ्गपञ्चकबीजमन्त्रः]
7.m: [The Seed-Mantras of the Five Minor Angas, Satya and the Others]

7.s: turyātītātmasaṃjño yo vargaḥ pañcārṇabhūṣitaḥ || 189 ||
7.d: तुर्यातीतात्मसंज्ञो यो वर्गः पञ्चार्णभूषितः || 189 ||
7.m: The class named 'whose self transcends the fourth [state]', adorned with five phonemes: // 189

7.s:
vilomena suparṇādyaṃ sthāpayitvā niyojya ca |
ādyaṃ vai bhūdharākhyena ūrjasaṃjñena cāparam || 190 ||
7.d:
विलोमेन सुपर्णाद्यं स्थापयित्वा नियोज्य च |
आद्यं वै भूधराख्येन ऊर्जसंज्ञेन चापरम् || 190 ||
7.m: having placed and applied the one beginning with Suparṇa in reverse order— / the first with the one named mountain-bearer (bhūdhara), the second with the one named strength (ūrjas), // 190

7.s:
lokeśena tṛtīyaṃ tu turyaṃ sākṣācca viṣṇunā |
p. 56) pañcamaṃ tvādidevena vyāpī sarvatra mūrdhani || 191 ||
7.d:
लोकेशेन तृतीयं तु तुर्यं साक्षाच्च विष्णुना |
प्. 56) पञ्चमं त्वादिदेवेन व्यापी सर्वत्र मूर्धनि || 191 ||
7.m: the third with the lord of the world (lokeśa), the fourth directly with Viṣṇu, / and the fifth with the primal god (ādideva)—is all-pervading everywhere on the head. // 191

7.s:
samastena dvijoṅkāre ekaikaṃ madhyataḥ kṣipet |
pañcakaṃ pañcasaṃjñasya bījabhūtamidaṃ smṛtam || 192 ||
7.d:
समस्तेन द्विजोङ्कारे एकैकं मध्यतः क्षिपेत् |
पञ्चकं पञ्चसंज्ञस्य बीजभूतमिदं स्मृतम् || 192 ||
7.m: O twice-born, into the complete oṃkāra one should insert each one in the middle; / this is remembered as the group of five that constitutes the seed of the fivefold. // 192

7.s:
saṃsthitaṃ tu paratvena etasmātprabhavanti te |
saukṣmyena vyāpakatvena dhātṛtvena tu nārada || 193 ||
7.d:
संस्थितं तु परत्वेन एतस्मात्प्रभवन्ति ते |
सौक्ष्म्येन व्यापकत्वेन धातृत्वेन तु नारद || 193 ||
7.m: Existing, however, in transcendence, they arise from this / through subtlety, pervasiveness, and sustaining power, O Nārada. // 193

7.s:
ekaikasminsamūhena pañcaite saṃvyavasthitāḥ |
praśāntahutabhugrūpāḥ paramantrasahoditāḥ || 194 ||
7.d:
एकैकस्मिन्समूहेन पञ्चैते संव्यवस्थिताः |
प्रशान्तहुतभुग्रूपाः परमन्त्रसहोदिताः || 194 ||
7.m: These five are established as a group within each one, / having the form of extinguished fire, arising together with the supreme mantra. // 194

7.s:
ādidevasya vai viṣṇoḥ satyākhyasya mahātmanaḥ |
mahāvibhavasaṃjñasya prathamo mantrarāṭ smṛtaḥ || 195 ||
7.d:
आदिदेवस्य वै विष्णोः सत्याख्यस्य महात्मनः |
महाविभवसंज्ञस्य प्रथमो मन्त्रराट् स्मृतः || 195 ||
7.m: Of the primal god, the great-souled Viṣṇu named Satya / and called 'of great majesty' (mahāvibhava), the first king of mantras is remembered. // 195

7.s:
vāsudevasya ca vibhordvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
saṅkarṣaṇasya ca tato bījamuktaṃ tṛtīyakam || 196 ||
7.d:
वासुदेवस्य च विभोर्द्वितीयः परिकीर्तितः |
सङ्कर्षणस्य च ततो बीजमुक्तं तृतीयकम् || 196 ||
7.m: The second is proclaimed as of the all-pervading Vāsudeva; / then the third seed is declared to belong to Saṅkarṣaṇa. // 196

7.s:
caturthaṃ vipraśārdūla pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ |
upāṅgaṃ pañcamaṃ viddhi aniruddhātmano vibhoḥ || 197 ||
7.d:
चतुर्थं विप्रशार्दूल प्रद्युम्नस्य महात्मनः |
उपाङ्गं पञ्चमं विद्धि अनिरुद्धात्मनो विभोः || 197 ||
7.m: Know the fourth, O tiger among brāhmaṇas, to belong to the great-souled Pradyumna, / and the fifth minor aṅga to belong to the all-pervading Lord Aniruddha. // 197

7.s:
satyādyamaniruddhāntaṃ pavitraṃ mantrapañcakam |
upāṅgasaṃjñaṃ yo vetti sa satyaṃ vetti nānyathā || 198 ||
7.d:
सत्याद्यमनिरुद्धान्तं पवित्रं मन्त्रपञ्चकम् |
उपाङ्गसंज्ञं यो वेत्ति स सत्यं वेत्ति नान्यथा || 198 ||
7.m: Whoever knows the pure group of five mantras beginning with Satya and ending with Aniruddha, / named the minor aṅgas, knows the truth, not otherwise. // 198

7.s:
iti sūkṣmasvarūpasya vibhormantravarasya ca |
tryakṣarasya dvibījādyaṃ vyāpakasyāmalasya ca || 199 ||
7.d:
इति सूक्ष्मस्वरूपस्य विभोर्मन्त्रवरस्य च |
त्र्यक्षरस्य द्विबीजाद्यं व्यापकस्यामलस्य च || 199 ||
7.m: Thus, of the supreme mantra of the all-pervading Lord of subtle nature, / which has three syllables and begins with two seeds, and is all-pervading and immaculate, // 199

7.s:
mūrttimantrāditaḥ prokto mantrasaṃjño(gho ?) yathākramam |
abhīpsitapradassamyagbhaktānāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 200 ||
7.d:
मूर्त्तिमन्त्रादितः प्रोक्तो मन्त्रसंज्ञो(घो ?) यथाक्रमम् |
अभीप्सितप्रदस्सम्यग्भक्तानां भावितात्मनाम् || 200 ||
7.m: the designation of mantras has been declared in proper order, beginning with the icon-mantra, / fully granting the desired [fruit] to devotees of cultivated self. // 200

7.s:
atrāsakto bhava mune yajaitatpūjayasva ca |
vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena vāñchitaṃ yatprayachati || 201 ||
7.d:
अत्रासक्तो भव मुने यजैतत्पूजयस्व च |
विधिना शास्त्रदृष्टेन वाञ्छितं यत्प्रयछति || 201 ||
7.m: Be devoted to this, O sage: offer this and worship [it] / according to the injunction seen in the scripture, for it grants what is desired. // 201

7.s: nāradaḥ
7.d: नारदः

7.s:
sthūlasūkṣmavibhāgena eṣa mantraḥ paro mayā |
jñātaḥ parasvarūpeṇa na jñātaḥ parameśvara || 202 ||
7.d:
स्थूलसूक्ष्मविभागेन एष मन्त्रः परो मया |
ज्ञातः परस्वरूपेण न ज्ञातः परमेश्वर || 202 ||
7.m: By division into gross and subtle, this supreme mantra / has been understood by me; it has not been understood in its supreme nature, O Supreme Lord. // 202

7.s:
purā'syaiva parā mūrttirmāntrī saṃsūcitā tvayā |
samācakṣva samāsena yadi sānugraho'si me || 203 ||
7.d:
पुराऽस्यैव परा मूर्त्तिर्मान्त्री संसूचिता त्वया |
समाचक्ष्व समासेन यदि सानुग्रहोऽसि मे || 203 ||
7.m: Formerly, this very supreme sonic form was indicated by you; / explain it concisely if you have grace toward me. // 203

7.s: [mantrasya parasvarūpanirūpaṇam]
7.d: [मन्त्रस्य परस्वरूपनिरूपणम्]
7.m: [Determination of the Supreme Nature of the Mantra]

7.s: śrībhagavān
7.d: श्रीभगवान्

7.s:
mūrtimantraṃ vinā vipra yo mantraḥ prāgudīritaḥ |
p. 57) prabhavādyo visargāntassudhāsandohavigrahaḥ || 204 ||
7.d:
मूर्तिमन्त्रं विना विप्र यो मन्त्रः प्रागुदीरितः |
प्. 57) प्रभवाद्यो विसर्गान्तस्सुधासन्दोहविग्रहः || 204 ||
7.m: Apart from the icon-mantra, O brāhmaṇa, the mantra that was uttered previously, / beginning with the source and ending with visarga, having a body of abundant nectar, // 204

7.s:
sarvadevamayaśśuddhassarvādhvātmā paraḥ prabhuḥ |
samastaśaktidehastu bhārūpassūkṣmarūpadhṛt || 205 ||
7.d:
सर्वदेवमयश्शुद्धस्सर्वाध्वात्मा परः प्रभुः |
