समस्तशक्तिदेहस्तु भारूपस्सूक्ष्मरूपधृत् || 205 ||
7.m: consisting of all deities, pure, the self of all paths, the supreme sovereign, / having a body of all powers, having the form of light, bearing a subtle form, // 205

7.s:
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāmicchayā sthūlatāṃ gataḥ |
adhiṣṭhitassa vibhunā pareṇālokarūpiṇā || 206 ||
7.d:
संसारार्णवमग्नानामिच्छया स्थूलतां गतः |
अधिष्ठितस्स विभुना परेणालोकरूपिणा || 206 ||
7.m: has reached grossness by [his] will for those immersed in the ocean of transmigratory existence, / presided over by the supreme, all-pervading Lord whose form is light, // 206

7.s:
susūkṣmeṇāvigraheṇa sadālokarasātmanā |
aṇīyāṃsamaṇorviddhi mantraśaktiḥ parā hi sā || 207 ||
7.d:
सुसूक्ष्मेणाविग्रहेण सदालोकरसात्मना |
अणीयांसमणोर्विद्धि मन्त्रशक्तिः परा हि सा || 207 ||
7.m: by means of the extremely subtle, bodiless self of the essence of perpetual light. / Know it to be smaller than the smallest, for that is the supreme mantra-power. // 207

7.s:
upādhirahitaṃ śuddhaṃ matsāmīpyaphalapradam |
taccharīraṃ hi me mantraṃ paraṃ paraphalapradam || 208 ||
7.d:
उपाधिरहितं शुद्धं मत्सामीप्यफलप्रदम् |
तच्छरीरं हि मे मन्त्रं परं परफलप्रदम् || 208 ||
7.m: Deceitless, pure, granting the fruit of proximity to me, / that body of mine is indeed the supreme mantra, granting the supreme fruit. // 208

7.s:
[parasūkṣmasthūlarūpeṇa satāṃ mantrāṇāṃ saṃvinmayāt sarvataḥ
paratarātprādurbhāvanirūpaṇam]
7.d:
[परसूक्ष्मस्थूलरूपेण सतां मन्त्राणां संविन्मयात् सर्वतः
परतरात्प्रादुर्भावनिरूपणम्]
7.m: [Determination of the Manifestation of Mantras Existing in Supreme, Subtle, and Gross Forms from the Supreme beyond All, Consisting of Consciousness]

7.s:
nirvikāraśarīraṃ ca yāgākhyaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam |
turyātparaṃ padādasmāt jñeyākhyaṃ paramaṃ mama || 209 ||
7.d:
निर्विकारशरीरं च यागाख्यं परमं स्मृतम् |
तुर्यात्परं पदादस्मात् ज्ञेयाख्यं परमं मम || 209 ||
7.m: And that immutable body, designated as sacrifice, is remembered as supreme; / beyond the fourth state, from this abode, my [body] is designated as the supreme object of knowledge, // 209

7.s:
grāhyagrāhakanirmuktaṃ saṃvidānandalakṣaṇam |
tanmayāstaṃ prapaśyanti viśuddhenāntarātmanā || 210 ||
7.d:
ग्राह्यग्राहकनिर्मुक्तं संविदानन्दलक्षणम् |
तन्मयास्तं प्रपश्यन्ति विशुद्धेनान्तरात्मना || 210 ||
7.m: free from apprehended and apprehender, characterized by consciousness and bliss; / those who are composed of it behold it with a completely purified inner self, // 210

7.s:
yataḥ paraḥ prabhavati bhāḥśabdākhyaśca mantrarāṭ |
yatra saptapadārthaṃ tu vijñātaṃ vyaktimeti ca || 211 ||
7.d:
यतः परः प्रभवति भाःशब्दाख्यश्च मन्त्रराट् |
यत्र सप्तपदार्थं तु विज्ञातं व्यक्तिमेति च || 211 ||
7.m: from which the supreme king of mantras, designated by the word 'light' (bhāḥ), arises, / in which the seven ontological categories, when understood, become manifest, // 211

7.s:
yatra vai varṇarūpeṇa sarve lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
pradhānakāraṇānāṃ yaddvābhyāṃ yatparatassthitam || 212 ||
7.d:
यत्र वै वर्णरूपेण सर्वे लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः |
प्रधानकारणानां यद्द्वाभ्यां यत्परतस्स्थितम् || 212 ||
7.m: in which indeed all worlds are established in the form of phonemes; / which stands beyond the two material causes (pradhānakāraṇa). // 212

7.s:
mantrotpattikrameṇaiva yādṛksaṃsthaṃ tathā śṛṇu |
anukrameṇa saṃyojya sṛṣṭinyāyena nārada || 213 ||
7.d:
मन्त्रोत्पत्तिक्रमेणैव यादृक्संस्थं तथा शृणु |
अनुक्रमेण संयोज्य सृष्टिन्यायेन नारद || 213 ||
7.m: Hear how it is situated precisely in the order of the origin of mantras, / having joined them in succession according to the rule of creation, O Nārada: // 213

7.s:
saptakañcaiva varṇānāṃ saṃvibhaktivibhāvitam |
sūryasomāgnirūpaṃ tu pradhānapuruṣeśvaram || 214 ||
7.d:
सप्तकञ्चैव वर्णानां संविभक्तिविभावितम् |
सूर्यसोमाग्निरूपं तु प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरम् || 214 ||
7.m: a heptad of phonemes differentiated by case-terminations, / having the forms of sun, moon, and fire, [consisting of] pradhāna, puruṣa, and the Lord, // 214

7.s:
aśeṣabhuvanādhāraṃ tryailokyaiśvaryadāyakam |
eṣa varṇamayaḥ piṇḍaḥ paro me mantravigrahaḥ || 215 ||
7.d:
अशेषभुवनाधारं त्र्यैलोक्यैश्वर्यदायकम् |
एष वर्णमयः पिण्डः परो मे मन्त्रविग्रहः || 215 ||
7.m: the support of all worlds, granting sovereignty over the three worlds: / this aggregate consisting of phonemes is my supreme mantra-body. // 215

7.s:
bhāvagrāhyamanaupamyamaprakāśyamidaṃ mune |
prakāśito mayā te'dya jīvabhūto hi mantrarāṭ || 216 ||
7.d:
भावग्राह्यमनौपम्यमप्रकाश्यमिदं मुने |
प्रकाशितो मया तेऽद्य जीवभूतो हि मन्त्रराट् || 216 ||
7.m: To be grasped through contemplation, peerless, not to be revealed, O sage: / this king of mantras, which is indeed the soul [of all mantras], has been revealed by me to you today. // 216

7.s:
samastamantracakrasya sāmarthyajanako hi yaḥ |
mantreṇa tena vidhinā otaprotavyavasthayā || 217 ||
7.d:
समस्तमन्त्रचक्रस्य सामर्थ्यजनको हि यः |
मन्त्रेण तेन विधिना ओतप्रोतव्यवस्थया || 217 ||
7.m: For it is that which generates efficacy for the entire circle of mantras; / by that mantra, in accordance with the rule, by way of warp and woof, // 217

7.s:
adhiṣṭhito'pi bījo vai nirmalasphaṭiko yathā |
p. 58) nirmalenāmbareṇaiva dṛśyādṛśyena vai tathā || 218 ||
7.d:
अधिष्ठितोऽपि बीजो वै निर्मलस्फटिको यथा |
प्. 58) निर्मलेनाम्बरेणैव दृश्यादृश्येन वै तथा || 218 ||
7.m: the seed is indeed presided over, like a stainless crystal / by a stainless sky, visible and invisible as well; // 218

7.s: vyāptāstenāpare mantrāstathaiva paribhāvitāḥ |
7.d: व्याप्तास्तेनापरे मन्त्रास्तथैव परिभाविताः |
7.m: the other mantras are pervaded by it, and in that very way they are realized.

7.s: nāradaḥ
7.d: नारदः

7.s: mantraḥ(ḥ ?)sṛṣṭikrameṇaiva yathāvannoditastvayā || 219 ||
7.d: मन्त्रः(ः ?)सृष्टिक्रमेणैव यथावन्नोदितस्त्वया || 219 ||
7.m: The mantra was not properly declared by you according to the order of creation. // 219

7.s:
tamādiśasva yenādya kṛtakṛtyo bhavāmyaham |
yo'vikāraḥ paraśśuddhassthitassaṃvedanātpare || 220 ||
7.d:
तमादिशस्व येनाद्य कृतकृत्यो भवाम्यहम् |
योऽविकारः परश्शुद्धस्स्थितस्संवेदनात्परे || 220 ||
7.m: Instruct me on that, whereby I may accomplish my purpose today! / That which is immutable, supreme, pure, resting beyond consciousness— // 220

7.s: sa kathaṃ vyāpakaṃ brahma mantramūrtitvamāgataḥ |
7.d: स कथं व्यापकं ब्रह्म मन्त्रमूर्तित्वमागतः |
7.m: how has that all-pervading Brahman arrived at the state of a mantra-body?

7.s: [mantrasṛṣṭikramavivecanam]
7.d: [मन्त्रसृष्टिक्रमविवेचनम्]
7.m: [Examination of the Order of Creation of Mantras]

7.s: śrībhagavān
7.d: श्रीभगवान्

7.s: tasyaikāṃ paramāṃ śaktiṃ viddhi taddharmacāriṇīm || 221 ||
7.d: तस्यैकां परमां शक्तिं विद्धि तद्धर्मचारिणीम् || 221 ||
7.m: Know his one supreme power that acts in accordance with his nature, // 221

7.s:
yayopacaryate vipra sṛṣṭikṛtparameśvaraḥ |
bṛhmito yadbṛhatvena nityānandoditastathā || 222 ||
7.d:
ययोपचर्यते विप्र सृष्टिकृत्परमेश्वरः |
बृह्मितो यद्बृहत्वेन नित्यानन्दोदितस्तथा || 222 ||
7.m: by which, O brāhmaṇa, the Supreme Lord, maker of creation, is served; / augmented by whose greatness, he is likewise arisen in eternal bliss. // 222

7.s:
sarvadā nityaśuddho yastasyaitannopapadyate |
śaktyātmakassa bhagavānsarvaśaktyupabṛṃhitaḥ || 223 ||
7.d:
सर्वदा नित्यशुद्धो यस्तस्यैतन्नोपपद्यते |
शक्त्यात्मकस्स भगवान्सर्वशक्त्युपबृंहितः || 223 ||
7.m: For him who is eternally and ever pure, this does not apply; / the Lord consists of power and is augmented by all powers. // 223

7.s:
agnīṣomātmaketaṃ me (katvena ?) tulyakālaṃ hi mūrcchati |
prakāśastu bhavetsūrya āhlādassoma ucyate || 224 ||
7.d:
अग्नीषोमात्मकेतं मे (कत्वेन ?) तुल्यकालं हि मूर्च्छति |
प्रकाशस्तु भवेत्सूर्य आह्लादस्सोम उच्यते || 224 ||
7.m: Through consisting of Agni and Soma, he indeed expands simultaneously: / the sun is light, while the moon is called delight. // 224

7.s:
dvayorantargatā saṃvittābhyāmastodayāvapi |
pumānsa eva cinmūrttiragnīṣomamayo dvija || 225 ||
7.d:
द्वयोरन्तर्गता संवित्ताभ्यामस्तोदयावपि |
पुमान्स एव चिन्मूर्त्तिरग्नीषोममयो द्विज || 225 ||
7.m: Consciousness is situated within both; both setting and rising are through them. / That very puruṣa, whose form is consciousness, consists of Agni and Soma, O twice-born one. // 225

7.s:
yadagnirūpaṃ traiguṇyaṃ tacca vidyāmayaṃ tu vai |
cidātmā śalabho yadvattamadhiṣṭhāya tiṣṭhati || 226 ||
7.d:
यदग्निरूपं त्रैगुण्यं तच्च विद्यामयं तु वै |
चिदात्मा शलभो यद्वत्तमधिष्ठाय तिष्ठति || 226 ||
7.m: The nature of the three guṇas that is the form of Agni is indeed composed of knowledge. / The conscious self presides over it, standing like a moth. // 226

7.s:
tataḥ pradhānikīṃ bhūmiṃ tatrastho gamayetprabhuḥ |
puruṣeśvaratāṃ yāti kṣmātattve'dhiṣṭhite sati || 227 ||
7.d:
ततः प्रधानिकीं भूमिं तत्रस्थो गमयेत्प्रभुः |
पुरुषेश्वरतां याति क्ष्मातत्त्वेऽधिष्ठिते सति || 227 ||
7.m: From there, staying therein, the Lord may conduct [him] to the realm of pradhāna; / he attains lordship over the puruṣas once the earth-tattva has been presided over. // 227

7.s:
mameti vāsanāviddhastejasā paripūrayet |
tattvabṛndaṃ ca sakalaṃ trailokyaiśvaryatāṃ vrajet || 228 ||
7.d:
ममेति वासनाविद्धस्तेजसा परिपूरयेत् |
तत्त्वबृन्दं च सकलं त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यतां व्रजेत् || 228 ||
7.m: Pierced by the latent impression 'mine', he should fill [it] with splendor; / and having gone to lordship over the three worlds, [he presides over] the entire multitude of tattvas. // 228

7.s:
taijasādabhimānāttu tatastasmānnivartate |
svāṃ sthitiṃ samavāpnoti parāvasthāsthitiṃ punaḥ || 229 ||
7.d:
तैजसादभिमानात्तु ततस्तस्मान्निवर्तते |
स्वां स्थितिं समवाप्नोति परावस्थास्थितिं पुनः || 229 ||
7.m: Then, however, he turns away from the conceit born of taijasa; / he attains his own state, the state of the supreme condition once again. // 229

7.s:
gamayetsthūlarūpaṃ vā sūkṣmaṃ vā śaktiveṣṭitam |
dvayametatsamāśritya lokānugrahakṛdbhavet || 230 ||
7.d:
गमयेत्स्थूलरूपं वा सूक्ष्मं वा शक्तिवेष्टितम् |
द्वयमेतत्समाश्रित्य लोकानुग्रहकृद्भवेत् || 230 ||
7.m: He may conduct either to the gross form or to the subtle one enveloped by power; / having resorted to these two, he becomes a shower of grace to the worlds. // 230

7.s:
saṃprayacchati mokṣaṃ ca bhogaṃ rājyādikaṃ tu vā |
yattasmāttadupāsyo vai sthūlasūkṣmobhayātmakaḥ || 231 ||
7.d:
संप्रयच्छति मोक्षं च भोगं राज्यादिकं तु वा |
यत्तस्मात्तदुपास्यो वै स्थूलसूक्ष्मोभयात्मकः || 231 ||
7.m: He grants liberation, or enjoyment such as kingship and the like; / because of that, he, consisting of both gross and subtle, is indeed to be worshipped. // 231

7.s:
p. 59) tryakṣaraḥ paramo mantrastena saṃdīkṣayetkramāt |
bhavābdhipatitānbhaktānapareṇa tu (?)karhicit || 232 ||
7.d:
प्. 59) त्र्यक्षरः परमो मन्त्रस्तेन संदीक्षयेत्क्रमात् |
भवाब्धिपतितान्भक्तानपरेण तु (?)कर्हिचित् || 232 ||
7.m: With that supreme three-syllable mantra he should initiate in due order / the devotees fallen into the ocean of worldly existence, but never with another. // 232

7.s:
dīkṣitaḥ pāśamukto vai tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ |
piṇḍapātābhilāṣī vā yogaikagatamānasaḥ || 233 ||
7.d:
दीक्षितः पाशमुक्तो वै त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः |
पिण्डपाताभिलाषी वा योगैकगतमानसः || 233 ||
7.m: Initiated, freed from bonds, having abandoned all possessions, / or desiring the fall of the body, his mind fixed exclusively on yoga, // 233

7.s:
bhaktaḥ paro yojanīyassarvo nirvāṇabhāgatha |
tatsthaḥ paraṃ padaṃ yāti sthūlasūkṣmobhayena tat || 234 ||
7.d:
भक्तः परो योजनीयस्सर्वो निर्वाणभागथ |
तत्स्थः परं पदं याति स्थूलसूक्ष्मोभयेन तत् || 234 ||
7.m: the supreme devotee is to be united, completely partaking of nirvāṇa; / resting in it through both gross and subtle, he attains that supreme state. // 234

7.s:
vyaktimetyacirādvipra bhavināṃ bhāvitātmanām |
upalabdhau tu satyāṃ vai saṃyuktaṃ caiva viṣṇunā || 235 ||
7.d:
व्यक्तिमेत्यचिराद्विप्र भविनां भावितात्मनाम् |
उपलब्धौ तु सत्यां वै संयुक्तं चैव विष्णुना || 235 ||
7.m: It manifests before long, O brāhmaṇa, to worldly beings whose minds are cultivated; / and when realization occurs, he is indeed united with Viṣṇu. // 235

7.s:
japamānastu yo dhyāyetpañcasthānavinirgatam |
sṛṣṭikrameṇa tasyāśu sidhyate manasepsitam || 236 ||
7.d:
जपमानस्तु यो ध्यायेत्पञ्चस्थानविनिर्गतम् |
सृष्टिक्रमेण तस्याशु सिध्यते मनसेप्सितम् || 236 ||
7.m: He who recites and meditates upon it as having emerged from the five stations / in the order of creation, his heart's desire is quickly accomplished. // 236

7.s:
vigrahāduditaṃ vā'tha vyāptisattāsamanvitam |
yatpadādavatīrṇaṃ ca tadākramya punarbahiḥ || 237 ||
7.d:
विग्रहादुदितं वाऽथ व्याप्तिसत्तासमन्वितम् |
यत्पदादवतीर्णं च तदाक्रम्य पुनर्बहिः || 237 ||
7.m: Or having arisen from the body, endowed with pervasive existence, / and having traversed again outside the plane from which it descended, // 237

7.s:
vartate vigrahaṃ tyaktvā saṃsmṛto mokṣamṛcchati |
dṛśyādvāyorgatipathādvyāpārācca krameṇa tu || 238 ||
7.d:
वर्तते विग्रहं त्यक्त्वा संस्मृतो मोक्षमृच्छति |
दृश्याद्वायोर्गतिपथाद्व्यापाराच्च क्रमेण तु || 238 ||
7.m: he abides having abandoned the body; remembered, he attains liberation. / Gradually, from the perceptible course of the wind and from [sensory] activity, // 238

7.s:
saṃhṛtya hṛdayātsarvaṃ sthānānyūrdhve tathaiva ca |
tatsevāmṛtasaṃbhinnānnityābhyāsācca nārada || 239 ||
7.d:
संहृत्य हृदयात्सर्वं स्थानान्यूर्ध्वे तथैव च |
तत्सेवामृतसंभिन्नान्नित्याभ्यासाच्च नारद || 239 ||
7.m: having withdrawn everything from the heart, and likewise the upper stations, / permeated by the nectar of its service, and through constant practice, O Nārada, // 239

7.s:
syātsthiratvaṃ śarīrasya bhogamokṣabalaṃ tathā |
tasmādasya sadā pūjā dhyānajapyamayī bhavet || 240 ||
7.d:
स्यात्स्थिरत्वं शरीरस्य भोगमोक्षबलं तथा |
तस्मादस्य सदा पूजा ध्यानजप्यमयी भवेत् || 240 ||
7.m: there would be stability of the body, as well as the power of enjoyment and liberation. / Therefore, his worship should always consist of meditation and repetition. // 240

7.s:
nopacāramayī kāryā puṣpadhūpādikairbahiḥ |
yatassakaladehasya pūjanaṃ vihitaṃ mune || 241 ||
7.d:
नोपचारमयी कार्या पुष्पधूपादिकैर्बहिः |
यतस्सकलदेहस्य पूजनं विहितं मुने || 241 ||
7.m: It is not to be performed externally consisting of services with flowers, incense, and the like; / for the worship of the qualified body is prescribed, O sage. // 241

7.s:
bhāvanā niṣkalākhyasya naitadasti dvayojjhite |
yadasyāvikṛtaṃ rūpaṃ tadanena tvadhiṣṭhitam || 242 ||
7.d:
भावना निष्कलाख्यस्य नैतदस्ति द्वयोज्झिते |
यदस्याविकृतं रूपं तदनेन त्वधिष्ठितम् || 242 ||
7.m: The contemplation of what is called unqualified does not exist in that which is devoid of the pair; / whatever is his immutable form, that is presided over by this [mantra], // 242

7.s:
bhāvyodayena yogena so'sya vai janako yataḥ |
asmātsiṃhmādivaccānyadevameva vibhāvayet || 243 ||
7.d:
भाव्योदयेन योगेन सोऽस्य वै जनको यतः |
अस्मात्सिंह्मादिवच्चान्यदेवमेव विभावयेत् || 243 ||
7.m: because through the yoga of the arising of the object of contemplation, it is indeed his producer. / From this, just as for [forms] such as the Lion, one should likewise contemplate another deity // 243

7.s:
pṛthagyāge samaste vā nirvighnaphalasiddhaye |
brahmaprāttau tathā bhoge dīkṣādye karmasaṃgrahe || 244 ||
7.d:
पृथग्यागे समस्ते वा निर्विघ्नफलसिद्धये |
ब्रह्मप्रात्तौ तथा भोगे दीक्षाद्ये कर्मसंग्रहे || 244 ||
7.m: in a separate worship or in a combined one, for the accomplishment of fruit without obstacles, / in the attainment of Brahman and likewise in enjoyment, in the totality of rituals such as initiation. // 244

7.s:
etadīyaṃ hi sāmarthyaṃ mantrasya tryakṣarasya tu |
boddhavyassa tridhaivātmā guṇatrayamayastathā || 245 ||
7.d:
एतदीयं हि सामर्थ्यं मन्त्रस्य त्र्यक्षरस्य तु |
बोद्धव्यस्स त्रिधैवात्मा गुणत्रयमयस्तथा || 245 ||
7.m: Such indeed is the power of this three-syllable mantra; / it should be known that its self is threefold, consisting of the three guṇas. // 245

7.s:
sadā vipra trilokātmā trivedātmā sa ucyate |
tretāgniṃ taṃ vijānīyātkarma vāṅmanase asau || 246 ||
7.d:
सदा विप्र त्रिलोकात्मा त्रिवेदात्मा स उच्यते |
त्रेताग्निं तं विजानीयात्कर्म वाङ्मनसे असौ || 246 ||
7.m: He is always, O brāhmaṇa, called the soul of the three worlds, the soul of the three Vedas; / one should know him as the triple sacred fire, as action, speech, and mind. // 246

7.s:
p. 60) manobuddhirahaṅkāro buddhikarmākṣabhūtavān |
somasūryāgnirūpeṇa tridhā so'pi trayo'kṣaraḥ (rāḥ ?) || 247 ||
7.d:
प्. 60) मनोबुद्धिरहङ्कारो बुद्धिकर्माक्षभूतवान् |
सोमसूर्याग्निरूपेण त्रिधा सोऽपि त्रयोऽक्षरः (राः ?) || 247 ||
7.m: Mind, buddhi, ahaṅkāra, possessing the senses of knowledge and action and the elements; / in the form of soma, sun, and fire, those three syllables are also threefold. // 247

7.s:
prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva tṛtīyaśceśvaraśca saḥ |
sa ca nāḍītrayaṃ dehe sthānatrayasamanvitam || 248 ||
7.d:
प्रकृतिः पुरुषश्चैव तृतीयश्चेश्वरश्च सः |
स च नाडीत्रयं देहे स्थानत्रयसमन्वितम् || 248 ||
7.m: He is prakṛti and puruṣa, and he is the third, the Lord; / and he is the triad of nāḍīs in the body, endowed with the triad of stations. // 248

7.s:
evamevāsya mantrasya vaiśvarūpyaṃ ca nārada |
vyāpakatvaṃ ca yo vetti tatsatyaṃ vetti nānyathā || 249 ||
7.d:
एवमेवास्य मन्त्रस्य वैश्वरूप्यं च नारद |
व्यापकत्वं च यो वेत्ति तत्सत्यं वेत्ति नान्यथा || 249 ||
7.m: He who knows the universal form and the pervasiveness / of this mantra just in this way, O Nārada, knows that which is true, not otherwise. // 249

7.s:
iti mantragaṇo mukhyassarvoplavaśāntikṛt |
prakāśito yathā tathyaṃ nākhyeyo yasya kasyacit || 250 ||
7.d:
इति मन्त्रगणो मुख्यस्सर्वोप्लवशान्तिकृत् |
प्रकाशितो यथा तथ्यं नाख्येयो यस्य कस्यचित् || 250 ||
7.m: Thus the primary group of mantras, bringing pacification of all afflictions, / has been revealed truthfully; it must not be told to just anyone. // 250

7.s:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ mukhyamantroddhāro nāma
ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ || 6 ||
7.d:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां मुख्यमन्त्रोद्धारो नाम
षष्ठः पटलः || 6 ||
7.m: Thus ends the sixth chapter, named 'The Extraction of the Primary Mantras', in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the revered Pāñcarātra. // 6

8.s: atha upakaraṇamantroddhāro nāma saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ
8.d: अथ उपकरणमन्त्रोद्धारो नाम सप्तमः पटलः
8.m: Now begins the seventh chapter, named 'The Extraction of the Accessory Mantras'.

8.s: śrībhagavān
8.d: श्रीभगवान्

8.s:
athādhārāsanākhyānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu |
pūjanaṃ yairvinā vipra mantreśasya na jāyate || 1 ||
8.d:
अथाधारासनाख्यानां मन्त्राणां लक्षणं शृणु |
पूजनं यैर्विना विप्र मन्त्रेशस्य न जायते || 1 ||
8.m: Now listen to the characteristics of the mantras designated as base and seat, / without which, O brāhmaṇa, the worship of the Lord of Mantras does not take place. // 1

8.s: [ādhāraśaktimantraḥ]
8.d: [आधारशक्तिमन्त्रः]

8.s:
aśeṣabhuvanādhārāmādhārādheyavannyaset |
paramātmani viprendra māyākhyo mata ūrdhvataḥ || 2 ||
8.d:
अशेषभुवनाधारामाधाराधेयवन्न्यसेत् |
परमात्मनि विप्रेन्द्र मायाख्यो मत ऊर्ध्वतः || 2 ||
8.m: One should install the support of all worlds like a base and that which is supported / in the Supreme Self, O foremost of brāhmaṇas; above, it is regarded as consisting of māyā. // 2

8.s:
namo'ntaṃ praṇavādyaṃ ca bījamādhāraśaktijam |
ādheyatulyasāmarthyamasya rūpaṃ tathāvidham || 3 ||
8.d:
नमोऽन्तं प्रणवाद्यं च बीजमाधारशक्तिजम् |
आधेयतुल्यसामर्थ्यमस्य रूपं तथाविधम् || 3 ||
8.m: Ending in 'namaḥ' and beginning with the praṇava is the seed born of Ādhāraśakti; / its power is equal to what is supported, and its form is of such a nature. // 3

8.s: [kūrmamantraḥ]
8.d: [कूर्ममन्त्रः]

8.s:
uddhṛtya praṇavaṃ pūrvamananteśasya pūrvajam |
tatkālapāvakenaiva bhinnaṃ kuryāddvijobhayoḥ || 4 ||
8.d:
उद्धृत्य प्रणवं पूर्वमनन्तेशस्य पूर्वजम् |
तत्कालपावकेनैव भिन्नं कुर्याद्द्विजोभयोः || 4 ||
8.m: Having first extracted the praṇava, the elder brother of the Lord of Ananta, / one should separate it with the fire of time of both, O twice-born one, // 4

8.s:
trailokyaiśvaryadenaivamūrjena tu tathā dvija |
namaskārānvitaṃ bījaṃ kūrmakālāgnivācakam || 5 ||
8.d:
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेनैवमूर्जेन तु तथा द्विज |
नमस्कारान्वितं बीजं कूर्मकालाग्निवाचकम् || 5 ||
8.m: with that which bestows lordship over the three worlds, and likewise with vigor, O twice-born one; / endowed with the salutation, this seed designates Kūrma and the fire of time. // 5

8.s:
ādhāraśakterupari vimalaṃ dīptavigraham |
jvālāśatasamākīrṇaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 6 ||
8.d:
आधारशक्तेरुपरि विमलं दीप्तविग्रहम् |
ज्वालाशतसमाकीर्णं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् || 6 ||
8.m: Above the Ādhāraśakti, [one should visualize Kūrma] of spotless, radiant body, / surrounded by hundreds of flames, bearing a conch, discus, and mace. // 6

8.s: [anantamantraḥ]
8.d: [अनन्तमन्त्रः]

8.s:
ananteśasya yatpūrvaṃ gopanena samanvitam |
vyomayuktamanantākhyaṃ nāgarājasya kīrttitam || 7 ||
8.d:
अनन्तेशस्य यत्पूर्वं गोपनेन समन्वितम् |
व्योमयुक्तमनन्ताख्यं नागराजस्य कीर्त्तितम् || 7 ||
8.m: That which precedes the Lord of Ananta, accompanied by concealment, / joined with the void, named Ananta, is proclaimed as belonging to the King of Serpents. // 7

8.s:
praṇavādi namo'ntaṃ ca etadbījavaraṃ śubham |
pūrṇacandrānanaṃ dhyāyetsahasraphaṇabhūṣitam || 8 ||
8.d:
प्रणवादि नमोऽन्तं च एतद्बीजवरं शुभम् |
पूर्णचन्द्राननं ध्यायेत्सहस्रफणभूषितम् || 8 ||
8.m: Beginning with the praṇava and ending in 'namaḥ', this excellent, auspicious seed [is formed]. / One should meditate on him with a face like the full moon, adorned with a thousand hoods, // 8

8.s: p. 61) cakralāṅgalahastaṃ ca praṇamantaṃ parātparam |
8.d: प्. 61) चक्रलाङ्गलहस्तं च प्रणमन्तं परात्परम् |
8.m: bearing a discus and a plow in his hands, and bowing to the highest beyond the high.

8.s: [dharāmantraḥ]
8.d: [धरामन्त्रः]

8.s: anantākhyaṃ ca yadbījaṃ pradhānopari saṃsthitam || 9 ||
8.d: अनन्ताख्यं च यद्बीजं प्रधानोपरि संस्थितम् || 9 ||
8.m: And the seed named Ananta that is situated above pradhāna, // 9

8.s:
so'pyārūḍho dhareśasya vyomānantadvayāṅkitam |
prāgvadādyantasaṃruddhaṃ dharāyāssaṃprakīrtitam || 10 ||
8.d:
सोऽप्यारूढो धरेशस्य व्योमानन्तद्वयाङ्कितम् |
प्राग्वदाद्यन्तसंरुद्धं धरायास्संप्रकीर्तितम् || 10 ||
8.m: that too mounted on dhareśa, marked by the two, the void and Ananta, / enclosed at the beginning and end as before, is proclaimed for Dharā. // 10

8.s:
kuṅkumodakasaṅkāśāṃ hemaratnavibhūṣitām |
baddhāñjaliṃ śirodeśe saṃsmarantīṃ vibhoḥ smaret || 11 ||
8.d:
कुङ्कुमोदकसङ्काशां हेमरत्नविभूषिताम् |
बद्धाञ्जलिं शिरोदेशे संस्मरन्तीं विभोः स्मरेत् || 11 ||
8.m: One should meditate on her resembling saffron-water, adorned with gold and jewels, / folding her hands in reverent greeting at the region of her head, remembering the All-Pervading Lord. // 11

8.s: [kṣīrodamantraḥ]
8.d: [क्षीरोदमन्त्रः]

8.s:
amṛtaṃ varuṇasthaṃ ca ādidevena yojitam |
kṣīrodamantrarāḍeṣa vyomayukto dvijottama || 12 ||
8.d:
अमृतं वरुणस्थं च आदिदेवेन योजितम् |
क्षीरोदमन्त्रराडेष व्योमयुक्तो द्विजोत्तम || 12 ||
8.m: The nectar resting on Varuṇa, united with the Primeval Deity, / joined with the void, O best of the twice-born, is this king of mantras of Kṣīroda. // 12

8.s:
asyādau praṇavañcānte namaskārapadaṃ nyaset |
śuddhakundendudhavalaṃ srotoraśmibhirāvṛtam || 13 ||
8.d:
अस्यादौ प्रणवञ्चान्ते नमस्कारपदं न्यसेत् |
शुद्धकुन्देन्दुधवलं स्रोतोरश्मिभिरावृतम् || 13 ||
8.m: At its beginning one should place the praṇava and at the end the word of salutation; / white as a pure jasmine or the moon, surrounded by rays of flowing streams, // 13

8.s: kīrṇasaṃpūrṇacaṃdrābhaṃ dhyāyedgambhīravigraham |
8.d: कीर्णसंपूर्णचंद्राभं ध्यायेद्गम्भीरविग्रहम् |
8.m: shining like the full moon, one should meditate on his profound form.

8.s: [padmamantraḥ]
8.d: [पद्ममन्त्रः]

8.s: padmasyātha pravakṣyāmi mantraṃ sannidhikāraṇam || 14 ||
8.d: पद्मस्याथ प्रवक्ष्यामि मन्त्रं सन्निधिकारणम् || 14 ||
8.m: Now I shall proclaim the mantra of the lotus, which causes presence. // 14

8.s:
praṇavaṃ praṇavānte ca pavitraṃ tadanantaram |
bhuvanaṃ vyomasaṃbhinnamādhāreti padaṃ tataḥ || 15 ||
8.d:
प्रणवं प्रणवान्ते च पवित्रं तदनन्तरम् |
भुवनं व्योमसंभिन्नमाधारेति पदं ततः || 15 ||
8.m:
[First] the praṇava, and after the praṇava, then the pure [syllable],
then the word 'ādhārā', combined with the world and space; // 15

8.s:
padmāya ca namaścānte padaṃ pūrvapadasya ca |
praśāntapāvakākāramudayādityasannibham || 16 ||
8.d:
पद्माय च नमश्चान्ते पदं पूर्वपदस्य च |
प्रशान्तपावकाकारमुदयादित्यसन्निभम् || 16 ||
8.m:
and at the end 'padmāya namaḥ', and the word of the preceding term.
Having the appearance of a tranquil fire, resembling the rising sun, // 16

8.s:
dhyāyedvai dvibhujaṃ hrasvaṃ jaṭharādyairvilambitam |
bhāsitaṃ sitadantaṃ ca veṣṭitaṃ suraṣaṭpadaiḥ || 17 ||
8.d:
ध्यायेद्वै द्विभुजं ह्रस्वं जठराद्यैर्विलम्बितम् |
भासितं सितदन्तं च वेष्टितं सुरषट्पदैः || 17 ||
8.m:
one should meditate on him as two-armed, dwarfish, bulging with a potbelly and [limbs],
radiant, with white teeth, and surrounded by divine bees. // 17

8.s:
vyaktāvyaktaparatvena padmādyaṃ tritayaṃ smaret |
tritayaṃ tadadhasthaṃ yacchakyaṃ tasyaivameva hi || 18 ||
8.d:
व्यक्ताव्यक्तपरत्वेन पद्माद्यं त्रितयं स्मरेत् |
त्रितयं तदधस्थं यच्छक्यं तस्यैवमेव हि || 18 ||
8.m:
One should contemplate the triad beginning with the lotus as having the nature of manifest, unmanifest, and the supreme;
and the triad situated beneath it in the very same way, which is its capacity. // 18

8.s: ayamādhāraṣaṭkasya mantramārgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
8.d: अयमाधारषट्कस्य मन्त्रमार्गः प्रकीर्तितः |
8.m: This has been proclaimed as the path of mantras for the sextet of supports.

8.s: [dharmādyāsanamantrāḥ]
8.d: [धर्माद्यासनमन्त्राः]
8.m: [Mantras of the Seats Beginning with Dharma]

8.s: atroparyāsanākhyāṃśca ṣaṇmantrānatha me śṛṇu || 19 ||
8.d: अत्रोपर्यासनाख्यांश्च षण्मन्त्रानथ मे शृणु || 19 ||
8.m: Now hear from me the six mantras called seats above this. // 19

8.s:
dharttā'jito'mṛtādhāro vibudhākhyaiśca nārada |
vyutkramānukrameṇaiva kṛtvaikaikasya yojayet || 20 ||
8.d:
धर्त्ताऽजितोऽमृताधारो विबुधाख्यैश्च नारद |
व्युत्क्रमानुक्रमेणैव कृत्वैकैकस्य योजयेत् || 20 ||
8.m:
Dhartṛ, Ajita, Amṛtādhāra, and those called Vibudha, O Nārada,
having arranged them in reverse and direct order, one should join them to each one. // 20

8.s:
samyagjvālā'tha liṅgātmā devadattastato dvija |
p. 62) vāmanaṃ somamuddāmaṃ praṇavasyopari nyaset || 21 ||
8.d:
सम्यग्ज्वालाऽथ लिङ्गात्मा देवदत्तस्ततो द्विज |
प्. 62) वामनं सोममुद्दामं प्रणवस्योपरि न्यसेत् || 21 ||
8.m:
Samyagjvālā, then Liṅgātman, Devadatta, then, O twice-born,
one should place Vāmana and the unbounded Soma above the praṇava. // 21

8.s:
trailokyaiśvaryadaṃ dadyātsarveṣāṃ syāccatuṣṭayam |
dharmādyaṃ tadviparyāsairyuktaṃ vedaistathā yugaiḥ || 22 ||
8.d:
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदं दद्यात्सर्वेषां स्याच्चतुष्टयम् |
धर्माद्यं तद्विपर्यासैर्युक्तं वेदैस्तथा युगैः || 22 ||
8.m:
One should provide the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds; there should be a group of four for all,
beginning with Dharma and their opposites, joined with the Vedas and the Yugas. // 22

8.s:
susitaṃ cāmṛtaṃ padmaṃ sūryendvagnitrayaṃ tataḥ |
eteṣāṃ praṇavaḥ saṃjñā namaskāro bhaveddvija || 23 ||
8.d:
सुसितं चामृतं पद्मं सूर्येन्द्वग्नित्रयं ततः |
एतेषां प्रणवः संज्ञा नमस्कारो भवेद्द्विज || 23 ||
8.m:
Pure white and nectar-like is the lotus, then the triad of sun, moon, and fire;
their name is the praṇava, accompanied by reverence, O twice-born. // 23

8.s:
atroparyaparaṃ vipra cidbhāsā khacitaṃ śubham |
bhāvāsanaṃ vibhordadyātsthūlasūkṣmadvayātparam || 24 ||
8.d:
अत्रोपर्यपरं विप्र चिद्भासा खचितं शुभम् |
भावासनं विभोर्दद्यात्स्थूलसूक्ष्मद्वयात्परम् || 24 ||
8.m:
Above this, O vipra, one should offer the Lord another auspicious seat of contemplation,
inlaid with the light of consciousness, beyond the two, gross and subtle; // 24

8.s:
aprameyeṇa sūryeṇa vyomākhyenāmṛtena ca |
parameśvarayuktena tritāroktātmanāthavā || 25 ||
8.d:
अप्रमेयेण सूर्येण व्योमाख्येनामृतेन च |
परमेश्वरयुक्तेन त्रितारोक्तात्मनाथवा || 25 ||
8.m:
with the immeasurable sun, named space, and with nectar,
joined with the Supreme Lord, or consisting of what is proclaimed by the three omkāras. // 25

8.s:
ityevaṃ pīṭhapūjārtho mantragrāmo dvijottama |
rahasyametadākhyātamidānīmaparaṃ śṛṇu || 26 ||
8.d:
इत्येवं पीठपूजार्थो मन्त्रग्रामो द्विजोत्तम |
रहस्यमेतदाख्यातमिदानीमपरं शृणु || 26 ||
8.m:
Such is the collection of mantras for the worship of the seat, O best of the twice-born.
This secret has been proclaimed; now hear the other. // 26

8.s: [kṣatrapālamantraḥ]
8.d: [क्षत्रपालमन्त्रः]

8.s:
kṣetreśādyaṃ mantracayaṃ vighnanirmathanakṣamam |
anantākhyaṃ ca kālena bhedayetsānalena ca || 27 ||
8.d:
क्षेत्रेशाद्यं मन्त्रचयं विघ्ननिर्मथनक्षमम् |
अनन्ताख्यं च कालेन भेदयेत्सानलेन च || 27 ||
8.m:
The group of mantras beginning with Kṣetreśa is capable of crushing obstacles;
and one should pierce the one called Ananta with Time and Fire; // 27

8.s:
trailokyaiśvaryadenātha sādidevena bheditam |
kṣetrapālasya mantro'yamoṅkārāntena bhūṣitaḥ || 28 ||
8.d:
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेनाथ सादिदेवेन भेदितम् |
क्षेत्रपालस्य मन्त्रोऽयमोङ्कारान्तेन भूषितः || 28 ||
8.m:
then pierced with the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds and with the Primal Deity.
This mantra of Kṣetrapāla is adorned with the sound of oṃ at the end. // 28

8.s: [kṣetrapāladhyānam]
8.d: [क्षेत्रपालध्यानम्]

8.s:
nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ mahātanum |
muṣṭikṛdvāmahastena yāgakṣetrāvadhau smaret || 29 ||
8.d:
नीलजीमूतसङ्काशं दण्डहस्तं महातनुम् |
मुष्टिकृद्वामहस्तेन यागक्षेत्रावधौ स्मरेत् || 29 ||
8.m:
Resembling a dark rain-cloud, holding a staff, with a vast body,
making a fist with his left hand, one should contemplate him at the boundary of the sacrifice-field. // 29

8.s: [śrayādīnāṃ padmanidhyantānāṃ mantrāḥ]
8.d: [श्रयादीनां पद्मनिध्यन्तानां मन्त्राः]
8.m: [Mantras of the Deities Beginning with Śrī and Ending with Padmanidhi]

8.s:
puṇḍarīkastataścakrī pavitraścātha śāśvataḥ |
varāhaśca gadadhvaṃ(sī) sūkṣmaśśāntaḥ pavitrakaḥ || 30 ||
8.d:
पुण्डरीकस्ततश्चक्री पवित्रश्चाथ शाश्वतः |
वराहश्च गदध्वं(सी) सूक्ष्मश्शान्तः पवित्रकः || 30 ||
8.m:
Puṇḍarīka, then Cakrin, Pavītra, and then Śāśvata,
Varāha, Gadādhvaṃsin, Sūkṣma, Śānta, and Pavitraka: // 30

8.s:
krameṇa muniśārdūla etadvarṇagaṇaṃ likhet |
aśeṣabhuvanādhāraṃ viśrāntaṃ vyomabhūṣitam || 31 ||
8.d:
क्रमेण मुनिशार्दूल एतद्वर्णगणं लिखेत् |
अशेषभुवनाधारं विश्रान्तं व्योमभूषितम् || 31 ||
8.m:
in order, O tiger among sages, one should write this group of syllables,
resting on the support of all the worlds, adorned with space. // 31

8.s:
māyādyasyopari nyasya caturṇāmatha vikramī |
pañcabindurato dvābhyāṃ lokeśo'pyapare dvaye || 32 ||
8.d:
मायाद्यस्योपरि न्यस्य चतुर्णामथ विक्रमी |
पञ्चबिन्दुरतो द्वाभ्यां लोकेशोऽप्यपरे द्वये || 32 ||
8.m:
Placing it above the first of māyā, then for the four, the mighty one [placed]
with five bindus; then with two; and Lokeśa on the other two. // 32

8.s:
praṇavenābhidhānena namaskāreṇa bhūṣitāḥ |
sarve mantravarā hyete svasāmarthyaphalapradāḥ || 33 ||
8.d:
प्रणवेनाभिधानेन नमस्कारेण भूषिताः |
सर्वे मन्त्रवरा ह्येते स्वसामर्थ्यफलप्रदाः || 33 ||
8.m:
Adorned with the praṇava, the designation, and reverence,
all these supreme mantras bestow the fruits of their respective powers: // 33

8.s:
p. 63) śriyaścaṇḍapracaṇḍābhyāṃ jayasya vijayasya ca |
gaṅgāyamunayorvipra sanidhyoḥ śaṅkhapadmayoḥ || 34 ||
8.d:
प्. 63) श्रियश्चण्डप्रचण्डाभ्यां जयस्य विजयस्य च |
गङ्गायमुनयोर्विप्र सनिध्योः शङ्खपद्मयोः || 34 ||
8.m:
of Śrī, of Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa, of Jaya and Vijaya,
of Gaṅgā and Yamunā, O vipra, and of Śaṅkha and Padma together with their treasures. // 34

8.s: [śryādīnāṃ padmanidhyantānāṃ dhyānam]
8.d: [श्र्यादीनां पद्मनिध्यन्तानां ध्यानम्]
8.m: [Meditation on the Deities Beginning with Śrī and Ending with Padmanidhi]

8.s:
padmakumbhakarāṃ lakṣmīṃ padmoparigatāṃ smaret |
caṇḍādyā vijayāntāśca sarve jñeyāścaturbhujāḥ || 35 ||
8.d:
पद्मकुम्भकरां लक्ष्मीं पद्मोपरिगतां स्मरेत् |
चण्डाद्या विजयान्ताश्च सर्वे ज्ञेयाश्चतुर्भुजाः || 35 ||
8.m:
One should meditate on Lakṣmī holding a lotus and a water-pot, standing upon a lotus;
and all those beginning with Caṇḍa and ending with Vijaya are to be known as four-armed, // 35

8.s:
gadācakradharāścaiva śaṅkhahastā mahābalāḥ |
tarjayanto hyabhaktānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ dhvaṃsanodyatāḥ || 36 ||
8.d:
गदाचक्रधराश्चैव शङ्खहस्ता महाबलाः |
तर्जयन्तो ह्यभक्तानां दोषाणां ध्वंसनोद्यताः || 36 ||
8.m:
bearing mace and discus, and holding a conch, of great strength,
menacing the non-devotees and intent on destroying defects. // 36

8.s:
toyādhāraṃ vahantyau te kalaśaṃ vāripūritam |
navayauvanalāvaṇyastrīrūpaṃ ca nadīdvayam || 37 ||
8.d:
तोयाधारं वहन्त्यौ ते कलशं वारिपूरितम् |
नवयौवनलावण्यस्त्रीरूपं च नदीद्वयम् || 37 ||
8.m:
Those two carrying a reservoir of water, a pitcher filled with water,
the two rivers having the form of women endowed with the loveliness of fresh youth; // 37

8.s:
nidhipau śaṅkhapadmau ca nidhibhāṇḍopari sthitau |
sthūladantau ca piṅgākṣau dvibhujau bhagavanmayau || 38 ||
8.d:
निधिपौ शङ्खपद्मौ च निधिभाण्डोपरि स्थितौ |
स्थूलदन्तौ च पिङ्गाक्षौ द्विभुजौ भगवन्मयौ || 38 ||
8.m:
and the two treasure-guardians, Śaṅkha and Padma, standing upon treasure-jars,
with prominent teeth, reddish-brown eyes, two-armed, and full of the Lord. // 38

8.s: [gaṇeśādipitrantānāṃ mantrāḥ]
8.d: [गणेशादिपित्रन्तानां मन्त्राः]
8.m: [Mantras of the Deities Beginning with Gaṇeśa and Ending with the Pitṛs]

8.s: pitrantaṃ ca gaṇeśādyamatha mantragaṇaṃ śṛṇu |
8.d: पित्रन्तं च गणेशाद्यमथ मन्त्रगणं शृणु |
8.m: Now hear the group of mantras beginning with Gaṇeśa and ending with the Pitṛs. // 39ab

8.s: [gaṇeśamantraḥ]
8.d: [गणेशमन्त्रः]

8.s: gadādharaṃ samuddhṛtya prajñādhāreṇa bhedayet || 39 ||
8.d: गदाधरं समुद्धृत्य प्रज्ञाधारेण भेदयेत् || 39 ||
8.m: Extracting Gadādhara, one should pierce it with Prajñādhāra; // 39cd

8.s:
aṃkārayojitaṃ mūrdhni gaṇādhipataye padam |
namaskārānvitaṃ pūrvaṃ praṇavañcāsya yojayet || 40 ||
8.d:
अंकारयोजितं मूर्ध्नि गणाधिपतये पदम् |
नमस्कारान्वितं पूर्वं प्रणवञ्चास्य योजयेत् || 40 ||
8.m:
joined with the sound 'aṃ' on the head, the word 'gaṇādhipataye'
preceded by reverence, and one should join the praṇava to it. // 40

8.s:
navākṣaro hyayaṃ mantro vighneśasya ca vācakaḥ |
eṣa eva gadadhvaṃsī ṣoḍhā kāryo'tha bhedayet || 41 ||
8.d:
नवाक्षरो ह्ययं मन्त्रो विघ्नेशस्य च वाचकः |
एष एव गदध्वंसी षोढा कार्योऽथ भेदयेत् || 41 ||
8.m:
This nine-syllable mantra is indeed expressive of Vighneśa.
This very Gadādhvaṃsin is to be made sixfold; then one should pierce it: // 41

8.s:
ādidevādiṣaṭ dīrghairvirāṭ jvālojjhitaiḥ kramāt |
pañcānāṃ mastake vyāpī jātyaikaikaṃ svayaṃ nyaset || 42 ||
8.d:
आदिदेवादिषट् दीर्घैर्विराट् ज्वालोज्झितैः क्रमात् |
पञ्चानां मस्तके व्यापी जात्यैकैकं स्वयं न्यसेत् || 42 ||
8.m:
successively with the six long vowels beginning with the Primal Deity, free of Virāṭ and flame.
Pervading on the head of the five, one should personally place each with its termination: // 42

8.s:
namaḥ svāhā tato vauṣaṭ huṃ vauṣaṭ phaṭ samanvitāḥ |
jātayaḥ ṣaṭ samākhyātā hṛdādīnāṃ krameṇa tu || 43 ||
8.d:
नमः स्वाहा ततो वौषट् हुं वौषट् फट् समन्विताः |
जातयः षट् समाख्याता हृदादीनां क्रमेण तु || 43 ||
8.m:
joined with namaḥ, svāhā, then vauṣaṭ, huṃ, vauṣaṭ, and phaṭ,
these six terminations are proclaimed in order for the heart and other limbs. // 43

8.s: [gaṇeśadhyānam]
8.d: [गणेशध्यानम्]

8.s:
dhyāyeccampakavarṇābhaṃ baddhapadmāsanaṃ dvija |
karṇikāyāṃ tripatre'bje rakte ṣaṭkesare śubhe || 44 ||
8.d:
ध्यायेच्चम्पकवर्णाभं बद्धपद्मासनं द्विज |
कर्णिकायां त्रिपत्रेऽब्जे रक्ते षट्केसरे शुभे || 44 ||
8.m:
One should meditate on him having the color of a campaka flower, seated in the lotus posture, O twice-born,
on the pericarp of an auspicious, red, three-petalled lotus with six filaments; // 44

8.s:
varadābhayahastaśca (staṃ ca ?) dakṣiṇe sākṣasūtrakam |
viśrāntaṃ cintayedvāmaṃ caturthaṃ paraśūpari || 45 ||
8.d:
वरदाभयहस्तश्च (स्तं च ?) दक्षिणे साक्षसूत्रकम् |
विश्रान्तं चिन्तयेद्वामं चतुर्थं परशूपरि || 45 ||
8.m:
with hands bestowing boons and fearlessness, and on the right one with a rosary;
one should contemplate the resting left fourth hand [placed] upon an axe. // 45

8.s:
varadābhayahastābhyāṃ matsyamudrādvayaṃ smaret |
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhasaṅghaṭṭājjāyate yadayatnataḥ || 46 ||
8.d:
वरदाभयहस्ताभ्यां मत्स्यमुद्राद्वयं स्मरेत् |
तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठसङ्घट्टाज्जायते यदयत्नतः || 46 ||
8.m:
With the hands of boons and fearlessness, one should contemplate the two fish-gestures,
which arise effortlessly from the contact of the forefinger and thumb. // 46

8.s:
p. 64) sthūlāṅgamekadaṃṣṭraṃ ca lambakroḍaṃ gajānanam |
kesareṣvaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ ca patratrayagataṃ nyaset || 47 ||
8.d:
प्. 64) स्थूलाङ्गमेकदंष्ट्रं च लम्बक्रोडं गजाननम् |
केसरेष्वङ्गषट्कं च पत्रत्रयगतं न्यसेत् || 47 ||
8.m:
Having a stout body, a single tusk, a drooping belly, an elephant face;
and one should place the sextet of limbs on the filaments located on the three petals. // 47

8.s: [vāgīśvarīmantraḥ]
8.d: [वागीश्वरीमन्त्रः]

8.s:
ādāya praṇavañcādau suparṇaṃ tadanantaram |
tadante'tha tadādyaṃ ca somaṃ tadanu vai dvidhā || 48 ||
8.d:
आदाय प्रणवञ्चादौ सुपर्णं तदनन्तरम् |
तदन्तेऽथ तदाद्यं च सोमं तदनु वै द्विधा || 48 ||
8.m:
Taking the praṇava first, and Suparṇa immediately after,
then at its end its first, and then Soma twofold: // 48

8.s:
prākbījasyādha ūrdhve ca yojayetkālapāvakam |
atho dadyāddvitīyasya kevalaṃ tacca nārada || 49 ||
8.d:
प्राक्बीजस्याध ऊर्ध्वे च योजयेत्कालपावकम् |
अथो दद्याद्द्वितीयस्य केवलं तच्च नारद || 49 ||
8.m:
below and above the first seed, one should join the Fire of Time;
and then one should give that alone to the second, O Nārada; // 49

8.s:
śaṅkhasaṃsthaṃ tṛtīyasya caturthasyākṣarasya ca |
sragdhareṇa tu śaṅkhena tadūrdhvādhoyutaṃ nyaset || 50 ||
8.d:
शङ्खसंस्थं तृतीयस्य चतुर्थस्याक्षरस्य च |
स्रग्धरेण तु शङ्खेन तदूर्ध्वाधोयुतं न्यसेत् || 50 ||
8.m:
for the third, situated in a conch, and for the fourth syllable,
one should place it joined above and below with the conch by Sragdhara. // 50

8.s:
punarādikrameṇaiva dvābhyāṃ māyāṃ niyojya ca |
dvābhyāṃ taṃ cādidevaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vyoma copari || 51 ||
8.d:
पुनरादिक्रमेणैव द्वाभ्यां मायां नियोज्य च |
द्वाभ्यां तं चादिदेवं च सर्वेषां व्योम चोपरि || 51 ||
8.m:
Again in direct order, joining māyā with two,
and that Primal Deity with two, and space above all of them; // 51

8.s:
tadante varṇapūrvāntāṃ kṣāntāṃ saṃyojya mātṛkām |
vāgīśvaryai namaścānte ekaṣaṣṭhyakṣaraḥ (?) śubhaḥ || 52 ||
8.d:
तदन्ते वर्णपूर्वान्तां क्षान्तां संयोज्य मातृकाम् |
वागीश्वर्यै नमश्चान्ते एकषष्ठ्यक्षरः (?) शुभः || 52 ||
8.m:
at its end, having joined the mātṛkā beginning with the first letter and ending with kṣa,
and at the end 'vāgīśvaryai namaḥ', an auspicious sixty-one-syllable mantra: // 52

8.s:
vāgvibhūtiprado mantro vāgīśvaryā mayoditaḥ |
somaṃ cānalasaṃsthaṃ ca gaṇeśāṅgoditaissvaraiḥ || 53 ||
8.d:
वाग्विभूतिप्रदो मन्त्रो वागीश्वर्या मयोदितः |
सोमं चानलसंस्थं च गणेशाङ्गोदितैस्स्वरैः || 53 ||
8.m:
the mantra of Vāgīśvarī, bestowing the power of speech, has been proclaimed by me.
With Soma situated in fire, and with the vowels proclaimed for the limbs of Gaṇeśa, // 53

8.s: bhinnamasyāṅgaṣaṭkaṃ syāt oṅkārādyaṃ namo'ntakam |
8.d: भिन्नमस्याङ्गषट्कं स्यात् ओङ्काराद्यं नमोऽन्तकम् |
8.m: pierced by these, her sextet of limbs is formed, beginning with oṃ and ending with namaḥ.

8.s: [vāgīśvaryā dhyānam]
8.d: [वागीश्वर्या ध्यानम्]

8.s: sūryendumaṇḍalābhyāṃ ca madhye padmaṃ smaret sthitam || 54 ||
8.d: सूर्येन्दुमण्डलाभ्यां च मध्ये पद्मं स्मरेत् स्थितम् || 54 ||
8.m: Between the orbs of the sun and moon, one should contemplate a lotus situated. // 54

8.s:
tanmadhye saṃsthitāṃ devīṃ vahniveśmaprabhāñcitām |
sarvopādhivinirmuktāṃ sarvākārasamanvitām || 55 ||
8.d:
तन्मध्ये संस्थितां देवीं वह्निवेश्मप्रभाञ्चिताम् |
सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्तां सर्वाकारसमन्विताम् || 55 ||
8.m:
In its center is seated the goddess, endowed with the radiance of an abode of fire,
freed from all deceit, endowed with all forms. // 55

8.s:
ityasyā vaiśvarūpyaṃ syāddhyānamapyadhunā śṛṇu |
sitakundendudhavalāṃ śaṅkhapadmakarodyatām || 56 ||
8.d:
इत्यस्या वैश्वरूप्यं स्याद्ध्यानमप्यधुना शृणु |
सितकुन्देन्दुधवलां शङ्खपद्मकरोद्यताम् || 56 ||
8.m:
Thus is her universal form. Now also hear [her form for] meditation:
white as a white kunda flower or the moon, raising a conch and a lotus in her hands, // 56

8.s:
varadābhayahastāṃ ca vilikhantīṃ ca pustakam |
dvinetrāmekavaktrāṃ ca hemakuṇḍalabhūṣitām || 57 ||
8.d:
वरदाभयहस्तां च विलिखन्तीं च पुस्तकम् |
द्विनेत्रामेकवक्त्रां च हेमकुण्डलभूषिताम् || 57 ||
8.m:
holding her hands in the boongiving and fear-dispelling gestures, and writing in a book,
having two eyes and a single face, adorned with golden earrings. // 57

8.s:
dhyātā bhagavatī hyeṣā śaktiḥ śabdātmikā vibhoḥ |
samabhyastā dadātyāśu sādhakānāmabhīpsitam || 58 ||
8.d:
ध्याता भगवती ह्येषा शक्तिः शब्दात्मिका विभोः |
समभ्यस्ता ददात्याशु साधकानामभीप्सितम् || 58 ||
8.m:
Indeed, when this blessed goddess, the power of the All-Pervading Lord consisting of sound,
is meditated upon and continually recited, she swiftly bestows the desired object upon practitioners. // 58

8.s: [gurūṇāṃ mantrāḥ]
8.d: [गुरूणां मन्त्राः]

8.s:
praṇavadvitayaṃ vyāpī tadadhasthodayastu gaḥ |
gurave sanamaścānte mantro'yaṃ pūjane guroḥ || 59 ||
8.d:
प्रणवद्वितयं व्यापी तदधस्थोदयस्तु गः |
गुरवे सनमश्चान्ते मन्त्रोऽयं पूजने गुरोः || 59 ||
8.m:
A pair of praṇavas, the all-pervasive [syllable], and below that the arising ga;
at the end, "gurave" along with "namaḥ"—this is the mantra in the worship of the guru. // 59

8.s:
praṇavatritayānte tu savyomā paścimānanaḥ |
tataḥ paramaśabdastu gurave sanamastataḥ || 60 ||
8.d:
प्रणवत्रितयान्ते तु सव्योमा पश्चिमाननः |
ततः परमशब्दस्तु गुरवे सनमस्ततः || 60 ||
8.m:
At the end of a triad of praṇavas, however, the west-facing [syllable] accompanied by the void,
then the word "parama", and then "gurave" accompanied by "namaḥ". // 60

8.s:
gurorgurorayaṃ mantrastadguroravadhāraya |
p. 65) mantrādyasya catuṣkaṃ tu padmanābhamataḥ param || 61 ||
8.d:
गुरोर्गुरोरयं मन्त्रस्तद्गुरोरवधारय |
प्. 65) मन्त्राद्यस्य चतुष्कं तु पद्मनाभमतः परम् || 61 ||
8.m:
This is the mantra of the guru's guru; apprehend that of his guru:
A tetrad of the initial mantra, and after that Padmanābha; // 61

8.s:
nyasettasyānandayutaṃ vyomordhve parameṣṭhine |
sanamastakaṃ padaṃ dadyāt pitṛbhyāṃ [tṝṇāṃ] cātha me śṛṇu || 62 ||
8.d:
न्यसेत्तस्यानन्दयुतं व्योमोर्ध्वे परमेष्ठिने |
सनमस्तकं पदं दद्यात् पितृभ्यां [तॄणां] चाथ मे शृणु || 62 ||
8.m:
one should place it joined with bliss, with the void above, to Parameṣṭhin;
one should provide the word along with "namas". And now hear from me [the mantra] for the ancestors: // 62

8.s: [pitṝṇāṃ mantrāḥ]
8.d: [पितॄणां मन्त्राः]

8.s:
tārapañcakamāhlādaṃ vyomaprāṇopari nyaset |
kālānalau tu tadadhassarvalokeśvaropari || 63 ||
8.d:
तारपञ्चकमाह्लादं व्योमप्राणोपरि न्यसेत् |
कालानलौ तु तदधस्सर्वलोकेश्वरोपरि || 63 ||
8.m:
One should place a pentad of tāras, delight, upon the breath of the void,
and time and fire beneath that, above the lord of all worlds; // 63

8.s:
yathākramoditairvarṇaiḥ piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ padam |
svadhā pitṛbhyaḥsanamaḥ pitṛsaṅghasya mantrarāṭ || 64 ||
8.d:
यथाक्रमोदितैर्वर्णैः पिण्डं कृत्वा ततः पदम् |
स्वधा पितृभ्यःसनमः पितृसङ्घस्य मन्त्रराट् || 64 ||
8.m:
having formed a conjunct syllable with the phonemes uttered in due order, then the words
"svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ", accompanied by "namaḥ"—[this is] the king of mantras of the host of ancestors. // 64

8.s: [pūrvasiddhamantraḥ]
8.d: [पूर्वसिद्धमन्त्रः]

8.s:
kathito dvijaśārdūla pūrvasiddheṣvathocyate |
ante praṇavaṣaṭkasya ānandaṃ vyomabhūṣitam || 65 ||
8.d:
कथितो द्विजशार्दूल पूर्वसिद्धेष्वथोच्यते |
अन्ते प्रणवषट्कस्य आनन्दं व्योमभूषितम् || 65 ||
8.m:
It has been told, O tiger among the twice-born! Now it is declared with respect to the ancient siddhas:
At the end of a hexad of praṇavas, bliss adorned by the void; // 65

8.s:
pada tathādisiddhebhyassanamaskaṃ niyojayet |
prāgimaṃ mantranicayaṃ pūjayitvā tato'rcayet || 66 ||
8.d:
पद तथादिसिद्धेभ्यस्सनमस्कं नियोजयेत् |
प्रागिमं मन्त्रनिचयं पूजयित्वा ततोऽर्चयेत् || 66 ||
8.m:
likewise one should append the word "ādisiddhebhyaḥ" accompanied by "namas".
Having first worshipped this collection of mantras, one should then worship [them] // 66

8.s: pradhānamantrapūrvā ye yasmiṃnyasmiṃstu karmaṇi |
8.d: प्रधानमन्त्रपूर्वा ये यस्मिंन्यस्मिंस्तु कर्मणि |
8.m: preceded by the principal mantra in whatever rite [one undertakes].

8.s: [lokeśamantrāḥ]
8.d: [लोकेशमन्त्राः]

8.s: atha lokeśamantrāṇāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu || 67 ||
8.d: अथ लोकेशमन्त्राणां शास्त्राणां लक्षणं शृणु || 67 ||
8.m: Now hear the characteristic definition of the mantras and scriptures of the world-protectors: // 67

8.s:
vyomānandaṃ tataḥ prāṇaṃ dhareśopari saṃsthitam |
etadekīkṛtaṃ varṇaṃ sṛṣṭinyāyena nārada || 68 ||
8.d:
व्योमानन्दं ततः प्राणं धरेशोपरि संस्थितम् |
एतदेकीकृतं वर्णं सृष्टिन्यायेन नारद || 68 ||
8.m:
The void, bliss, and then the breath, situated above the dhareśa;
this phoneme brought into unity according to the rule of emission, O Nārada, // 68

8.s:
aindro mantrassamuddiṣṭa itareṣāṃ nibodha me |
prāṇadvayaṃ dvijoddhṛtya kramādanalakālagam || 69 ||
8.d:
ऐन्द्रो मन्त्रस्समुद्दिष्ट इतरेषां निबोध मे |
प्राणद्वयं द्विजोद्धृत्य क्रमादनलकालगम् || 69 ||
8.m:
is declared to be the mantra of Indra. Learn from me those of the others:
Extracting a pair of breaths, O twice-born, placed respectively on fire and time, // 69

8.s:
dvitīyasvarasaṃyuktaṃ vyomamastakabhūṣitam |
śikhinaścāntakasyaiva dve bīje parikīrtite || 70 ||
8.d:
द्वितीयस्वरसंयुक्तं व्योममस्तकभूषितम् |
शिखिनश्चान्तकस्यैव द्वे बीजे परिकीर्तिते || 70 ||
8.m:
joined with the second vowel, adorned with the void as their crest,
the two seeds are proclaimed for the Fire-God and the Ender. // 70

8.s:
vyāpī naraśca liṅgātmā prāgvatsaṃyojya piṇḍavat |
yātvīśasya tu bījena anyeṣāmavadhāraya || 71 ||
8.d:
व्यापी नरश्च लिङ्गात्मा प्राग्वत्संयोज्य पिण्डवत् |
यात्वीशस्य तु बीजेन अन्येषामवधारय || 71 ||
8.m:
The pervasive one, man, and that whose nature is the liṅga, joined as a conjunct syllable as before,
is the seed of the lord of rākṣasas. Now apprehend those of the others: // 71

8.s:
paramātmānamuddhṛtya dvidhā dvābhyāmatho nyaset |
varāhasūkṣmasaṃjñau tu vyomānandāvathopari || 72 ||
8.d:
परमात्मानमुद्धृत्य द्विधा द्वाभ्यामथो न्यसेत् |
वराहसूक्ष्मसंज्ञौ तु व्योमानन्दावथोपरि || 72 ||
8.m:
Extracting the supreme self twice, one should then place it with two;
those designated as Varāha and the subtle one, and then above, the void and bliss, // 72

8.s:
anukrameṇa vijñeyau bījau varuṇavāyujau |
dharmāṃśorūrdhvagaṃ nyasya varṇaṃ vārāhasaṃjñakam || 73 ||
8.d:
अनुक्रमेण विज्ञेयौ बीजौ वरुणवायुजौ |
धर्मांशोरूर्ध्वगं न्यस्य वर्णं वाराहसंज्ञकम् || 73 ||
8.m:
are to be known in due sequence as the two seeds born of Varuṇa and Vāyu.
Having placed above the sun the phoneme designated as of Varāha, // 73

8.s:
p. 66) prāgvatsvaradvayopetaṃ bījaṃ coḍupateḥ smṛtam |
sūryamūrjoparisthaṃ ca vyāpakena tathāṅkitam || 74 ||
8.d:
प्. 66) प्राग्वत्स्वरद्वयोपेतं बीजं चोडुपतेः स्मृतम् |
सूर्यमूर्जोपरिस्थं च व्यापकेन तथाङ्कितम् || 74 ||
8.m:
endowed with two vowels as before, it is remembered as the seed of the Moon-Lord;
and the sun situated above strength, likewise marked by the pervasive one, // 74

8.s:
īśānākhyaṃ smṛtaṃ bījaṃ viśvāpyāyakarānvitam |
ādidevānvitaṃ vyoma prāṇākhyasyopari nyaset || 75 ||
8.d:
ईशानाख्यं स्मृतं बीजं विश्वाप्यायकरान्वितम् |
आदिदेवान्वितं व्योम प्राणाख्यस्योपरि न्यसेत् || 75 ||
8.m:
is remembered as the seed named Īśāna, endowed with that which gratifies all.
One should place the void, endowed with the primeval deity, above that called breath; // 75

8.s:
vaikuṇṭhastadadho yojyo bījaṃ nāgeśvarasya ca |
prāgvatsvarānvite sūrye vedātmānamatho nyaset || 76 ||
8.d:
वैकुण्ठस्तदधो योज्यो बीजं नागेश्वरस्य च |
प्राग्वत्स्वरान्विते सूर्ये वेदात्मानमथो न्यसेत् || 76 ||
8.m:
Vaikuṇṭha is to be joined below that: [this is] the seed of the Lord of Serpents.
Upon the sun endowed with the vowel as before, one should then place that whose nature is the Veda: // 76

8.s:
brahmaṇo bījamākhyātaṃ paraṃ vyomeśvarasya ca |
sarveṣāṃ praṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ svasaṃjñānte namoyutāḥ || 77 ||
8.d:
ब्रह्मणो बीजमाख्यातं परं व्योमेश्वरस्य च |
सर्वेषां प्रणवं पूर्वं स्वसंज्ञान्ते नमोयुताः || 77 ||
8.m:
it is declared as the seed of Brahmā, and the supreme one of the Lord of the Void.
For all of them, the praṇava is at the beginning, and they are joined with namaḥ at the end of their own name. // 77

8.s: [vajrādyāyudhamantraḥ]
8.d: [वज्राद्यायुधमन्त्रः]
8.m: [Mantra of the Weapons Beginning with the Thunderbolt]

8.s:
athāyudhānāṃ kramaśo ye mantrāḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥ |
sthitān śṛṇu samāsena yathāyogānuvācakān || 78 ||
8.d:
अथायुधानां क्रमशो ये मन्त्राः शुभलक्षणाः |
स्थितान् शृणु समासेन यथायोगानुवाचकान् || 78 ||
8.m:
Now hear in brief the mantras of the weapons in their proper order, possessing auspicious characteristics,
which stand denoting [them] according to their proper application: // 78

8.s:
ajitaṃ ca dvidhoddhṛtya pradhānoparisaṃsthitam |
aśeṣabhuvanādhāramūrdhve'dhaścānayornyaset || 79 ||
8.d:
अजितं च द्विधोद्धृत्य प्रधानोपरिसंस्थितम् |
अशेषभुवनाधारमूर्ध्वेऽधश्चानयोर्न्यसेत् || 79 ||
8.m:
Extracting the unconquered one twice, situated above the pradhāna,
one should place the support of all worlds above and below them: // 79

8.s:
lokeśordhvoditaṃ pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ pañcabindunā |
visargayukte dve caite bīje kuliśaśaktije || 80 ||
8.d:
लोकेशोर्ध्वोदितं पूर्वं द्वितीयं पञ्चबिन्दुना |
विसर्गयुक्ते द्वे चैते बीजे कुलिशशक्तिजे || 80 ||
8.m:
the first uttered above the world-protector, the second with five bindus,
and these two seeds joined with the visarga, born of the thunderbolt and the spear. // 80

8.s:
akhaṇḍavikramaśvāndrī dvāvetau mardanasthitau |
lokeśvaravisargāḍhyau vijñeyau daṇḍakhaḍgayoḥ || 81 ||
8.d:
अखण्डविक्रमश्वान्द्री द्वावेतौ मर्दनस्थितौ |
लोकेश्वरविसर्गाढ्यौ विज्ञेयौ दण्डखड्गयोः || 81 ||
8.m:
Unbroken valor and lunar power, these two situated upon crushing,
endowed with the world-protector and the visarga, are to be known [as the seeds] of the staff and the sword. // 81

8.s:
āhlādājitasaṃjñau dvau śatākhyavaruṇasthitau |
visargānandasaṃyuktau jñeyau pāśadhvajābhidhau || 82 ||
8.d:
आह्लादाजितसंज्ञौ द्वौ शताख्यवरुणस्थितौ |
विसर्गानन्दसंयुक्तौ ज्ञेयौ पाशध्वजाभिधौ || 82 ||
8.m:
The two named delight and unconquered, situated upon the one called hundred and Varuṇa,
joined with the visarga and bliss, are to be known under the names of noose and banner. // 82

8.s:
paramātmānamuddhṛtya analākhyamataḥparam |
tayorupari tau kuryātkramādanalaśāśvatau || 83 ||
8.d:
परमात्मानमुद्धृत्य अनलाख्यमतःपरम् |
तयोरुपरि तौ कुर्यात्क्रमादनलशाश्वतौ || 83 ||
8.m:
Extracting the supreme self, and after that the one called fire;
upon them one should make fire and the eternal one in due order, // 83

8.s:
soddāmena visargeṇa ekaikamatha yojayet |
proktau mudgaraśūlau dvau someśābhyāṃ dvijāyudhe || 84 ||
8.d:
सोद्दामेन विसर्गेण एकैकमथ योजयेत् |
प्रोक्तौ मुद्गरशूलौ द्वौ सोमेशाभ्यां द्विजायुधे || 84 ||
8.m:
then join each one with an intense visarga:
the two weapons of the twice-born, the club and trident, are declared by the Moon and Īśa. // 84

8.s:
paraprakṛtisaṃjñaṃ yadvinyasedanalopari |
odanaṃ savisargaṃ ca tatastasyaiva yojayet || 85 ||
8.d:
परप्रकृतिसंज्ञं यद्विन्यसेदनलोपरि |
ओदनं सविसर्गं च ततस्तस्यैव योजयेत् || 85 ||
8.m:
That which is called the higher prakṛti one should place upon fire,
and then one should join boiled rice with a visarga to that itself: // 85

8.s:
sīrākhyaṃ bījametaddhi vārijasyādhunocyate |
varuṇañca dvijoddhṛtya narākhyasyopari sthitam || 86 ||
8.d:
सीराख्यं बीजमेतद्धि वारिजस्याधुनोच्यते |
वरुणञ्च द्विजोद्धृत्य नराख्यस्योपरि स्थितम् || 86 ||
8.m:
this is indeed the seed called plough. Now that of the lotus is declared:
Extracting Varuṇa, O twice-born, situated above that called man, // 86

8.s: visargeṇādidevena yuktaṃ pādmamihoditam |
8.d: विसर्गेणादिदेवेन युक्तं पाद्ममिहोदितम् |
8.m: joined with the visarga and the primeval deity, it is declared here as [the seed] of the lotus.

8.s: [viṣvaksenamantraḥ]
8.d: [विष्वक्सेनमन्त्रः]

8.s: ākrāntamanalenaiva prāṇākhyaṃ bījanāyakam || 87 ||
8.d: आक्रान्तमनलेनैव प्राणाख्यं बीजनायकम् || 87 ||
8.m: That called breath, the leader of seeds, pervaded by fire, // 87

8.s:
p. 67) trailokyaiśvaryadopetamūrjopari gataṃ tu tat |
tato vārāhamādāya bhūdharavyomabhūṣitam || 88 ||
8.d:
प्. 67) त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदोपेतमूर्जोपरि गतं तु तत् |
ततो वाराहमादाय भूधरव्योमभूषितम् || 88 ||
8.m:
endowed with the bestower of sovereign power over the three worlds, but gone above strength;
then taking Varāha's [seed], adorned with the mountain-bearer and the void, // 88

8.s:
viṣvaksenāya tadanu sanamaskaṃ padaṃ nyaset |
praṇavādyo hyayaṃ mantro viṣvaksenasya kīrttitaḥ || 89 ||
8.d:
विष्वक्सेनाय तदनु सनमस्कं पदं न्यसेत् |
प्रणवाद्यो ह्ययं मन्त्रो विष्वक्सेनस्य कीर्त्तितः || 89 ||
8.m:
thereafter one should place the word "viṣvaksenāya" accompanied by "namas".
This mantra beginning with the praṇava is proclaimed for Viṣvaksena. // 89

8.s:
pūrvabījaṃ hi yaccāsya ūkārasvaravarjitam |
gaṇeśavacca ṣaṭdīrghairbhinnamaṅgagaṇaṃ bhavet || 90 ||
8.d:
पूर्वबीजं हि यच्चास्य ऊकारस्वरवर्जितम् |
गणेशवच्च षट्दीर्घैर्भिन्नमङ्गगणं भवेत् || 90 ||
8.m:
Its preceding seed, bereft of the vowel sound ū
and differentiated by the six long vowels like that of Gaṇeśa, forms the group of aṅgas, // 90

8.s: praṇavena svanāmnā ca jātibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiranvitam |
8.d: प्रणवेन स्वनाम्ना च जातिभिः षड्भिरन्वितम् |
8.m: endowed with the praṇava, its own name, and the six terminations.

8.s: [aupacārikamantrapañcakam]
8.d: [औपचारिकमन्त्रपञ्चकम्]
8.m: [The Pentad of Mantras for the Services]

8.s: aupacārikamantrāṇāṃ pañcakaṃ cādhunocyate || 91 ||
8.d: औपचारिकमन्त्राणां पञ्चकं चाधुनोच्यते || 91 ||
8.m: And now the pentad of mantras for the services is declared, // 91

8.s:
mūlamantrādisarveṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ yanmahāmate |
yena vijñātamātreṇa japadhyānādikaṃ vinā || 92 ||
8.d:
मूलमन्त्रादिसर्वेषां सामान्यं यन्महामते |
येन विज्ञातमात्रेण जपध्यानादिकं विना || 92 ||
8.m:
which is common to all [rites] beginning with the root-mantra, O highly intelligent one,
by the mere knowledge of which, without recitation, meditation, and the like, // 92

8.s: yathākālaṃ prayuktatvātsaṃpūrṇaṃ jāyate'rcanam |
8.d: यथाकालं प्रयुक्तत्वात्संपूर्णं जायतेऽर्चनम् |
8.m: because it is employed at the proper time, worship becomes complete.

8.s: [āvāhane viniyoktavyo mantraḥ]
8.d: [आवाहने विनियोक्तव्यो मन्त्रः]
8.m: [Mantra to be Employed in Invocation]

8.s: praṇavadvitayopetaṃ paramaṃ tryakṣaraṃ padam || 93 ||
8.d: प्रणवद्वितयोपेतं परमं त्र्यक्षरं पदम् || 93 ||
8.m: The supreme three-syllable word endowed with a pair of praṇavas; // 93

8.s:
dhāmāvasthitapañcārṇaṃ dvitīyaṃ proddharettataḥ |
tadanugrahakāmyaṃ yo aṣṭārṇaṃ paramaṃ padam || 94 ||
8.d:
धामावस्थितपञ्चार्णं द्वितीयं प्रोद्धरेत्ततः |
तदनुग्रहकाम्यं यो अष्टार्णं परमं पदम् || 94 ||
8.m:
then one should extract a second five-syllable [word] situated in the abode;
he who desires the grace of that, the supreme eight-syllable word: // 94

8.s:
dakāraṃ ca yakārasthaṃ tadante yojayeddvija |
ādidevānvitaṃ paścāttālalakṣmāṇamuddharet || 95 ||
8.d:
दकारं च यकारस्थं तदन्ते योजयेद्द्विज |
आदिदेवान्वितं पश्चात्ताललक्ष्माणमुद्धरेत् || 95 ||
8.m:
one should join the letter da resting on the letter ya at the end of that, O twice-born;
afterwards one should extract the palm-sign endowed with the primeval deity; // 95

8.s:
tato varuṇasaṃjñaṃ ca kevalasragdharaṃ tataḥ |
aśeṣabhuvanādhāraṃ jagadyoniyutaṃ tataḥ || 96 ||
8.d:
ततो वरुणसंज्ञं च केवलस्रग्धरं ततः |
अशेषभुवनाधारं जगद्योनियुतं ततः || 96 ||
8.m:
then that called Varuṇa, and then the pure garland-bearer;
then the support of all worlds joined with the womb of the world; // 96

8.s:
paramātmānamante ca gopanena samanvitam |
rāmopetaṃ dhruvaṃ dadyāttataḥ kālaṃ ca kevalam || 97 ||
8.d:
परमात्मानमन्ते च गोपनेन समन्वितम् |
रामोपेतं ध्रुवं दद्यात्ततः कालं च केवलम् || 97 ||
8.m:
and at the end the supreme self endowed with concealment;
one should supply the constant one endowed with Rāma, and then pure time; // 97

8.s:
vairājaṃ kevalaṃ cātha siddhidaṃ tryakṣaraṃ padam |
mantreti dvyakṣaraṃ dadyācchaṅkaraṃ kevalaṃ tataḥ || 98 ||
8.d:
वैराजं केवलं चाथ सिद्धिदं त्र्यक्षरं पदम् |
मन्त्रेति द्व्यक्षरं दद्याच्छङ्करं केवलं ततः || 98 ||
8.m:
and then pure Vairāja, the three-syllable word bestowing attainment;
one should supply the two syllables "mantra", and then pure Śaṅkara. // 98

8.s:
aśeṣabhuvanādhāraṃ māyāyuktaṃ tato nyaset |
vikramavyomasaṃbhinnamanalaṃcoddharettataḥ || 99 ||
8.d:
अशेषभुवनाधारं मायायुक्तं ततो न्यसेत् |
विक्रमव्योमसंभिन्नमनलंचोद्धरेत्ततः || 99 ||
8.m: Then one should deposit the support of all worlds joined with Māyā; / then one should extract fire intersected by step and void. // 99

8.s:
namo namaḥ padaṃ paścādaṣṭatriṃśākṣaraḥ paraḥ |
praṇavenādhiko vipra dvitīyena mahāprabhaḥ || 100 ||
8.d:
नमो नमः पदं पश्चादष्टत्रिंशाक्षरः परः |
प्रणवेनाधिको विप्र द्वितीयेन महाप्रभः || 100 ||
8.m: Thereafter, the phrase "namo namaḥ". It has thirty-eight syllables, supreme, / increased by a second praṇava, O brāhmaṇa, possessing great splendor. // 100

8.s: p. 68) mantra āvāhane vipra yoktavyastu paraṃ śṛṇu |
8.d: प्. 68) मन्त्र आवाहने विप्र योक्तव्यस्तु परं शृणु |
8.m: This mantra is to be employed in invocation, O brāhmaṇa; but hear the next one:

8.s: [pādyādyeṣūpacāreṣu viniyojyo mantraḥ]
8.d: [पाद्याद्येषूपचारेषु विनियोज्यो मन्त्रः]
8.m: [The mantra to be employed in services such as the foot-water]

8.s: aupacārikahṛtsaṃjñaṃ kriyate yena pūjanam || 101 ||
8.d: औपचारिकहृत्संज्ञं क्रियते येन पूजनम् || 101 ||
8.m: designated the heart of service, by which worship is performed. // 101

8.s:
praṇavānte tridhā yojya prāṇaṃ vyomavibhūṣitam |
idamidamidaṃ paścātpadaṃ dadyātṣaḍakṣaram || 102 ||
8.d:
प्रणवान्ते त्रिधा योज्य प्राणं व्योमविभूषितम् |
इदमिदमिदं पश्चात्पदं दद्यात्षडक्षरम् || 102 ||
8.m: At the end of the praṇava, joining prāṇa adorned with the void three times, / thereafter one should supply the six-syllable phrase: "idam idam idam". // 102

8.s:
gṛhāṇa ca tataḥ svāhā mantraḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ |
yogyassarvopacāreṣu pādyādyeṣu sadaiva hi || 103 ||
8.d:
गृहाण च ततः स्वाहा मन्त्रः पञ्चदशाक्षरः |
योग्यस्सर्वोपचारेषु पाद्याद्येषु सदैव हि || 103 ||
8.m: And then "gṛhāṇa svāhā". This fifteen-syllable mantra / is always suitable in all services, beginning with the foot-water. // 103

8.s: [nyūnādhikaparihārāya viniyojyā viṣṇugāyatrī]
8.d: [न्यूनाधिकपरिहाराय विनियोज्या विष्णुगायत्री]
8.m: [The Viṣṇu-gāyatrī to be employed for the removal of defects of deficiency and excess]

8.s:
praṇavaṃ viśvarūpāya vidmahe vinyasettataḥ |
viśvātītāya tadanu dhīmahe tadanantaram || 104 ||
8.d:
प्रणवं विश्वरूपाय विद्महे विन्यसेत्ततः |
विश्वातीताय तदनु धीमहे तदनन्तरम् || 104 ||
8.m: Then one should place the praṇava, "viśvarūpāya vidmahe", / and after that, "viśvātītāya", immediately followed by "dhīmahe". // 104

8.s:
padadvayānte tadanu tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt |
sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāmante pūraṇārthaṃ prayojayet || 105 ||
8.d:
पदद्वयान्ते तदनु तन्नो विष्णुः प्रचोदयात् |
सर्वेषां कर्मणामन्ते पूरणार्थं प्रयोजयेत् || 105 ||
8.m: After these two phrases, then: "tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt". / One should employ it at the end of all rites for the sake of completion. // 105

8.s:
nyūnādhikanimittārthaṃ gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī parā |
caturviṃśākṣaro hyeṣa namaḥpraṇavasaṃyutaḥ || 106 ||
8.d:
न्यूनाधिकनिमित्तार्थं गायत्री वैष्णवी परा |
चतुर्विंशाक्षरो ह्येष नमःप्रणवसंयुतः || 106 ||
8.m: For the purpose of [atoning for] deficiency and excess, there is the supreme Vaiṣṇava Gāyatrī. / It has twenty-four syllables, joined with namaḥ and the praṇava. // 106

8.s: [prasādane viniyojyo mantraḥ]
8.d: [प्रसादने विनियोज्यो मन्त्रः]
8.m: [The mantra to be employed in propitiation]

8.s:
uddharetpraṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ viṣṇuṃ vyomānvitaṃ tataḥ |
hrīṃkāraṃ ca tato dadyādbhūyo viṣṇuṃ tathāvidham || 107 ||
8.d:
उद्धरेत्प्रणवं पूर्वं विष्णुं व्योमान्वितं ततः |
ह्रींकारं च ततो दद्याद्भूयो विष्णुं तथाविधम् || 107 ||
8.m: First one should extract the praṇava, then Viṣṇu joined with the void; / and then one should supply the syllable hrīṃ, and again Viṣṇu of the same kind. // 107

8.s:
tato vyomānvitaṃ prāṇaṃ somaṃ tadanu kevalam |
paravarṇaṃ dvayaṃ dadyātparameśapadaṃ tataḥ || 108 ||
8.d:
ततो व्योमान्वितं प्राणं सोमं तदनु केवलम् |
परवर्णं द्वयं दद्यात्परमेशपदं ततः || 108 ||
8.m: Then prāṇa joined with the void, and after that, pure Soma; / one should supply two supreme syllables, then the word "parameśa", // 108

8.s:
prasīda oṃ namasyānto mantro hyaṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ |
mantraprasādane yojyo mudrābandhāvasānataḥ || 109 ||
8.d:
प्रसीद ओं नमस्यान्तो मन्त्रो ह्यष्टादशाक्षरः |
मन्त्रप्रसादने योज्यो मुद्राबन्धावसानतः || 109 ||
8.m: ending in "prasīda oṃ namaḥ". This mantra has eighteen syllables. / It is to be employed in propitiating the mantra, at the conclusion of forming the mudrās. // 109

8.s: [visarjane viniyoktavyo mantraḥ]
8.d: [विसर्जने विनियोक्तव्यो मन्त्रः]
8.m: [The mantra to be employed in dismissal]

8.s:
oṃ bhagavanmantramūrte dadyādaṣṭākṣaraṃ padam |
tadante varuṇārūḍhamamṛtākhyaṃ niyojya ca || 110 ||
8.d:
ओं भगवन्मन्त्रमूर्ते दद्यादष्टाक्षरं पदम् |
तदन्ते वरुणारूढममृताख्यं नियोज्य च || 110 ||
8.m: One should supply the eight-syllable phrase: "oṃ bhagavanmantramūrte", / and at its end, having joined that called nectar, mounted upon Varuṇa, // 110

8.s:
padamāsādayapadaṃ tato dadyāt ṣaḍakṣaram |
kṣamasva tryakṣaraṃ bhūyaḥ praṇavāntaṃ ca vinyaset || 111 ||
8.d:
पदमासादयपदं ततो दद्यात् षडक्षरम् |
क्षमस्व त्र्यक्षरं भूयः प्रणवान्तं च विन्यसेत् || 111 ||
8.m: one should then supply the six-syllable word "āsādayapada"; / again the three-syllable "kṣamasva", and place it ending in the praṇava. // 111

8.s:
namonamaḥpadaṃ dadyātṣaḍviṃśārṇaṃ tu mantrarāṭ |
visarjane niyoktavyo mantragrāmasya sarvadā || 112 ||
8.d:
नमोनमःपदं दद्यात्षड्विंशार्णं तु मन्त्रराट् |
विसर्जने नियोक्तव्यो मन्त्रग्रामस्य सर्वदा || 112 ||
8.m: One should supply the phrase "namo namaḥ". This king of mantras has twenty-six syllables; / it is always to be employed in the dismissal of the assembly of mantras. // 112

8.s:
jñaptisaṃjñaṃ tu yadvarṇaṃ varāhopari saṃsthitam |
vyomeśaṃ viṣṇunā yuktaṃ namaḥpraṇavamadhyagam || 113 ||
8.d:
ज्ञप्तिसंज्ञं तु यद्वर्णं वराहोपरि संस्थितम् |
व्योमेशं विष्णुना युक्तं नमःप्रणवमध्यगम् || 113 ||
8.m: The syllable named Jñapti situated above Varāha, / the Lord of the Void joined with Viṣṇu, situated between namaḥ and the praṇava— // 113

8.s:
p. 69) saurabhīyo hyayaṃ mantraḥ svasaṃjñāsaṃyuto dvija |
saṃpūraṇārthaṃ bhogānte teṣāmāpyāyanārthataḥ || 114 ||
8.d:
प्. 69) सौरभीयो ह्ययं मन्त्रः स्वसंज्ञासंयुतो द्विज |
संपूरणार्थं भोगान्ते तेषामाप्यायनार्थतः || 114 ||
8.m: this is the mantra belonging to Saurabhī, joined with its own name, O twice-born, / for the sake of completion at the end of offerings, for their satisfaction. // 114

8.s:
ityeṣa kathito vipra mantrakośo yathā sthitaḥ |
sarvapāpakṣayakarassarvaduḥkhopaśāntidaḥ || 115 ||
8.d:
इत्येष कथितो विप्र मन्त्रकोशो यथा स्थितः |
सर्वपापक्षयकरस्सर्वदुःखोपशान्तिदः || 115 ||
8.m: Thus has this treasury of mantras been explained as it stands, O brāhmaṇa, / destroying all sins and granting the pacification of all sorrow. // 115

8.s:
gopanīyo hyabhaktānāṃ śaṭhānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
nāstikānāmasādhūnāṃ dhūrtānāṃ chadmacāriṇām || 116 ||
8.d:
गोपनीयो ह्यभक्तानां शठानां च विशेषतः |
नास्तिकानामसाधूनां धूर्तानां छद्मचारिणाम् || 116 ||
8.m: It should be concealed from non-devotees, and especially from the deceitful, / from atheists, the wicked, the cunning, and hypocrites; // 116

8.s:
nāstikānāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ śraddhāsaṃyamasevinām |
guruśāstraratānāṃ ca nayamārgānuvartinām || 117 ||
8.d:
नास्तिकानां च भक्तानां श्रद्धासंयमसेविनाम् |
गुरुशास्त्ररतानां च नयमार्गानुवर्तिनाम् || 117 ||
8.m: and [revealed to] non-atheists, devotees devoted to faith and restraint, / fond of the guru and the scriptures, following the path of righteousness, // 117

8.s:
tattvataścopapannānāṃ dṛḍhaśraddhāvalambinām |
tanmayānāmidaṃ vācyamitareṣu ca yo'nyathā || 118 ||
8.d:
तत्त्वतश्चोपपन्नानां दृढश्रद्धावलम्बिनाम् |
तन्मयानामिदं वाच्यमितरेषु च योऽन्यथा || 118 ||
8.m: endowed with truth, upholding firm faith, / and absorbed in Him. To these it should be spoken; but whoever acts otherwise among others, // 118

8.s:
vakti caiteṣu yo mohādbhaktiśraddhojjhiteṣu ca |
lobhenānyāyataḥ kāmātsa yāti narake'dhamaḥ || 119 ||
8.d:
वक्ति चैतेषु यो मोहाद्भक्तिश्रद्धोज्झितेषु च |
लोभेनान्यायतः कामात्स याति नरकेऽधमः || 119 ||
8.m: and whoever through delusion speaks among these people destitute of devotion and faith, / out of greed, injustice, or passion—that vile person goes to hell, // 119

8.s:
siddho'pi vipraśārdūla asiddhasya tu kā kathā |
tasmādālakṣya vai pūrvaṃ nyāyadharmo yathārthataḥ || 120 ||
8.d:
सिद्धोऽपि विप्रशार्दूल असिद्धस्य तु का कथा |
तस्मादालक्ष्य वै पूर्वं न्यायधर्मो यथार्थतः || 120 ||
8.m: even if he is an adept, O tiger among brāhmaṇas; what then of one who is not an adept? / Therefore, having first duly observed the rule of righteousness, // 120

8.s:
vaktavyamupasannasya nyāyataḥ śṛṇuyādyadi |
yo vakti nyāyarahitaṃ vinā nyāyaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ || 121 ||
8.d:
वक्तव्यमुपसन्नस्य न्यायतः शृणुयाद्यदि |
यो वक्ति न्यायरहितं विना न्यायं शृणोति यः || 121 ||
8.m: it must be spoken to one who has approached properly, if he listens according to the rule. / Whoever speaks devoid of rule, and whoever listens without rule, // 121

8.s:
tāvubhau narakaṃ ghoraṃ vrajataḥ kālamakṣayam |
jñātvaivaṃ muniśārdūla rahasyamidamuttamam || 122 ||
8.d:
तावुभौ नरकं घोरं व्रजतः कालमक्षयम् |
ज्ञात्वैवं मुनिशार्दूल रहस्यमिदमुत्तमम् || 122 ||
8.m: both of them go to a dreadful hell for an endless time. / Knowing this, O tiger among sages, this supreme secret, // 122

8.s:
sādhanaṃ bhogamokṣābhyāṃ vaktavyaṃ nāparīkṣite |
yadyatkiñcijjagatyasmiṃstattatsarvaṃ vinaśvaram || 123 ||
8.d:
साधनं भोगमोक्षाभ्यां वक्तव्यं नापरीक्षिते |
यद्यत्किञ्चिज्जगत्यस्मिंस्तत्तत्सर्वं विनश्वरम् || 123 ||
8.m: the means for enjoyment and liberation, must not be spoken to one untested. / Whatever there is in this world, all of that is perishable; // 123

8.s:
svapnavatkṣaṇamātrasya sukhadāyi dhanādikam |
samācārakriyāśśāstre māntraṃ jñānamanaśvaram || 124 ||
8.d:
स्वप्नवत्क्षणमात्रस्य सुखदायि धनादिकम् |
समाचारक्रियाश्शास्त्रे मान्त्रं ज्ञानमनश्वरम् || 124 ||
8.m: wealth and the like bestow happiness only for a moment, like a dream. / The ritual practices in the scripture and the knowledge of mantras are imperishable; // 124

8.s: anantanityasukhadaṃ vṛddhiṃ yāti kṣaṇātkṣaṇam |
8.d: अनन्तनित्यसुखदं वृद्धिं याति क्षणात्क्षणम् |
8.m: granting endless, eternal happiness, it increases from moment to moment.

8.s:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ upakaraṇamantroddhāro nāma
saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 7 ||
8.d:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां उपकरणमन्त्रोद्धारो नाम
सप्तमः पटलः || 7 ||
8.m: Thus ends the seventh chapter, named "Extraction of the Mantras of Paraphernalia", in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the venerable Pāñcarātra. // 7

9.s:
atha jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ mudrābandhākhyānaṃ nāma aṣṭamaḥ
paṭalaḥ
9.d:
अथ जयाख्यसंहितायां मुद्राबन्धाख्यानं नाम अष्टमः
पटलः
9.m: Now begins the eighth chapter in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā, named "Explanation of the Formation of Mudrās".

9.s:
asyaiva mantravṛndasya krameṇa tu yathākramam |
mudrākośaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena sannihitassadā || 1 ||
9.d:
अस्यैव मन्त्रवृन्दस्य क्रमेण तु यथाक्रमम् |
मुद्राकोशं प्रवक्ष्यामि येन सन्निहितस्सदा || 1 ||
9.m: I shall explain in due order the treasury of mudrās / belonging to this very assembly of mantras, by which He is always brought near, // 1

9.s:
p. 70) bhavecca sādhakendrāṇāṃ bhuktimuktiprasādhane |
ādau tu mūlamantrasya anyeṣāṃ tadanantaram || 2 ||
9.d:
प्. 70) भवेच्च साधकेन्द्राणां भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रसाधने |
आदौ तु मूलमन्त्रस्य अन्येषां तदनन्तरम् || 2 ||
9.m: and which serves the best of practitioners in accomplishing enjoyment and liberation: / first of the root-mantra, and after that of the others. // 2

9.s:
mudrāṃ vai bandhayenmantrī snānakāle jalāntare |
ātmano nyāsakāle tu pūjānte maṇḍalāvanau || 3 ||
9.d:
मुद्रां वै बन्धयेन्मन्त्री स्नानकाले जलान्तरे |
आत्मनो न्यासकाले तु पूजान्ते मण्डलावनौ || 3 ||
9.m: The mantrin should form the mudrā at the time of bathing, in the water; / at the time of one's own nyāsa; at the end of worship, on the ground of the maṇḍala; // 3

9.s:
arcāsu mantravinyāse arghyapātre'mbubhājane |
pūrṇāhutyavasāne ca mantre vahnyantarasthite || 4 ||
9.d:
अर्चासु मन्त्रविन्यासे अर्घ्यपात्रेऽम्बुभाजने |
पूर्णाहुत्यवसाने च मन्त्रे वह्न्यन्तरस्थिते || 4 ||
9.m: in the placement of mantras upon the icons; over the vessel of arghya and the water-jar; / and at the conclusion of the final oblation, when the mantra resides within the fire. // 4

9.s:
hiṃsakānāṃ vidhātāya sarvavighnopaśāntaye |
sarvakāryārthasidhyarthaṃ mudrākośa ihoditaḥ || 5 ||
9.d:
हिंसकानां विधाताय सर्वविघ्नोपशान्तये |
सर्वकार्यार्थसिध्यर्थं मुद्राकोश इहोदितः || 5 ||
9.m: For the destruction of harmful beings, for the pacification of all obstacles, / and for the accomplishment of the purpose of all undertakings, the treasury of mudrās is spoken of here. // 5

9.s:
adhomukhādvāmahastānmadhyamāṃ grāhayenmune |
kaniṣṭhayā dakṣiṇasya tisro'nyā muṣṭivatsthitāḥ || 6 ||
9.d:
अधोमुखाद्वामहस्तान्मध्यमां ग्राहयेन्मुने |
कनिष्ठया दक्षिणस्य तिस्रोऽन्या मुष्टिवत्स्थिताः || 6 ||
9.m: O sage, one should cause the middle finger to be grasped from the downward-facing left hand / by the little finger of the right; the other three fingers remain fist-like. // 6

9.s:
aṅguṣṭhamubhayaṃ kṛtvā mudreyaṃ tu jayā smṛtā |
adhastādgaruḍaṃ tasyā vāmahaste vicintayet || 7 ||
9.d:
अङ्गुष्ठमुभयं कृत्वा मुद्रेयं तु जया स्मृता |
अधस्ताद्गरुडं तस्या वामहस्ते विचिन्तयेत् || 7 ||
9.m: Having made both thumbs [erect], this is remembered as the Jayāmudrā. / Below it, on the left hand, one should meditate upon Garuḍa; // 7

9.s:
pṛṣṭhe syāddakṣiṇe haste dhyāyedviṣṇuṃ sanātanam |
eṣā mudrā jayā nāma sarvakāryārthasādhanī || 8 ||
9.d:
पृष्ठे स्याद्दक्षिणे हस्ते ध्यायेद्विष्णुं सनातनम् |
एषा मुद्रा जया नाम सर्वकार्यार्थसाधनी || 8 ||
9.m: on the back, on the right hand, one should meditate upon eternal Viṣṇu. / This mudrā is called Jayā, accomplishing the goal of all rites; // 8
one should employ it for the God of gods accompanied by Tārkṣya.
Having extended the left hand face-up, the fingers remain separated; // 9

9.s:
kāryāstvākuñcitāḥ prāntādaṅguṣṭhaṃ setuvadbhavet |
sammukhaṃ tāsu saṃlagnaṃ karaśākhāsu madhyataḥ || 10 ||
9.d:
कार्यास्त्वाकुञ्चिताः प्रान्तादङ्गुष्ठं सेतुवद्भवेत् |
सम्मुखं तासु संलग्नं करशाखासु मध्यतः || 10 ||
9.m: they are to be curved from the tip, and the thumb should be like a bridge, / facing forward, joined at the center of those finger-branches. // 10

9.s:
hṛtsammukhaṃ tu badhnīyācchaktimudrāṃ sukhapradām |
śaktiyuktasya dehasya mudrā vai sannidhāpanī || 11 ||
9.d:
हृत्सम्मुखं तु बध्नीयाच्छक्तिमुद्रां सुखप्रदाम् |
शक्तियुक्तस्य देहस्य मुद्रा वै सन्निधापनी || 11 ||
9.m: One should form facing the heart the bliss-bestowing Śaktimudrā; / it is the mudrā that brings about the presence of the body endowed with śakti. // 11
Know it to be [formed] with the forefinger […] in worship of Lakṣmī and the śaktis.
With the right hand, one should form a clenched fist. // 12

9.s:
aṅguṣṭhaṃ karamadhyasthaṃ kṛtvā yojyaṃ hṛdi dvija |
hṛdayākhyā bhavenmudrā sarvamantreṣu sādhanī || 13 ||
9.d:
अङ्गुष्ठं करमध्यस्थं कृत्वा योज्यं हृदि द्विज |
हृदयाख्या भवेन्मुद्रा सर्वमन्त्रेषु साधनी || 13 ||
9.m: Having placed the thumb in the middle of the hand, it is to be applied to the heart, O twice-born; / this becomes the mudrā called Hṛdaya, accomplishing all mantras. // 13

9.s:
prasṛtā aṅgulīssarvā aṅguṣṭhena tu saṃspṛśet |
p. 71) śiromudreti vikhyātā mantrasannidhikāriṇī || 14 ||
9.d:
प्रसृता अङ्गुलीस्सर्वा अङ्गुष्ठेन तु संस्पृशेत् |
प्. 71) शिरोमुद्रेति विख्याता मन्त्रसन्निधिकारिणी || 14 ||
9.m: One should touch all extended fingers with the thumb; / it is known as the Śiromudrā, bringing about the presence of the mantra. // 14

9.s:
muṣṭiṃ badhvā śikhāsthāne tarjanī cordhvasaṃsthitā |
śikhāmudreti vikhyātā sarvaduṣṭakṣayaṅkarī || 15 ||
9.d:
मुष्टिं बध्वा शिखास्थाने तर्जनी चोर्ध्वसंस्थिता |
शिखामुद्रेति विख्याता सर्वदुष्टक्षयङ्करी || 15 ||
9.m: Forming a fist at the place of the śikhā, with the forefinger held upright, / is known as the Śikhāmudrā, which destroys all wicked beings. // 15

9.s:
doṣavighnavināśāya sadā hyeṣā prakīrtitā |
ādau tasmātprayatnena yāgaveśmani bandhayet || 16 ||
9.d:
दोषविघ्नविनाशाय सदा ह्येषा प्रकीर्तिता |
आदौ तस्मात्प्रयत्नेन यागवेश्मनि बन्धयेत् || 16 ||
9.m: For it is taught always to destroy faults and obstacles; / therefore, one should form it with effort in the sacrificial pavilion at the outset. // 16
Accompanied by the mantra, it accomplishes the eradication of all obstacles.
O twice-born, the tips of the fingers of both hands are interlocked; // 17

9.s:
tayormadhyaṃ hyasaṃśliṣṭaṃ karabandhādhito bhavet |
vārmaṇyeṣā bhavenmudrā dvāvaṃsāvanayā spṛśet || 18 ||
9.d:
तयोर्मध्यं ह्यसंश्लिष्टं करबन्धाधितो भवेत् |
वार्मण्येषा भवेन्मुद्रा द्वावंसावनया स्पृशेत् || 18 ||
9.m: the space between them should be unjoined, down to the wrist-joint. / This is the mudrā for armor; one should touch both shoulders with it. // 18

9.s:
durbhedyā duṣṭasaṅghasya bhūtavetālayoginām |
karmakāle ca badhnīyātsamantrāṃ ca prayatnataḥ || 19 ||
9.d:
दुर्भेद्या दुष्टसङ्घस्य भूतवेतालयोगिनाम् |
कर्मकाले च बध्नीयात्समन्त्रां च प्रयत्नतः || 19 ||
9.m: It cannot be penetrated by the host of evil beings, by bhūtas, vetālas, and yogins. / One should form it with effort, along with its mantra, at the time of ritual action. // 19

9.s:
karayorgrathitāṅgulyassaṃvṛtāḥ pāṇipṛṣṭhagāḥ |
tarjanyau prāntasaṃlagne suṣirecorcite tayoḥ || 20 ||
9.d:
करयोर्ग्रथिताङ्गुल्यस्संवृताः पाणिपृष्ठगाः |
तर्जन्यौ प्रान्तसंलग्ने सुषिरेचोर्चिते तयोः || 20 ||
9.m: The fingers of both hands are entwined and enclosed, resting on the backs of the hands; / the two forefingers are joined at the tips and placed at the two hollows, // 20

9.s:
aṅguṣṭhau mūlasaṃlagnaviparyastau parasparam |
locanākhyā bhavenmudrā darśayeccakṣuṣo'ntike || 21 ||
9.d:
अङ्गुष्ठौ मूलसंलग्नविपर्यस्तौ परस्परम् |
लोचनाख्या भवेन्मुद्रा दर्शयेच्चक्षुषोऽन्तिके || 21 ||
9.m: the two thumbs are crossed, joined at their bases to one another. / This is the mudrā named Locanā; one should display it near the two eyes. // 21

9.s:
tarjanīṃ sphoṭayeddikṣu daśasvaṅguṣṭhakena tu |
drutaṃ karadvayenaiva cakṣurbhyāṃ sannirīkṣayet || 22 ||
9.d:
तर्जनीं स्फोटयेद्दिक्षु दशस्वङ्गुष्ठकेन तु |
द्रुतं करद्वयेनैव चक्षुर्भ्यां सन्निरीक्षयेत् || 22 ||
9.m: One should snap the forefinger with the thumb in the ten directions / swiftly with both hands, and gaze steadily with both eyes. // 22

9.s:
astramudreti vikhyātā trāsinī tridaśeṣvapi |
kiṃ punarduṣṭayonīnāṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃyutā || 23 ||
9.d:
अस्त्रमुद्रेति विख्याता त्रासिनी त्रिदशेष्वपि |
किं पुनर्दुष्टयोनीनां वाङ्मनःकायसंयुता || 23 ||
9.m: It is known as the Astramudrā, which terrifies even the gods, / let alone those born of wicked wombs, endowed with speech, mind, and body. // 23

9.s:
uttāne dakṣiṇe vāme kuñcayitvā'ṅgulitrayam |
prasārayecca tiryagvai aṅguṣṭhaṃ tarjanīṃ tathā || 24 ||
9.d:
उत्ताने दक्षिणे वामे कुञ्चयित्वाऽङ्गुलित्रयम् |
प्रसारयेच्च तिर्यग्वै अङ्गुष्ठं तर्जनीं तथा || 24 ||
9.m: With the right hand palm-up and the left hand [palm-down], bending three fingers, / one should extend sideways both the thumb and the forefinger. // 24
The gaze should be slightly raised, looking downwards, accompanied by a steady stare; / it destroys the bondage of nooses and removes all afflictions. // 25
This is the Siṃhamudrā, named Vismayā, of great splendor.
One should press the middle finger between the forefinger and the thumb; // 26

9.s:
prasārayedanāmāṃ ca paścāttasyāḥ kaniṣṭhikām |
parasparaṃ ca dūrasthe mudraiṣā kapilī smṛtā || 27 ||
9.d:
प्रसारयेदनामां च पश्चात्तस्याः कनिष्ठिकाम् |
परस्परं च दूरस्थे मुद्रैषा कपिली स्मृता || 27 ||
9.m: one should extend the ring finger, and after that the little finger, / placed far apart from one another. This is remembered as the Kapilī mudrā. // 27
It grants all accomplishments and accomplishes [siddhis] such as aṇimā.
When the left hand faces downward, and the middle and ring fingers // 28

9.s:
aṅguṣṭhasya tu saṃsakte kaniṣṭhā tarjanīdvayam |
prasāritaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ mudrā kroḍātmikā smṛtā || 29 ||
9.d:
अङ्गुष्ठस्य तु संसक्ते कनिष्ठा तर्जनीद्वयम् |
प्रसारितं ततः कार्यं मुद्रा क्रोडात्मिका स्मृता || 29 ||
9.m: are joined to the thumb, and the pair of the little finger and the forefinger / is then extended, it is remembered as the mudrā having the nature of Kroḍa. // 29

9.s:
sarvayantrapramathanī sarvaduṣṭanivāriṇī |
sve sve sthāne niyoktavyā mudrāvaktreṣu yā sthitā || 30 ||
9.d:
सर्वयन्त्रप्रमथनी सर्वदुष्टनिवारिणी |
स्वे स्वे स्थाने नियोक्तव्या मुद्रावक्त्रेषु या स्थिता || 30 ||
9.m: It shatters all yantras and turns away all wicked beings; / standing upon the mudrā-faces, it is to be employed in its respective place. // 30

9.s:
madhyamānāmikānyūnā muṣṭivatpāṇimadhyagāḥ |
ubhayorhastayorvipra paścānmuṣṭidvayaṃ tu tat || 31 ||
9.d:
मध्यमानामिकान्यूना मुष्टिवत्पाणिमध्यगाः |
उभयोर्हस्तयोर्विप्र पश्चान्मुष्टिद्वयं तु तत् || 31 ||
9.m: The fingers, excluding the middle and ring fingers, are held like a fist in the middle of the hands / of both hands, O vipra; then, those two fists // 31

9.s:
śleṣayetsamarandhreṇa tarjanyau dve prasārya ca |
tataḥ saṃśleṣayedagrādaṅguṣṭhāgre niyojayet || 32 ||
9.d:
श्लेषयेत्समरन्ध्रेण तर्जन्यौ द्वे प्रसार्य च |
ततः संश्लेषयेदग्रादङ्गुष्ठाग्रे नियोजयेत् || 32 ||
9.m: one should join with equal openings, extending both forefingers; / then, joining them from the tip, one should place them at the tips of the thumbs, // 32

9.s:
madhyatastarjanībhyāṃ tu anyonyena krameṇa tu |
mudraiṣā kaustubhasyoktā mālāmudrāmatho śṛṇu || 33 ||
9.d:
मध्यतस्तर्जनीभ्यां तु अन्योन्येन क्रमेण तु |
मुद्रैषा कौस्तुभस्योक्ता मालामुद्रामथो शृणु || 33 ||
9.m: from the middle, with both forefingers successively with each other. / This is declared as the mudrā of the Kaustubha. Now hear the Mālāmudrā. // 33

9.s:
śākhāṣṭakaṃ karābhyāṃ yadgrastamagrānadūrataḥ |
saṃślakṣṇaṃ lambamānaṃ ca upaviṣṭo'tha vāsthitaḥ || 34 ||
9.d:
शाखाष्टकं कराभ्यां यद्ग्रस्तमग्रानदूरतः |
संश्लक्ष्णं लम्बमानं च उपविष्टोऽथ वास्थितः || 34 ||
9.m: When the eight fingers of the two hands are interlocked near their tips, / smooth and hanging downward, seated or standing, // 34

9.s:
kuryādbāhudvayaṃ vipra ūrumadhyāvalambitam |
maṇibandhāvadhau samyaṅmālāmudrā prakīrtitā || 35 ||
9.d:
कुर्याद्बाहुद्वयं विप्र ऊरुमध्यावलम्बितम् |
मणिबन्धावधौ सम्यङ्मालामुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता || 35 ||
9.m: O vipra, one should make the two arms hang down between the thighs, / level with the wrists; it is proclaimed as the Mālāmudrā. // 35

9.s:
aṅguṣṭhau saṅgatau lagnau aṅgulyo viralāḥ sthitāḥ |
pādmī hyeṣā bhavenmudrā puṣṭisaubhāgyadāyikā || 36 ||
9.d:
अङ्गुष्ठौ सङ्गतौ लग्नौ अङ्गुल्यो विरलाः स्थिताः |
पाद्मी ह्येषा भवेन्मुद्रा पुष्टिसौभाग्यदायिका || 36 ||
9.m: The two thumbs are joined together, touching, while the fingers remain separated; / this is the Pādmī mudrā, granting nourishment and good fortune. // 36

9.s:
muṣṭinā grāhayedvāmamaṅguṣṭhaṃ dakṣiṇena tu |
aṅgulīrvāmahastāttu dakṣiṇasyopari nyaset || 37 ||
9.d:
मुष्टिना ग्राहयेद्वाममङ्गुष्ठं दक्षिणेन तु |
अङ्गुलीर्वामहस्तात्तु दक्षिणस्योपरि न्यसेत् || 37 ||
9.m: One should grasp the left thumb with the fist of the right hand, / and place the fingers of the left hand over the right. // 37

9.s:
p. 73) vāmatarjanikāgraṃ tu aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ ca dakṣiṇāt |
parasparaṃ sammukhaṃ tu suśliṣṭaṃ viniyojayet || 38 ||
9.d:
प्. 73) वामतर्जनिकाग्रं तु अङ्गुष्ठाग्रं च दक्षिणात् |
परस्परं सम्मुखं तु सुश्लिष्टं विनियोजयेत् || 38 ||
9.m: The tip of the left forefinger and the tip of the right thumb / one should join closely, facing each other. // 38

9.s: śaṅkhasyaiṣā bhavenmudrā uttānā tu yadā sthitā |
9.d: शङ्खस्यैषा भवेन्मुद्रा उत्ताना तु यदा स्थिता |
9.m: This is the mudrā of the Śaṅkha when it is held palm upward.
The two hands are distinctly extended and joined to each other; // 39

9.s:
bhramaṇāccakravattau tu cakramudreti kīrtitā |
nāśinī sarvaduḥkhānāṃ mudrāṇāṃ bhedinī parā || 40 ||
9.d:
भ्रमणाच्चक्रवत्तौ तु चक्रमुद्रेति कीर्तिता |
नाशिनी सर्वदुःखानां मुद्राणां भेदिनी परा || 40 ||
