9.m: because of rotation like a wheel, they are proclaimed as the Cakramudrā, / which destroys all sorrows and breaks through other mudrās. // 40

9.s:
badhvā muṣṭiṃ dakṣiṇena vāmāṅguṣṭhasya mūrdhani |
kṛtvaivaṃ darśayedeṣā kaumodakyāḥ suśobhanā || 41 ||
9.d:
बध्वा मुष्टिं दक्षिणेन वामाङ्गुष्ठस्य मूर्धनि |
कृत्वैवं दर्शयेदेषा कौमोदक्याः सुशोभना || 41 ||
9.m: Forming a fist with the right hand on the head of the left thumb, / having made it thus, one should display it; this is the very beautiful [mudrā] of Kaumodakī. // 41
It is known as the Gadāmudrā, which crushes the army of faults.

9.s: prasārya saṃhataṃ kṛtvā purā pāṇidvayaṃ dvija || 42 ||
9.d: प्रसार्य संहतं कृत्वा पुरा पाणिद्वयं द्विज || 42 ||
9.m: First extending both hands and bringing them together, O twice-born, // 42

9.s:
anāmā mūladeśābhyāmaṅguṣṭhāgradvayaṃ nyaset |
adhomukhaṃ tu patitaṃ maṇibandhasya sammukham || 43 ||
9.d:
अनामा मूलदेशाभ्यामङ्गुष्ठाग्रद्वयं न्यसेत् |
अधोमुखं तु पतितं मणिबन्धस्य सम्मुखम् || 43 ||
9.m: one should place the tips of both thumbs at the bases of the ring fingers, / turned downward and falling facing the wrist. // 43

9.s:
suśliṣṭamagrataḥ kṛtvā nyasettaccāṅgulidvayam |
tarjanīmadhyamābhyāṃ yadvāmaṃ yugmaṃ karadvayāt || 44 ||
9.d:
सुश्लिष्टमग्रतः कृत्वा न्यसेत्तच्चाङ्गुलिद्वयम् |
तर्जनीमध्यमाभ्यां यद्वामं युग्मं करद्वयात् || 44 ||
9.m: Joining them closely at the front, one should place those two fingers; / the pair of the forefinger and middle finger on the left of both hands // 44

9.s:
procchritaṃ viralaṃ kuryātkuñcitaṃ cāpi sammukham |
suspaṣṭamucchritaṃ lagnaṃ pucchavatkanyasāyugam || 45 ||
9.d:
प्रोच्छ्रितं विरलं कुर्यात्कुञ्चितं चापि सम्मुखम् |
सुस्पष्टमुच्छ्रितं लग्नं पुच्छवत्कन्यसायुगम् || 45 ||
9.m: one should raise upright, separate, and bend facing forward; / the pair of little fingers is clearly raised and joined like a tail. // 45
This is the mudrā of the King of Birds alone, the Great-Souled One.
Extending the right hand, then the thumb and the little finger // 46

9.s:
melayedagradeśācca setuvatkaraṇena tu |
phaṇavatkuñcitaṃ lagnaṃ tarjanyādyaṃ latātrayam || 47 ||
9.d:
मेलयेदग्रदेशाच्च सेतुवत्करणेन तु |
फणवत्कुञ्चितं लग्नं तर्जन्याद्यं लतात्रयम् || 47 ||
9.m: one should join at their tips, making it like a bridge; / the three creeper-like [fingers] beginning with the forefinger are bent like a hood and joined. // 47
This is the Pāśamudrā. Learn from me the one named Aṅkuśa. // 48

9.s:
kaniṣṭhā madhyamā nāma vāmahastasya madhyataḥ |
pṛṣṭhavannikṣipetpṛṣṭhe tāsāmaṅguṣṭakaṃ bhavet || 49 ||
9.d:
कनिष्ठा मध्यमा नाम वामहस्तस्य मध्यतः |
पृष्ठवन्निक्षिपेत्पृष्ठे तासामङ्गुष्टकं भवेत् || 49 ||
9.m: The little finger, the middle finger, and the ring finger, from the middle of the left hand, / one should cast back onto the back; their thumb should be [there]. // 49

9.s:
agratastarjanī kāryā kuñcitāṅkuśavaddvija |
ityeṣā'ṅkuśamudraiva satyādīnāmatho śṛṇu || 50 ||
9.d:
अग्रतस्तर्जनी कार्या कुञ्चिताङ्कुशवद्द्विज |
इत्येषाऽङ्कुशमुद्रैव सत्यादीनामथो शृणु || 50 ||
9.m: In front, the forefinger should be bent like an elephant-goad, O twice-born; / such is the Aṅkuśamudrā. Now hear the mudrās of Satya and the others. // 50
[The Five Mudrās of Satya and Others]

9.s:
dakṣiṇasya tu hastasya agrato'ṅgulipañcakam |
parasparaṃ spṛśetkāryaṃ pronnataṃ mukhasammukham || 51 ||
9.d:
दक्षिणस्य तु हस्तस्य अग्रतोऽङ्गुलिपञ्चकम् |
परस्परं स्पृशेत्कार्यं प्रोन्नतं मुखसम्मुखम् || 51 ||
9.m: At the front of the right hand, the five fingers / should touch one another, held raised facing the face. // 51

9.s:
satyasyaiṣā bhavenmudrā prāgupāṅgodbhavasya ca |
aṅguṣṭhatarjanīyogāddvitīyasya prakīrtitā || 52 ||
9.d:
सत्यस्यैषा भवेन्मुद्रा प्रागुपाङ्गोद्भवस्य च |
अङ्गुष्ठतर्जनीयोगाद्द्वितीयस्य प्रकीर्तिता || 52 ||
9.m: This is the mudrā of Satya, who arose as the first minor aṅga; / by joining the thumb and forefinger, [the mudrā] of the second is declared. // 52
By joining the thumb and middle finger, [the mudrā] of the third is declared; / and by joining the thumb and ring finger, O Nārada, of the fourth. // 53
And from joining the little finger and the thumb, [the mudrā] of the fifth arises.

9.s:
hṛllagnaṃ vāmahastaṃ tu kṛtvottānaṃ prasāritam |
pṛṣṭhe tu muṣṭibandhaṃ tu dakṣiṇena kareṇa tu || 54 ||
9.d:
हृल्लग्नं वामहस्तं तु कृत्वोत्तानं प्रसारितम् |
पृष्ठे तु मुष्टिबन्धं तु दक्षिणेन करेण तु || 54 ||
9.m: Having placed the left hand against the heart, turned upwards and extended, / one should form a fist with the right hand on its back. // 54

9.s:
muṣṭerūrdhvaṃ sthito'ṅguṣṭhaṃ cakṣurbhyāmavalokitam |
daivī hyeṣā bhavenmudrā mantrarājasya suvrata || 55 ||
9.d:
मुष्टेरूर्ध्वं स्थितोऽङ्गुष्ठं चक्षुर्भ्यामवलोकितम् |
दैवी ह्येषा भवेन्मुद्रा मन्त्रराजस्य सुव्रत || 55 ||
9.m: The thumb held upright above the fist should be gazed at with both eyes. / For this divine mudrā belongs to the king of mantras, O you of noble vows! // 55
Known as Mahājayā, it accomplishes every yoga, / ever grants all attainments, and fulfills every mudrā. // 56

9.s:
anayā mudritaṃ viśvamābrahmabhāvanāntimam |
sarvāṅgaśaktiyuktasya sarvamantrālayasya ca || 57 ||
9.d:
अनया मुद्रितं विश्वमाब्रह्मभावनान्तिमम् |
सर्वाङ्गशक्तियुक्तस्य सर्वमन्त्रालयस्य च || 57 ||
9.m: By it the universe is sealed, ending with the contemplation of Brahman; / [it belongs to the king of mantras,] which is endowed with the power of all parts, contains all mantras, // 57

9.s:
niṣkalasyāvikārasya brahmansaptākṣarasya ca |
ityeṣa garbhamantrāṇāmukto mudrāgaṇo mayā || 58 ||
9.d:
निष्कलस्याविकारस्य ब्रह्मन्सप्ताक्षरस्य च |
इत्येष गर्भमन्त्राणामुक्तो मुद्रागणो मया || 58 ||
9.m: is partless, unchangeable, and consists of seven syllables, O Brahmin. / Thus has been declared by me this group of mudrās for the core mantras. // 58
Hear the characteristic of the mudrās of the support-throne mantras.
[The Mudrā of Ādhāraśakti and Kūrma]
A pair of fingers is placed inside the two fists, O twice-born: // 59

9.s:
vāmasya dakṣiṇo muṣṭiḥ pṛṣṭhe syātsparśavarjitaḥ |
asāvādhāraśaktau ca ūrdhvataḥ kūrmavahni (ddvi?)ja || 60 ||
9.d:
वामस्य दक्षिणो मुष्टिः पृष्ठे स्यात्स्पर्शवर्जितः |
असावाधारशक्तौ च ऊर्ध्वतः कूर्मवह्नि (द्द्वि?)ज || 60 ||
9.m: the right fist should be on the back of the left, without touching it. / This [mudrā] is for Ādhāraśakti, and above it for Kūrma, O twice-born. // 60

9.s:
adhomukhasya vāmasya anāmā tarjanī ubhe |
ākuṃcya pṛṣṭhalagne tu madhyamāyāṃ tu saṃsthite || 61 ||
9.d:
अधोमुखस्य वामस्य अनामा तर्जनी उभे |
आकुंच्य पृष्ठलग्ने तु मध्यमायां तु संस्थिते || 61 ||
9.m: Of the left hand turned downward, both the ring finger and forefinger / are bent, resting on the back and positioned alongside the middle finger. // 61

9.s:
tayoradhastānmadhyākhyāmṛjvīṃ kuryādadhomukhām |
kaniṣṭhikā tu sāṅguṣṭhā kāryā suprasṛtā mune || 62 ||
9.d:
तयोरधस्तान्मध्याख्यामृज्वीं कुर्यादधोमुखाम् |
कनिष्ठिका तु साङ्गुष्ठा कार्या सुप्रसृता मुने || 62 ||
9.m: Beneath them one should make the [finger] called the middle one straight and pointing downwards; / and the little finger together with the thumb should be fully extended, O sage. // 62

9.s:
p. 75) anantāsanamudreyamanenāsyā(khyā?)yate dvija |
sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ hyeṣā kroḍīkṛtya ca vartate || 63 ||
9.d:
प्. 75) अनन्तासनमुद्रेयमनेनास्या(ख्या?)यते द्विज |
सर्वं जगदिदं ह्येषा क्रोडीकृत्य च वर्तते || 63 ||
9.m: This is the Anantāsana mudrā, designated by this [name], O twice-born; / for it encompasses this entire world. // 63

9.s:
sarvāsvādhāramudrāsu prādhānyena vyavasthitā |
tasyādau mantramuccārya plutaṃ ca bahumātṛkam || 64 ||
9.d:
सर्वास्वाधारमुद्रासु प्राधान्येन व्यवस्थिता |
तस्यादौ मन्त्रमुच्चार्य प्लुतं च बहुमातृकम् || 64 ||
9.m: It stands preeminent among all the support-mudrās. / At its beginning, having uttered the prolonged mantra consisting of many morae, // 64

9.s:
śabdaśakyavibhāgotthaṃ bhāvagrāhyamanāhatam |
tatastasya visarge tu anantāsanasaṃjñayā || 65 ||
9.d:
शब्दशक्यविभागोत्थं भावग्राह्यमनाहतम् |
ततस्तस्य विसर्गे तु अनन्तासनसंज्ञया || 65 ||
9.m: arisen from that which cannot be divided by words, graspable through contemplation, unstruck, / then upon its emission, under the designation of Anantāsana, // 65

9.s:
baddhaṃ prakalpayedvipra sadbhāvadhyānasaṃyutam |
sadādhikārayāge tu mantrāṇāṃ bhinnarūpiṇām || 66 ||
9.d:
बद्धं प्रकल्पयेद्विप्र सद्भावध्यानसंयुतम् |
सदाधिकारयागे तु मन्त्राणां भिन्नरूपिणाम् || 66 ||
9.m: the vipra should form [the mudrā], joined with meditation on true reality. / In the daily sacrifice of ritual authority belonging to the various mantras, // 66
it should be applied with effort for the swift accomplishment of the rite.
One should first form two connected fists with both hands: // 67

9.s:
aṅgulitritayenaiva aṅguṣṭhe tarjanīdvayam |
prāntalagnaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tadyuge melayetpunaḥ || 68 ||
9.d:
अङ्गुलित्रितयेनैव अङ्गुष्ठे तर्जनीद्वयम् |
प्रान्तलग्नं ततः कृत्वा तद्युगे मेलयेत्पुनः || 68 ||
9.m: with three fingers [closed], one joins both forefingers at their tips / on the thumbs, and then unites that pair again. // 68

9.s: eṣā tu pārthivī mudrā sāmudrīmadhunā śṛṇu |
9.d: एषा तु पार्थिवी मुद्रा सामुद्रीमधुना शृणु |
9.m: This is the mudrā of the Earth; now hear that of the Ocean.
The wrists are joined together, and the tips of the nails of both hands // 69

9.s:
kāryāṇi sāṅgulīkāni parasparamukhāni tu |
aṅguṣṭhāgre nirādhāre tanmadhye cālayeddhṛtam || 70 ||
9.d:
कार्याणि साङ्गुलीकानि परस्परमुखानि तु |
अङ्गुष्ठाग्रे निराधारे तन्मध्ये चालयेद्धृतम् || 70 ||
9.m: along with the fingers should be made facing one another; / unsupported, one should gently move the two thumb-tips in their middle. // 70

9.s:
madhyaṃ kuryācca hastābhyāṃ gādhaṃ tu suṣiropamam |
kṣīrārṇavasya mudraiṣā prāguktā paṅkajasya tu || 71 ||
9.d:
मध्यं कुर्याच्च हस्ताभ्यां गाधं तु सुषिरोपमम् |
क्षीरार्णवस्य मुद्रैषा प्रागुक्ता पङ्कजस्य तु || 71 ||
9.m: And one should make the center of the two hands deep like a cavity. / This is the mudrā of the Milk Ocean; that of the lotus was previously declared. // 71
Through association with the mantra and through meditation, difference indeed arises.
[The Four Mudrās of Dharma and the Rest]
Having made the two hands not touching, one should then unite them, // 72

9.s:
mukhe mukhaṃ tarjanībhyāṃ taṃ muñcedatha madhyayoḥ |
kuryāttāddṛgvidhaṃ bandhaṃ taṃ tyaktvā'nāmikādvaye || 73 ||
9.d:
मुखे मुखं तर्जनीभ्यां तं मुञ्चेदथ मध्ययोः |
कुर्यात्ताद्दृग्विधं बन्धं तं त्यक्त्वाऽनामिकाद्वये || 73 ||
9.m: tip to tip with the two forefingers; one should release that, and then between the two middle fingers / form a similar arrangement; releasing that, upon the two ring fingers; // 73

9.s:
upasaṃhṛtya taṃ cāpi dve kaniṣṭhe niyojayet |
pratyekabandhe saṃlagnamaṅguṣṭhayugalaṃ nyaset || 74 ||
9.d:
उपसंहृत्य तं चापि द्वे कनिष्ठे नियोजयेत् |
प्रत्येकबन्धे संलग्नमङ्गुष्ठयुगलं न्यसेत् || 74 ||
9.m: and withdrawing that as well, one should join the two little fingers. / In each arrangement one should place the joined pair of thumbs. // 74
Know this group of mudrās in sequence for the tetrad beginning with Dharma. // 75
[The mudrā] of the lotus situated above that was previously spoken of, through mantra application.
[The Mudrā of the Three Abodes Characterized by the Sun, Moon, and Fire]
Joining the forefinger and thumb of the right hand, // 76

9.s:
kṛtvā tadanu tadbandhaṃ vikāsya ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
samuttānaṃ punaḥ kuryācchākhāsaṅghaṃ pṛthaksthitam || 77 ||
9.d:
कृत्वा तदनु तद्बन्धं विकास्य च शनैः शनैः |
समुत्तानं पुनः कुर्याच्छाखासङ्घं पृथक्स्थितम् || 77 ||
9.m: and then gradually opening that formation, / one should again make the group of fingers held separately, facing upwards. // 77

9.s: dhāmatrayasya mudraiṣā haṃsākhyāṃ tu nibodha me |
9.d: धामत्रयस्य मुद्रैषा हंसाख्यां तु निबोध मे |
9.m: This is the mudrā of the three abodes; now learn from me the one named Haṃsa.
One should hold the two hands distinct and spread out, in the form of an añjali. // 78

9.s:
bhāvāsanasya mudraiṣā suśuddhā paramārthakī |
eṣa āsanamantrāṇāṃ mudrābandho mayoditaḥ || 79 ||
9.d:
भावासनस्य मुद्रैषा सुशुद्धा परमार्थकी |
एष आसनमन्त्राणां मुद्राबन्धो मयोदितः || 79 ||
9.m: This is the mudrā of the seat of contemplation, purely clean and ultimate. / Thus has been declared by me the formation of mudrās for the throne-mantras. // 79
In sequence, O best of sages, for the seeds beginning with Kṣetreśa / and ending with the Lord of the Lotus Treasure, the ten mudrās are proclaimed: // 80
Interlocking the fingers of both hands, / one should press firmly and make both thumbs raised upright. // 81
This is the mudrā of Kṣetrapāla. Now hear from me [the mudrās] of Śrī and the others.

9.s: uttānau tu karau kṛtvā nikaṭasthau tu nārada || 82 ||
9.d: उत्तानौ तु करौ कृत्वा निकटस्थौ तु नारद || 82 ||
9.m: Turning both hands face upwards and holding them close, O Nārada, // 82

9.s:
tadaṅgulīgaṇaṃ sarvaṃ kuñcitaṃ madhyasaṃsthitam |
aṅguṣṭhau patitau kṛtvā kramaśaḥ spaṣṭatāṃ nayet || 83 ||
9.d:
तदङ्गुलीगणं सर्वं कुञ्चितं मध्यसंस्थितम् |
अङ्गुष्ठौ पतितौ कृत्वा क्रमशः स्पष्टतां नयेत् || 83 ||
9.m: all the fingers are bent and held in the middle; / letting the thumbs drop, one should gradually bring them to clarity. // 83

9.s: śrībījasya tu mudraiṣā prathamaṃ kathitā tava |
9.d: श्रीबीजस्य तु मुद्रैषा प्रथमं कथिता तव |
9.m: This mudrā of the seed of Śrī is told to you first.
Raising the forefinger from the left hand, it arises for the seed of Caṇḍa. // 84
Know indeed that very [finger raised] from the right hand for the one named Pracaṇḍa.
Raising the middle finger from the left hand, [the mudrā] is of Jaya; // 85
from the right, it is declared for the seed named Vijaya. // 86
And raising the ring finger as before from the left, know that for Gāṅga.
From the right, the mudrā is declared for the seed named Yāmuna, O Nārada. // 87
For the treasure-guardian Śaṅkha, [it is] the little finger from the left hand.
For the one named Padma, when that same [finger] is raised up from the other hand. // 88

9.s:
dakṣiṇena tu hastena sāṅguṣṭhena ca muṣṭinā |
pradeśinīṃ hyanāmāṃ ca vāmahastasya pīḍayet || 89 ||
9.d:
दक्षिणेन तु हस्तेन साङ्गुष्ठेन च मुष्टिना |
प्रदेशिनीं ह्यनामां च वामहस्तस्य पीडयेत् || 89 ||
9.m: With the right hand forming a fist with the thumb, / he should press the forefinger and ring finger of the left hand. // 89

9.s:
prayatnakṛtaśaṅkhānāṃ pṛṣṭhe yojyā ca madhyamā |
lambamānakarākārā yathā saṃdṛśyate ca sā || 90 ||
9.d:
प्रयत्नकृतशङ्खानां पृष्ठे योज्या च मध्यमा |
लम्बमानकराकारा यथा संदृश्यते च सा || 90 ||
9.m: The middle finger is to be joined to the back of the conch carefully formed, / so that it is seen having the shape of a hanging trunk. // 90
One should visualize the little finger from the left hand, not situated too close to the fist / and outside the right thumb, like a tusk. // 91

9.s:
īṣattiryaktatassapaṣṭo vāmāṅguṣṭhastathā paraḥ |
yathā tau paridṛśyete gajakarṇopamau dvija || 92 ||
9.d:
ईषत्तिर्यक्ततस्सपष्टो वामाङ्गुष्ठस्तथा परः |
यथा तौ परिदृश्येते गजकर्णोपमौ द्विज || 92 ||
9.m: Then, slightly obliquely distinct, the left thumb and likewise the other [thumb], / so that the two appear resembling elephant ears, O twice-born. // 92
This is the mudrā of the lord of Gaṇas, which destroys all obstacles.

9.s: suśliṣṭau maṇibandhau tu kṛtvā pāṇidvaye purā || 93 ||
9.d: सुश्लिष्टौ मणिबन्धौ तु कृत्वा पाणिद्वये पुरा || 93 ||
9.m: Having first brought the two wrists together closely in the two hands, // 93

9.s:
saṃlagnamagradeśāttu pronnataṃ madhyamāyutam |
pradeśinīdvayaṃ tadvatkṛtvā'nāmāyugaṃ tathā || 94 ||
9.d:
संलग्नमग्रदेशात्तु प्रोन्नतं मध्यमायुतम् |
प्रदेशिनीद्वयं तद्वत्कृत्वाऽनामायुगं तथा || 94 ||
9.m: joining [them] at the tips, upright, along with the middle finger, / likewise making the pair of forefingers and so too the pair of ring fingers // 94

9.s:
acalaṃ dviguṇīkṛtya namayettadadhomukham |
śanaiḥ śanaiḥspṛśedyāvatsvaṃ svaṃ pāṇitalaṃ dvija || 95 ||
9.d:
अचलं द्विगुणीकृत्य नमयेत्तदधोमुखम् |
शनैः शनैःस्पृशेद्यावत्स्वं स्वं पाणितलं द्विज || 95 ||
9.m: motionless, doubled over, he should bend them face downward / slowly until each touches its own palm, O twice-born. // 95

9.s:
spaṣṭaṃ suviralaṃ kuryādaṅguṣṭhadvitayaṃ dvija |
tadvatkanīyasīyugmaṃ samena dharaṇena tu || 96 ||
9.d:
स्पष्टं सुविरलं कुर्यादङ्गुष्ठद्वितयं द्विज |
तद्वत्कनीयसीयुग्मं समेन धरणेन तु || 96 ||
9.m: He should keep the pair of thumbs clearly well separated, O twice-born; / likewise the pair of little fingers, held evenly. // 96

9.s:
mudraiṣā vāgviśrūtyarthī yo badhnāti dine dine |
japamānastu tadbhāvī tasya cāvatarettu dhīḥ || 97 ||
9.d:
मुद्रैषा वाग्विश्रूत्यर्थी यो बध्नाति दिने दिने |
जपमानस्तु तद्भावी तस्य चावतरेत्तु धीः || 97 ||
9.m: He who, desiring eloquence in speech, binds this mudrā day after day / while reciting [the mantra] and intent on that, his intellect descends [upon him]. // 97

9.s:
sammukhau saṃpuṭīkṛtya dvau hastau saṃprasāritau |
viniyojyau lalāṭordhve śirasā'vanatena tu || 98 ||
9.d:
सम्मुखौ संपुटीकृत्य द्वौ हस्तौ संप्रसारितौ |
विनियोज्यौ ललाटोर्ध्वे शिरसाऽवनतेन तु || 98 ||
9.m: Having cupped the two hands extended face-to-face, / they are to be placed above the forehead with bowed head. // 98

9.s: p. 78) gurorgurutarasyāpi mudrā hyeṣā pituḥ pituḥ |
9.d: प्. 78) गुरोर्गुरुतरस्यापि मुद्रा ह्येषा पितुः पितुः |
9.m: p. 78) This is the mudrā of the guru, and also of the higher guru, the father's father.
Having turned the right hand upwards, then / bending slightly the fingers joined together // 99

9.s:
saṃlagnaṃ kuñcayetkiñcidaṅguṣṭhaṃ saṃprasārya ca |
tiryagbhavaiḥ śanaiḥ kiñcitkuryādvā'dhomukhaṃ tataḥ || 100 ||
9.d:
संलग्नं कुञ्चयेत्किञ्चिदङ्गुष्ठं संप्रसार्य च |
तिर्यग्भवैः शनैः किञ्चित्कुर्याद्वाऽधोमुखं ततः || 100 ||
9.m: and extending the thumb, / he should then make it slightly face downward, slowly, with transverse [movements]. // 100

9.s:
mudrā pitṛgaṇasyaiṣā nityatṛptikarī smṛtā |
pūjākāle tu vai tasmāddarśanīyā prayatnataḥ || 101 ||
9.d:
मुद्रा पितृगणस्यैषा नित्यतृप्तिकरी स्मृता |
पूजाकाले तु वै तस्माद्दर्शनीया प्रयत्नतः || 101 ||
9.m: This mudrā of the host of ancestors is remembered as granting perpetual satisfaction; / therefore it should be shown with effort at the time of worship. // 101

9.s:
yo vai naimittikācchrāddhātparitoṣastu jāyate |
sa pitṝṇāṃ śataguṇo mudrābandhācca pūjanāt || 102 ||
9.d:
यो वै नैमित्तिकाच्छ्राद्धात्परितोषस्तु जायते |
स पितॄणां शतगुणो मुद्राबन्धाच्च पूजनात् || 102 ||
9.m: Whatever satisfaction arises from an occasional śrāddha, / that is increased a hundredfold for the ancestors from forming the mudrā and from worship. // 102

9.s:
karadvayaṃ samuttānaṃ nābhideśe niyojayet |
vāmasya dakṣiṇe(?) pṛṣṭhe mudraiṣā siddhasantateḥ || 103 ||
9.d:
करद्वयं समुत्तानं नाभिदेशे नियोजयेत् |
वामस्य दक्षिणे(?) पृष्ठे मुद्रैषा सिद्धसन्ततेः || 103 ||
9.m: He should place the two hands upturned at the region of the navel, / [the right] on the back of the left hand; this is the mudrā of the succession of siddhas. // 103

9.s:
suspaṣṭaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ svātmanastu parāṅmukham |
parāṅmukhaṃ lambamānaṃ vāmapāṇiṃ prakalpayet || 104 ||
9.d:
सुस्पष्टं दक्षिणं हस्तं स्वात्मनस्तु पराङ्मुखम् |
पराङ्मुखं लम्बमानं वामपाणिं प्रकल्पयेत् || 104 ||
9.m: He should arrange the right hand very clearly turned away from oneself, / and the left hand turned away, hanging down. // 104

9.s:
kramādvarābhayākhyaṃ tu idaṃ mudrādvayaṃ dvija |
vijñeyaṃ lokapālānāmindrādīnāṃ samāsataḥ || 105 ||
9.d:
क्रमाद्वराभयाख्यं तु इदं मुद्राद्वयं द्विज |
विज्ञेयं लोकपालानामिन्द्रादीनां समासतः || 105 ||
9.m: In order, these two mudrās called Vara and Abhaya, O twice-born, / are to be known concisely for the world-protectors headed by Indra. // 105

9.s:
ekaikena tu mantreṇa vajrādyena kramādyutām |
astrākhyāṃ śaktisaṃyuktāṃ prāguktāṃ saṃpradarśayet || 106 ||
9.d:
एकैकेन तु मन्त्रेण वज्राद्येन क्रमाद्युताम् |
अस्त्राख्यां शक्तिसंयुक्तां प्रागुक्तां संप्रदर्शयेत् || 106 ||
9.m: With each mantra beginning with the thunderbolt in succession, / he should show the previously described [gesture] named astra, accompanied by śakti, // 106
for the weapons of the world-protectors, worshipped in due order.
The little finger, ring finger, and middle finger from the left [hand] situated in the palm, // 107

9.s:
tāsāmaṅguṣṭhakaḥ pṛṣṭhe tarjanī pronnatā bhavet |
nāsāvaṃśapradeśasthā tato dakṣiṇapāṇinā || 108 ||
9.d:
तासामङ्गुष्ठकः पृष्ठे तर्जनी प्रोन्नता भवेत् |
नासावंशप्रदेशस्था ततो दक्षिणपाणिना || 108 ||
9.m: their thumb on the back, and the forefinger raised upright / positioned at the region of the bridge of the nose; then with the right hand, // 108

9.s:
aṅgulītritayenaivaṃ muṣṭiṃ badhvā tu pūrvavat |
tarjanīdviguṇaṃ kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhāgre nirodhayet || 109 ||
9.d:
अङ्गुलीत्रितयेनैवं मुष्टिं बध्वा तु पूर्ववत् |
तर्जनीद्विगुणं कृत्वा अङ्गुष्ठाग्रे निरोधयेत् || 109 ||
9.m: forming a fist with three fingers in this way as before, / bending the forefinger double, he should press it against the tip of the thumb. // 109

9.s:
prodyato bāhudaṇḍaḥ syāccakrakṣepe yathodyataḥ |
viṣvaksenasya mudreyaṃ viśvakarmanikartanī || 110 ||
9.d:
प्रोद्यतो बाहुदण्डः स्याच्चक्रक्षेपे यथोद्यतः |
विष्वक्सेनस्य मुद्रेयं विश्वकर्मनिकर्तनी || 110 ||
9.m: The arm should be raised up as if ready to hurl a discus; / this is the mudrā of Viṣvaksena, which cuts away all karma. // 110

9.s:
kiñcidākuñcayeddhastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hṛdayopagam |
aṅguṣṭho viralaspaṣṭo mudrā hyāvāhane smṛtā || 111 ||
9.d:
किञ्चिदाकुञ्चयेद्धस्तं दक्षिणं हृदयोपगम् |
अङ्गुष्ठो विरलस्पष्टो मुद्रा ह्यावाहने स्मृता || 111 ||
9.m: He should contract slightly the right hand brought near the heart, / the thumb separated and distinct; this is remembered as the mudrā for invocation. // 111

9.s:
khaḍgadhārāsamākārā viralāṅgulikāvubhau |
aṅguṣṭhau daṇḍavatkṛtvā muṣṭibandhaṃ śanaiśśanaiḥ || 112 ||
9.d:
खड्गधारासमाकारा विरलाङ्गुलिकावुभौ |
अङ्गुष्ठौ दण्डवत्कृत्वा मुष्टिबन्धं शनैश्शनैः || 112 ||
9.m: Both [hands] having the shape of a sword blade with fingers separated, / making the two thumbs like rods, slowly making a fist // 112
beginning with the little finger—this is the mudrā for dismissal.
Having intertwined the two hands, closely joined and turned face downward, // 113

9.s:
kanīyasau tadāṅguṣṭhau suśleṣeṇa niyojya ca |
madhyamāṅguliyugmaṃ tu anyonyakarapṛṣṭhagam |
vikṣiptānāmikāyugmaṃ tarjanīyugalaṃ tathā || 114 ||
9.d:
कनीयसौ तदाङ्गुष्ठौ सुश्लेषेण नियोज्य च |
मध्यमाङ्गुलियुग्मं तु अन्योन्यकरपृष्ठगम् |
विक्षिप्तानामिकायुग्मं तर्जनीयुगलं तथा || 114 ||
9.m: and then joining the little fingers and thumbs closely, / the pair of middle fingers placed on the back of the opposite hand, / the pair of ring fingers extended, and likewise the pair of forefingers: // 114

9.s:
mudraiṣā kāmadhenvākhyā sarvecchāparipūraṇī |
dviprakāraṃ tu mudrāṇāṃ prayogaṃ nityamācaret || 115 ||
9.d:
मुद्रैषा कामधेन्वाख्या सर्वेच्छापरिपूरणी |
द्विप्रकारं तु मुद्राणां प्रयोगं नित्यमाचरेत् || 115 ||
9.m: this is the mudrā called Kāmadhenu, fulfilling all desires. / One should daily perform the two-fold application of mudrās, // 115

9.s:
saṃvinmayaṃ tu cādhyātmarūpaṃ bhāsvarasaṃpuṭam |
bāhyāntastrividhaṃ vipra karmavākcittajaṃ tu yat || 116 ||
9.d:
संविन्मयं तु चाध्यात्मरूपं भास्वरसंपुटम् |
बाह्यान्तस्त्रिविधं विप्र कर्मवाक्चित्तजं तु यत् || 116 ||
9.m: consisting of consciousness, the internal form, a luminous casket, / and the three-fold external and internal [form], O brahmin, born of action, speech, and mind. // 116

9.s:
anena vidhinā mudrāṃ yo badhnāti vidhānavit |
tenedaṃ mudritaṃ viśvamapunarbhavasiddhidam || 117 ||
9.d:
अनेन विधिना मुद्रां यो बध्नाति विधानवित् |
तेनेदं मुद्रितं विश्वमपुनर्भवसिद्धिदम् || 117 ||
9.m: Whoever, knowing the rule, binds a mudrā according to this rule, / by him this universe is sealed, bestowing the attainment of non-rebirth. // 117

9.s:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ mudrābandhākhyānaṃ nāma
aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 8 ||
9.d:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां मुद्राबन्धाख्यानं नाम
अष्टमः पटलः || 8 ||
9.m: Thus ends the eighth chapter, named The Exposition of the Formation of Mudrās, in the venerable Pāñcarātra Jayākhyasaṃhitā. // 8

10.s:
atha pāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ snānavidhirnāma navamaḥ
paṭalaḥ
10.d:
अथ पाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां स्नानविधिर्नाम नवमः
पटलः
10.m: Now begins the ninth chapter, named The Rule for Bathing, in the Pāñcarātra Jayākhyasaṃhitā.

10.s: śrībhagavān
10.d: श्रीभगवान्

10.s:
athādhikārasiddhyarthaṃ snānaṃ vakṣyāmi pūrvataḥ |
yena bhakto'bhiṣiktastu syādarho homayāgayoḥ || 1 ||
10.d:
अथाधिकारसिद्ध्यर्थं स्नानं वक्ष्यामि पूर्वतः |
येन भक्तोऽभिषिक्तस्तु स्यादर्हो होमयागयोः || 1 ||
10.m: Now, for the attainment of qualification, I shall explain the bath first, / bathed by which the devotee becomes fit for the homa and sacrifice. // 1

10.s: [snāne dvaividhyam]
10.d: [स्नाने द्वैविध्यम्]

10.s:
snānaṃ tu dvividhaṃ kuryānmalasaṅkaraśuddhaye |
sāmānyavidhinā snātvā viśeṣavidhinā tataḥ || 2 ||
10.d:
स्नानं तु द्विविधं कुर्यान्मलसङ्करशुद्धये |
सामान्यविधिना स्नात्वा विशेषविधिना ततः || 2 ||
10.m: One should perform a two-fold bath for the purification of impurities and mixture, / having bathed first according to the general rule, and then by the specific rule: // 2

10.s: sāmānyaṃ laukikaṃ snānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtam |
10.d: सामान्यं लौकिकं स्नानं विशिष्टं मन्त्रसंस्कृतम् |
10.m: the general is the ordinary bath, while the specific is consecrated with mantras.

10.s: [śaucavidhiḥ]
10.d: [शौचविधिः]

10.s: taccāpi śaucapūrvaṃ syāttadādau kathayāmi te || 3 ||
10.d: तच्चापि शौचपूर्वं स्यात्तदादौ कथयामि ते || 3 ||
10.m: And that must be preceded by purificatory cleaning; I shall describe that to you first. // 3

10.s:
p. 80) tisro liṅge mṛdo deyā ekaikāntaramṛttikāḥ |
pañca vāmakare deyāstisraḥ pāṇyorviśuddhaye || 4 ||
10.d:
प्. 80) तिस्रो लिङ्गे मृदो देया एकैकान्तरमृत्तिकाः |
पञ्च वामकरे देयास्तिस्रः पाण्योर्विशुद्धये || 4 ||
10.m: p. 80) Three applications of clay are to be applied to the penis, with clay between each; / five are to be applied to the left hand, and three for the purification of both hands. // 4

10.s:
mūtrotsarge śuddhireṣā purīṣasyāpyanantaram |
pañcāpāne mṛttikāssyustathaivāntaramṛttikāḥ || 5 ||
10.d:
मूत्रोत्सर्गे शुद्धिरेषा पुरीषस्याप्यनन्तरम् |
पञ्चापाने मृत्तिकास्स्युस्तथैवान्तरमृत्तिकाः || 5 ||
10.m: This is the purification in urination. And after defecation, / there should be five applications of clay to the anus, and likewise clay between each. // 5

10.s:
daśa vāmakare deyāssapta tūbhayahastayoḥ |
pādābhyāṃ trisṛbhiśśuddhirjaṅghāśuddhiśca pañcabhiḥ || 6 ||
10.d:
दश वामकरे देयास्सप्त तूभयहस्तयोः |
पादाभ्यां त्रिसृभिश्शुद्धिर्जङ्घाशुद्धिश्च पञ्चभिः || 6 ||
10.m: Ten are to be applied to the left hand, and seven to both hands; / purification of both feet is with three, and purification of both calves with five. // 6

10.s:
niyojayottato vipra kaṭyāṃ vai saptamṛttikāḥ |
svadehasvedadoṣaghnaṃ bāhyakardamaśāntaye || 7 ||
10.d:
नियोजयोत्ततो विप्र कट्यां वै सप्तमृत्तिकाः |
स्वदेहस्वेददोषघ्नं बाह्यकर्दमशान्तये || 7 ||
10.m: Then, O vipra, he should apply seven applications of clay to the waist / to destroy the defect of sweat on one's body, for the removal of external dirt. // 7

10.s:
bhaktānāṃ śrotriyāṇāṃ ca varṣāsvevaṃ nirūpitam |
prāvṛṭsūktāttadetasmādekamṛdvyapanodanam || 8 ||
10.d:
भक्तानां श्रोत्रियाणां च वर्षास्वेवं निरूपितम् |
प्रावृट्सूक्तात्तदेतस्मादेकमृद्व्यपनोदनम् || 8 ||
10.m: This is taught during the rainy season for devotees and Vedic scholars; / from that [number] taught for the rainy season, one application of clay is subtracted [each time]: // 8

10.s:
śaradgrīṣmavasanteṣu nityaṃ kāryā kriyāparaiḥ |
etasmādapi caikaikā parilopyā tu mṛttikā || 9 ||
10.d:
शरद्ग्रीष्मवसन्तेषु नित्यं कार्या क्रियापरैः |
एतस्मादपि चैकैका परिलोप्या तु मृत्तिका || 9 ||
10.m: In autumn, summer, and spring, this must constantly be done by those devoted to ritual action; / and one application of clay is to be omitted even from this [reduced number] // 9

10.s:
hemante śiśire vipra śrotriyaiḥ saṃyamasthitaiḥ |
pathi śaucaṃ prakartavyaṃ deśakālānurūpataḥ || 10 ||
10.d:
हेमन्ते शिशिरे विप्र श्रोत्रियैः संयमस्थितैः |
पथि शौचं प्रकर्तव्यं देशकालानुरूपतः || 10 ||
10.m: in early winter and late winter, O vipra, by Vedic scholars abiding in restraint. / When on a journey, purificatory cleaning must be done according to place and time. // 10

10.s: gandhalepamapāsyaivaṃ manaśśuddhyā viśudhyati |
10.d: गन्धलेपमपास्यैवं मनश्शुद्ध्या विशुध्यति |
10.m: Having thus removed the smell and the smear, he becomes purified through purity of mind.

10.s: [snānārthaṃ mṛtsaṃgrahaṇam]
10.d: [स्नानार्थं मृत्संग्रहणम्]
10.m: [Gathering clay for the bath]

10.s: evaṃ kṛtvā purā śaucaṃ samācamya tataḥ khanet || 11 ||
10.d: एवं कृत्वा पुरा शौचं समाचम्य ततः खनेत् || 11 ||
10.m: Having first performed purificatory cleaning in this manner, and having sipped water, he should then dig // 11

10.s:
śaṅkunā hyastrajaptena śucisthānāttu mṛttikām |
gṛhītvā'streṇa saṅgṛhya yāyājjalaniketanam || 12 ||
10.d:
शङ्कुना ह्यस्त्रजप्तेन शुचिस्थानात्तु मृत्तिकाम् |
गृहीत्वाऽस्त्रेण सङ्गृह्य यायाज्जलनिकेतनम् || 12 ||
10.m: clay from a clean place with a wooden peg consecrated with the astra-mantra; / having taken it up and held it with the astra-mantra, he should go to the body of water. // 12

10.s: [snānavidhiḥ]
10.d: [स्नानविधिः]

10.s:
tatrādau jalakūlaṃ tu kṣālayedastravāriṇā |
mṛdaḥ kṛtvā dvidhā sthāpya eka bhāgopagaṃ tataḥ || 13 ||
10.d:
तत्रादौ जलकूलं तु क्षालयेदस्त्रवारिणा |
मृदः कृत्वा द्विधा स्थाप्य एक भागोपगं ततः || 13 ||
10.m: There, he should first wash the water's edge with astra-water; / dividing the clay into two portions and setting it down, then, joining one portion [to other substances], // 13

10.s:
nidhāya gomayaṃ darbhānstilāstrānabhimantritān |
laukikaṃ gomayāḍhyena bhāgena [snānamācāret] || 14 ||
10.d:
निधाय गोमयं दर्भान्स्तिलास्त्रानभिमन्त्रितान् |
लौकिकं गोमयाढ्येन भागेन [स्नानमाचारेत्] || 14 ||
10.m: having placed cow-dung, darbha grasses, and sesamum consecrated with the astra-mantra, / he should perform an ordinary bath with the portion enriched with cow-dung. // 14

10.s: tata(tacca ?)snānaṃ purā kṛtvā vidhisnānaṃ samācaret |
10.d: तत(तच्च ?)स्नानं पुरा कृत्वा विधिस्नानं समाचरेत् |
10.m: Having first performed that bath, he should perform the ritual bath.

10.s: [vidhisnāne kramaḥ]
10.d: [विधिस्नाने क्रमः]

10.s: vidhisnāne tu mṛdbhāgo yastaṃ kuryāddvidhā punaḥ || 15 ||
10.d: विधिस्नाने तु मृद्भागो यस्तं कुर्याद्द्विधा पुनः || 15 ||
10.m: As for the portion of clay for the ritual bath, he should divide it again into two parts. // 15

10.s:
pādādi kṣālyamekena pūrvavatkramayogataḥ |
pāṇiprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā vinimajya jalāntare || 16 ||
10.d:
पादादि क्षाल्यमेकेन पूर्ववत्क्रमयोगतः |
पाणिप्रक्षालनं कृत्वा विनिमज्य जलान्तरे || 16 ||
10.m: The feet and other parts are to be washed with one part, in the proper order as before; / having washed both hands, having submerged himself in the water, // 16

10.s: p. 81) [snānāṅgamantranyāsamudrābandhau]
10.d: प्. 81) [स्नानाङ्गमन्त्रन्यासमुद्राबन्धौ]
10.m: p. 81) [Nyāsa of mantras and formation of mudrās as limbs of bathing]

10.s:
samutthāya nyasenmantraṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vigrahe svake |
mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryānmudrābandhaṃ ca kārayet || 17 ||
10.d:
समुत्थाय न्यसेन्मन्त्रं षडङ्गं विग्रहे स्वके |
मन्त्रन्यासं ततः कुर्यान्मुद्राबन्धं च कारयेत् || 17 ||
10.m: and having risen up, he should place the six-limbed mantra on his own body; / then he should perform the nyāsa of mantras and execute the formation of mudrās. // 17

10.s:
kīṭādyaśucisamparkājjalasyāvahato dvija |
vahato'pyuddhṛtasyāpi śuddhirevaṃ bhavetpurā || 18 ||
10.d:
कीटाद्यशुचिसम्पर्काज्जलस्यावहतो द्विज |
वहतोऽप्युद्धृतस्यापि शुद्धिरेवं भवेत्पुरा || 18 ||
10.m: Because of contact with impurities such as insects, O twice-born, whether the water is flowing, / or even when non-flowing or drawn out, this purification should first take place. // 18

10.s:
nirmalaṃ vāruṇaṃ vipra candrārkakaratāpitam |
yadyapi syāttathā naivaṃ samyaṅmāntre kriyākrame || 19 ||
10.d:
निर्मलं वारुणं विप्र चन्द्रार्ककरतापितम् |
यद्यपि स्यात्तथा नैवं सम्यङ्मान्त्रे क्रियाक्रमे || 19 ||
10.m: Even if the water of Varuṇa is spotless, O vipra, heated by the rays of the moon and sun, / it is still not so in the correct ritual procedure of mantras. // 19

10.s: [pavitradhāraṇam]
10.d: [पवित्रधारणम्]

10.s:
tripañcasaptakāṇḍotthaṃ draḍhimagranthisaṃyutam |
pavitrakadvayaṃ dārbhamastramantrābhimantritam || 20 ||
10.d:
त्रिपञ्चसप्तकाण्डोत्थं द्रढिमग्रन्थिसंयुतम् |
पवित्रकद्वयं दार्भमस्त्रमन्त्राभिमन्त्रितम् || 20 ||
10.m: Having placed two pavitraka rings made of darbha grass, / made of three, five, or seven blades, joined with a firm knot, / consecrated with the astra-mantra, // 20

10.s: hastadvaye'pi nikṣipya anāmāṅgulayoradhaḥ |
10.d: हस्तद्वयेऽपि निक्षिप्य अनामाङ्गुलयोरधः |
10.m: on both hands, at the base of the ring fingers,

10.s:
[vāmapāṇau mūlādisthānabhedena tredhā vibhaktāyā mṛdaḥ
krameṇāstrāditrayeṇābhimantraṇam]
10.d:
[वामपाणौ मूलादिस्थानभेदेन त्रेधा विभक्ताया मृदः
क्रमेणास्त्रादित्रयेणाभिमन्त्रणम्]
10.m: [Consecration of the clay divided into three on the left hand at the base, middle, and tip, sequentially with the three mantras beginning with the astra]

10.s: sāvaśeṣāṃ mṛdaṃ śeṣāṃ kṛtvā'dāyāstramuccaran || 21 ||
10.d: सावशेषां मृदं शेषां कृत्वाऽदायास्त्रमुच्चरन् || 21 ||
10.m: he should make the remaining clay into a remainder, and taking it up while uttering the astra-mantra, // 21

10.s:
tāṃ tathā vāmapāṇau tu mūlamadhyāgrato bhajet |
sāstreṇa mūlamantreṇa japedaṅgairanukramāt || 22 ||
10.d:
तां तथा वामपाणौ तु मूलमध्याग्रतो भजेत् |
सास्त्रेण मूलमन्त्रेण जपेदङ्गैरनुक्रमात् || 22 ||
10.m: he should divide it thus on his left hand into root, middle, and tip; / with the astra-mantra, with the root-mantra, and with the aṅga-mantras he should recite over them in succession. // 22

10.s: [tatrāstrābhimantritāyā viniyogaḥ]
10.d: [तत्रास्त्राभिमन्त्रिताया विनियोगः]
10.m: [Application of the portion consecrated with the astra-mantra]

10.s:
astrajaptāṃ mṛdaṃ gṛhya kṣipeddikṣu vidikṣu ca |
adha ūrdhve ca tanmantraṃ (ntra ?) mudrābandhena saṃyutam || 23 ||
10.d:
अस्त्रजप्तां मृदं गृह्य क्षिपेद्दिक्षु विदिक्षु च |
अध ऊर्ध्वे च तन्मन्त्रं (न्त्र ?) मुद्राबन्धेन संयुतम् || 23 ||
10.m: Taking the clay recited over with the astra-mantra, he should throw it in the cardinal and intermediate directions, / below, and above, with that mantra accompanied by the formation of mudrās. // 23

10.s:
tena snānaharā vighnā digvidikparisaṃsthitāḥ |
prayānti vihvalībhūtā yāvattannopasaṃbhṛtam || 24 ||
10.d:
तेन स्नानहरा विघ्ना दिग्विदिक्परिसंस्थिताः |
प्रयान्ति विह्वलीभूता यावत्तन्नोपसंभृतम् || 24 ||
10.m: By that, the obstacles that ruin bathing, residing in the cardinal and intermediate directions, / flee, bewildered, as long as that [space] is not dismantled. // 24

10.s: [mūlamantritāyā mṛdo viniyogaḥ]
10.d: [मूलमन्त्रिताया मृदो विनियोगः]
10.m: [Application of the clay consecrated with the root-mantra]

10.s:
mṛdbhāgo mūlamantreṇa mantrito yaḥ purā sthitaḥ |
tamuccaraṃstamādāya toyamadhye vinikṣipet || 25 ||
10.d:
मृद्भागो मूलमन्त्रेण मन्त्रितो यः पुरा स्थितः |
तमुच्चरंस्तमादाय तोयमध्ये विनिक्षिपेत् || 25 ||
10.m: As for that portion of clay which was previously consecrated with the root-mantra, / taking it while uttering that [mantra], he should cast it into the middle of the water. // 25

10.s:
tena tat dvijaśārdūla tatkṣaṇādeva jāyate |
gaṅgātoyena saṃpūrṇaṃ yāmunena jalena ca || 26 ||
10.d:
तेन तत् द्विजशार्दूल तत्क्षणादेव जायते |
गङ्गातोयेन संपूर्णं यामुनेन जलेन च || 26 ||
10.m: By that, O tiger among the twice-born, it instantly becomes / filled with the water of the Gaṅgā and with the water of the Yamunā. // 26

10.s:
prāyāgaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca |
bhavanti sannidhībhūtā mantrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 27 ||
10.d:
प्रायागं चक्रतीर्थं च प्रभासं पुष्कराणि च |
भवन्ति सन्निधीभूता मन्त्रस्यास्य प्रभावतः || 27 ||
10.m: Prayāga, Cakratīrtha, Prabhāsa, and the Puṣkaras / become present there by the power of this mantra. // 27

10.s:
tato vai viṣṇutīrthāya mantrānte padamuccaret |
p. 82) sanamaskaṃ bhavettena viṣṇutīrthasya sannidhiḥ || 28 ||
10.d:
ततो वै विष्णुतीर्थाय मन्त्रान्ते पदमुच्चरेत् |
प्. 82) सनमस्कं भवेत्तेन विष्णुतीर्थस्य सन्निधिः || 28 ||
10.m: Then, indeed, at the end of the mantra he should utter the word viṣṇutīrthāya / p. 82) together with namas; through that, the presence of the Viṣṇutīrtha comes about. // 28

10.s: [tīrthāntare kevalamūlamantramātrayojanam]
10.d: [तीर्थान्तरे केवलमूलमन्त्रमात्रयोजनम्]
10.m: [Employment of only the root-mantra at other tīrthas]

10.s:
anyatīrthe yadā snānaṃ kuryāttatra ca yojayet |
kevalaṃ mūlamantraṃ tu viṣṇutīrthapadaṃ vinā || 29 ||
10.d:
अन्यतीर्थे यदा स्नानं कुर्यात्तत्र च योजयेत् |
केवलं मूलमन्त्रं तु विष्णुतीर्थपदं विना || 29 ||
10.m: When he bathes at another tīrtha, he should employ there / only the root-mantra, without the word viṣṇutīrtha. // 29

10.s:
tīrthāntareṣvidaṃ nāma na saṅkīrtayate sudhīḥ |
sannidhāne hi tīrthasya yadyanyāmabhidhāṃ smaret || 30 ||
10.d:
तीर्थान्तरेष्विदं नाम न सङ्कीर्तयते सुधीः |
सन्निधाने हि तीर्थस्य यद्यन्यामभिधां स्मरेत् || 30 ||
10.m: At other tīrthas, a wise man does not utter this name; / for if, in the presence of one tīrtha, he should remember another name, // 30

10.s:
snātakastasya tattīrthamabhiśapya kṣaṇaṃ vrajet |
nirjarāmbutaṭākādau sāmānyasnānakarmaṇi || 31 ||
10.d:
स्नातकस्तस्य तत्तीर्थमभिशप्य क्षणं व्रजेत् |
निर्जराम्बुतटाकादौ सामान्यस्नानकर्मणि || 31 ||
10.m: having cursed that person who has bathed, that tīrtha will immediately depart. / In the common rite of bathing in waterfall streams, ponds, and the like, // 31

10.s:
gaṅgādīnāṃ nadīnāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ ca prakīrtitam |
māntre snānakrame samyagviṣṇutīrthāya kīrtayet || 32 ||
10.d:
गङ्गादीनां नदीनां च तीर्थानां च प्रकीर्तितम् |
मान्त्रे स्नानक्रमे सम्यग्विष्णुतीर्थाय कीर्तयेत् || 32 ||
10.m: the invocation of rivers such as the Gaṅgā and of tīrthas is prescribed; / in the proper mantra-procedure of bathing, he should recite: "To Viṣṇutīrtha." // 32

10.s: [aṅgamantrābhimantritasya mṛdbhāgasya viniyogaḥ]
10.d: [अङ्गमन्त्राभिमन्त्रितस्य मृद्भागस्य विनियोगः]
10.m: [Application of the portion of clay consecrated with the aṅga-mantra]

10.s:
tato'ṅgamantrajaptaṃ ca bhāgaṃ pāṇitale sthitam |
toyenāloḍhya masṛṇaṃ tāpayedarkaraśmibhiḥ || 33 ||
10.d:
ततोऽङ्गमन्त्रजप्तं च भागं पाणितले स्थितम् |
तोयेनालोढ्य मसृणं तापयेदर्करश्मिभिः || 33 ||
10.m: Then, having dissolved with water the portion resting on the palm of his hand, / which was recited over with the aṅga-mantras, making it smooth, he should warm it with the sun's rays. // 33

10.s:
meghacchanne svakaṃ mantraṃ sūryavatkhasthitaṃ smaret |
darśayitvā kare tasya tābhyāṃ sarvāṅgakaṃ spṛśet || 34 ||
10.d:
मेघच्छन्ने स्वकं मन्त्रं सूर्यवत्खस्थितं स्मरेत् |
दर्शयित्वा करे तस्य ताभ्यां सर्वाङ्गकं स्पृशेत् || 34 ||
10.m: When it is overcast with clouds, he should meditate on his own mantra residing in the sky like the sun; / having shown [the clay] in his hand to it, he should touch all his limbs with both hands. // 34

10.s: [tīrthasya paramīkaraṇaprakāraḥ]
10.d: [तीर्थस्य परमीकरणप्रकारः]
10.m: [The method of elevating the tīrtha to the supreme state]

10.s:
dhāraṇādvitayenātha tīrthasya sajalasya ca |
paramīkaraṇaṃ kuryādvidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 35 ||
10.d:
धारणाद्वितयेनाथ तीर्थस्य सजलस्य च |
परमीकरणं कुर्याद्विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा || 35 ||
10.m: Then, by means of a pair of dhāraṇās, he should effect the elevation of the tīrtha / along with the water to the supreme state, by the rite seen in the rules. // 35

10.s:
ādhāraśakterārabhya saṅkalpaviṣayāvadhi |
vahninā pūrayetsarvaṃ jvālāmālāvilena ca || 36 ||
10.d:
आधारशक्तेरारभ्य सङ्कल्पविषयावधि |
वह्निना पूरयेत्सर्वं ज्वालामालाविलेन च || 36 ||
10.m: Beginning from the Ādhāraśakti up to the realm of mental intention, / he should fill everything with fire swirling with wreaths of flames. // 36

10.s:
nirammayaṃ jagatkṛtvā tīrthaṃ śāntatanu smaret |
śānte saṃvinmaye viṣṇau bhūyastadavatārya ca || 37 ||
10.d:
निरम्मयं जगत्कृत्वा तीर्थं शान्ततनु स्मरेत् |
शान्ते संविन्मये विष्णौ भूयस्तदवतार्य च || 37 ||
10.m: Having made the world devoid of water, he should visualize the tīrtha as having a tranquil body; / and having brought it down again into Viṣṇu, who is tranquil and composed of consciousness, // 37

10.s:
niśāmbukaṇasaṅkāśamiyattākalpitaṃ purā |
smṛtvā śaktiprabhāvena brahmasroto vinirgatam || 38 ||
10.d:
निशाम्बुकणसङ्काशमियत्ताकल्पितं पुरा |
स्मृत्वा शक्तिप्रभावेन ब्रह्मस्रोतो विनिर्गतम् || 38 ||
10.m: remembering that it was previously conceived with a specific measure resembling a drop of night-dew, / [and then remembering] the stream of Brahman that has issued forth by the power of Śakti, // 38

10.s:
dhārākallolasaṅgīrṇaṃ patamānaṃ tu vegataḥ |
ābrahmabhavanaṃ sarvaṃ pūrayecchaśisannibham || 39 ||
10.d:
धाराकल्लोलसङ्गीर्णं पतमानं तु वेगतः |
आब्रह्मभवनं सर्वं पूरयेच्छशिसन्निभम् || 39 ||
10.m: crowded with waves and billows, falling with great speed, / he should fill everything up to the abode of Brahmā, resembling the moon. // 39

10.s:
vilokanapadaiśśaśvatsaṅghaṭṭaṃ taṃ tu bhāvayet |
samaste prāksvarūpeṇa tanmadhye tvāsanaṃ prabhoḥ || 40 ||
10.d:
विलोकनपदैश्शश्वत्सङ्घट्टं तं तु भावयेत् |
समस्ते प्राक्स्वरूपेण तन्मध्ये त्वासनं प्रभोः || 40 ||
10.m: He should constantly contemplate that collision by means of the planes of vision; / when everything is in its original essential nature, having placed the Lord's seat in its midst, // 40

10.s:
datvā tadupari brahman smarennārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
p. 83) candrakoṭisamaṃ śuddhasudhādhārāgaṇāvṛtam || 41 ||
10.d:
दत्वा तदुपरि ब्रह्मन् स्मरेन्नारायणं प्रभुम् |
प्. 83) चन्द्रकोटिसमं शुद्धसुधाधारागणावृतम् || 41 ||
10.m: and upon it, O Brahman, he should meditate on the Lord Nārāyaṇa, / p. 83) equal to ten million moons, surrounded by multitudes of streams of pure nectar, // 41

10.s:
sāhaṃśaktisamūhāḍhyaṃ prodgirantaṃ sudhārasam |
evaṃ kṛte sati bhavettīrthaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam || 42 ||
10.d:
साहंशक्तिसमूहाढ्यं प्रोद्गिरन्तं सुधारसम् |
एवं कृते सति भवेत्तीर्थं नारायणात्मकम् || 42 ||
10.m: abundant with the assemblage of the 'I'-powers, pouring forth the juice of nectar. / When this is done, the tīrtha becomes identified with Nārāyaṇa. // 42

10.s:
nimajjanaṃ tataḥ kuryādunmajjanasamanvitam |
gandhaissāmalakairhṛdyaiḥ pavitrairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 43 ||
10.d:
निमज्जनं ततः कुर्यादुन्मज्जनसमन्वितम् |
गन्धैस्सामलकैर्हृद्यैः पवित्रैर्विविधैः शुभैः || 43 ||
10.m: Then he should immerse himself, followed by emerging; / with delightful, pure, diverse, and auspicious perfumes along with āmalaka fruits, // 43

10.s: cakravartyupacāreṇa mantrī snāyādatandritaḥ |
10.d: चक्रवर्त्युपचारेण मन्त्री स्नायादतन्द्रितः |
10.m: with an emperor's service, the mantrin should bathe unflaggingly.

10.s: [atha snānottarāṅgavidhiḥ]
10.d: [अथ स्नानोत्तराङ्गविधिः]
10.m: [Now the rule for the auxiliary acts after bathing]

10.s: tataścāntarjalasthaśca smarenmantraṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 44 ||
10.d: ततश्चान्तर्जलस्थश्च स्मरेन्मन्त्रं स्वशक्तितः || 44 ||
10.m: And then, standing in the water, he should meditate on the mantra according to his ability. // 44

10.s:
bhāsvadbhāsvararūpo'sau udeti hṛdayāntare |
hṛdayādagrataścānte dvādaśāntena dūrataḥ || 45 ||
10.d:
भास्वद्भास्वररूपोऽसौ उदेति हृदयान्तरे |
हृदयादग्रतश्चान्ते द्वादशान्तेन दूरतः || 45 ||
10.m: Having a radiant form like the sun, it rises within the heart, / and from the heart forward, at the end, at a distance up to the twelve-finger limit. // 45

10.s:
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣasthaṃ tu nārada |
samutthāya jalātpaśyedgaganasthaṃ tameva hi || 46 ||
10.d:
परमं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यक्षस्थं तु नारद |
समुत्थाय जलात्पश्येद्गगनस्थं तमेव हि || 46 ||
10.m: Having seen the supreme puruṣa directly present, O Nārada, / and rising from the water, he should look upon Him standing in the sky. // 46

10.s:
tato'psu tāramāsādya upaviśya yathāsukham |
nyasedaṅkuśamudrāgre hṛnmantraṃ sitavigraham || 47 ||
10.d:
ततोऽप्सु तारमासाद्य उपविश्य यथासुखम् |
न्यसेदङ्कुशमुद्राग्रे हृन्मन्त्रं सितविग्रहम् || 47 ||
10.m: Then, having reached the bank of the water and seated himself comfortably, / he should place the heart-mantra, white in form, at the tip of the goad-gesture. // 47

10.s:
svenānilena saṃyuktaṃ recayettīrthamadhyataḥ |
pūrakeṇa samākṛṣya mudrāyuktena tatpunaḥ || 48 ||
10.d:
स्वेनानिलेन संयुक्तं रेचयेत्तीर्थमध्यतः |
पूरकेण समाकृष्य मुद्रायुक्तेन तत्पुनः || 48 ||
10.m: Combined with his own breath, he should exhale it into the middle of the sacred water; / drawing it back again through inhalation combined with the gesture, // 48

10.s:
evañcopagataṃ tīrthaṃ purā kṛtvā tu nārada |
praṇavenopacārākhyahṛdayenācamettataḥ || 49 ||
10.d:
एवञ्चोपगतं तीर्थं पुरा कृत्वा तु नारद |
प्रणवेनोपचाराख्यहृदयेनाचमेत्ततः || 49 ||
10.m: and having thus first brought forth the sacred water, O Nārada, / he should then sip water with the Praṇava and the heart-[mantra] called the service. // 49

10.s:
suprasannena toyena jānvantasthena pāṇinā |
ekena pādyamantreṇa sopacārahṛdā dvija || 50 ||
10.d:
सुप्रसन्नेन तोयेन जान्वन्तस्थेन पाणिना |
एकेन पाद्यमन्त्रेण सोपचारहृदा द्विज || 50 ||
10.m: With completely pure water, with the hand held within the knees, / with the single foot-water mantra and the service-heart[-mantra], O twice-born, // 50

10.s:
dhvātvā tatra sthitaṃ devaṃ sāṅgaṃ saparivārakam |
japyamānaśca mantro'yamupasthānaṃ tu kārayet || 51 ||
10.d:
ध्वात्वा तत्र स्थितं देवं साङ्गं सपरिवारकम् |
जप्यमानश्च मन्त्रोऽयमुपस्थानं तु कारयेत् || 51 ||
10.m: having meditated on the God stationed there, along with His limbs and retinue, / while this mantra is being recited, he should perform the morning praise. // 51

10.s:
praṇavena tatassarvānpitṛdevāṃśca tarpayet |
tilamiśreṇa vidhivatsantyajetsnānakarpaṭam || 52 ||
10.d:
प्रणवेन ततस्सर्वान्पितृदेवांश्च तर्पयेत् |
तिलमिश्रेण विधिवत्सन्त्यजेत्स्नानकर्पटम् || 52 ||
10.m: Then with the Praṇava he should make libations to all the ancestors and gods / mixed with sesamum according to the rule, and discard the bathing cloth. // 52

10.s:
sudhautaṃ paridhāyātha vastrayugmamakhedadam |
athavā tadadhaśśāṭīṃ yogapaṭṭakasaṃyutām || 53 ||
10.d:
सुधौतं परिधायाथ वस्त्रयुग्ममखेददम् |
अथवा तदधश्शाटीं योगपट्टकसंयुताम् || 53 ||
10.m: Then, putting on a pair of well-washed garments that cause no discomfort, / or an undergarment accompanied by a meditation-cloth— // 53

10.s:
naikavastreṇa vai yasmādbhavitavyaṃ kadācana |
sthāne'straśodhite'nyasminnanantāsanasaṃsthitam || 54 ||
10.d:
नैकवस्त्रेण वै यस्माद्भवितव्यं कदाचन |
स्थानेऽस्त्रशोधितेऽन्यस्मिन्ननन्तासनसंस्थितम् || 54 ||
10.m: since one should never be clad in only a single garment— / in another place purified by the weapon-[mantra], stationed on the seat of Ananta, // 54

10.s:
p. 84) ādhāramāsanaṃ dhyātvā jalamadhye'cyutasya ca |
mantragrāmasamopetamāhūya viniveśya tam || 55 ||
10.d:
प्. 84) आधारमासनं ध्यात्वा जलमध्येऽच्युतस्य च |
मन्त्रग्रामसमोपेतमाहूय विनिवेश्य तम् || 55 ||
10.m: having meditated on the support-seat of Acyuta in the middle of the water, / summoning Him together with the host of mantras and installing Him, // 55

10.s:
tarpayedudakenaiva viṣvaksenāvasānakam |
svena svena tu mantreṇa pāṇibhyāmagrataḥ kramāt || 56 ||
10.d:
तर्पयेदुदकेनैव विष्वक्सेनावसानकम् |
स्वेन स्वेन तु मन्त्रेण पाणिभ्यामग्रतः क्रमात् || 56 ||
10.m: he should make libations with water alone, ending with Viṣvaksena, / each with its own mantra, with both hands in front in due order. // 56

10.s:
devatāśca munīnnāgān grahabhūtaviyaccarān |
santarpya sthāvarāntāṃśca svavaṃśaṃ tarpayetkramāt || 57 ||
10.d:
देवताश्च मुनीन्नागान् ग्रहभूतवियच्चरान् |
सन्तर्प्य स्थावरान्तांश्च स्ववंशं तर्पयेत्क्रमात् || 57 ||
10.m: Having made libations to the deities, sages, nāgas, planets, spirits, and sky-farers, / down to the immovable beings, he should then make libations to his own lineage in due order. // 57

10.s:
vrajantaṃ sāsanaṃ devaṃ jalamadhyāttatassmaret |
tīrthaśuddhau purā mantro nyasto'sāvapi dikṣu vai || 58 ||
10.d:
व्रजन्तं सासनं देवं जलमध्यात्ततस्स्मरेत् |
तीर्थशुद्धौ पुरा मन्त्रो न्यस्तोऽसावपि दिक्षु वै || 58 ||
10.m: Then he should meditate on the God departing from the middle of the water together with the seat. / The mantra that had previously been placed in the directions for the purification of the sacred water, // 58

10.s:
prerayanpūrvavaddevānprāṇāgreṇānilaṃ dvija |
tamekīkṛtya vai tena tyaktvā toyaṃ tu śuklavat || 59 ||
10.d:
प्रेरयन्पूर्ववद्देवान्प्राणाग्रेणानिलं द्विज |
तमेकीकृत्य वै तेन त्यक्त्वा तोयं तु शुक्लवत् || 59 ||
10.m: impelling the gods as before with the tip of the breath, O twice-born, / uniting it with that and having released the water like something white, // 59

10.s:
āpūrya hṛdi vinyasyet sopasaṃhāramudrayā |
ityuktamaudakaṃ snānamatha māntraṃ nibodha me || 60 ||
10.d:
आपूर्य हृदि विन्यस्येत् सोपसंहारमुद्रया |
इत्युक्तमौदकं स्नानमथ मान्त्रं निबोध मे || 60 ||
10.m: filling [himself] and placing it in the heart with the withdrawal-gesture. / Thus has the water-bath been declared; now learn from me the mantra-bath. // 60

10.s: [mantrasnānam]
10.d: [मन्त्रस्नानम्]

10.s:
toyābhāve ca yatkuryāddurge kāle ca śītale |
gamane kṣiprasiddhau vā gurukārye svatantratām || 61 ||
10.d:
तोयाभावे च यत्कुर्याद्दुर्गे काले च शीतले |
गमने क्षिप्रसिद्धौ वा गुरुकार्ये स्वतन्त्रताम् || 61 ||
10.m: And what he should do in the absence of water, in impassable terrain, in cold weather, / on a journey, or for swift accomplishment, or seeing independence in an important duty // 61

10.s:
prāptāṃ vā vīkṣya viprendra niśābhāge dinasya vā |
prakṣālya pādāvācamya proddhṛtena tu vāriṇā || 62 ||
10.d:
प्राप्तां वा वीक्ष्य विप्रेन्द्र निशाभागे दिनस्य वा |
प्रक्षाल्य पादावाचम्य प्रोद्धृतेन तु वारिणा || 62 ||
10.m: attained, O best of Brahmins, whether in a portion of the night or day: / having washed his feet and sipped water with water that has been drawn up, // 62

10.s:
snānaṃ daśa diśaḥ prāgvatsaṃśodhyopaviśettataḥ |
astraṃ hastatale yojyaṃ kramānnyāsaṃ tatastanau || 63 ||
10.d:
स्नानं दश दिशः प्राग्वत्संशोध्योपविशेत्ततः |
अस्त्रं हस्ततले योज्यं क्रमान्न्यासं ततस्तनौ || 63 ||
10.m: having purified the bath and the ten directions as before, he should then sit down; / the weapon-[mantra] is to be placed on the palm of the hand, and then the placement on the body in due order. // 63

10.s:
mūlamantrādi tatkuryātsarvamantragaṇena tu |
kevalādudakasnānātsaṃskāraparivarjitāt || 64 ||
10.d:
मूलमन्त्रादि तत्कुर्यात्सर्वमन्त्रगणेन तु |
केवलादुदकस्नानात्संस्कारपरिवर्जितात् || 64 ||
10.m: He should perform that beginning with the root-mantra, with the whole collection of mantras. / Compared to a mere bath with water that is devoid of consecration, // 64

10.s:
prabhāsādiṣu tīrtheṣu yatphalaṃ snātakasya ca |
jñeyaṃ śataguṇaṃ tasmānmantragrāmasya nārada || 65 ||
10.d:
प्रभासादिषु तीर्थेषु यत्फलं स्नातकस्य च |
ज्ञेयं शतगुणं तस्मान्मन्त्रग्रामस्य नारद || 65 ||
10.m: whatever fruit belongs to one who has bathed at Prabhāsa and other holy places, / that from the host of mantras is to be known as a hundred times greater, O Nārada. // 65

10.s: [dhyānasnānam]
10.d: [ध्यानस्नानम्]

10.s:
dhyānasnānamatho vakṣye dvābhyāmapi paraṃ tu yat |
khasthitaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ mantramūrtiṃ prabhuṃ smaret || 66 ||
10.d:
ध्यानस्नानमथो वक्ष्ये द्वाभ्यामपि परं तु यत् |
खस्थितं पुण्डरीकाक्षं मन्त्रमूर्तिं प्रभुं स्मरेत् || 66 ||
10.m: Now I shall teach the meditation-bath, which is superior even to both: / he should meditate on the Lord, the lotus-eyed, whose form is mantra, stationed in the sky. // 66

10.s:
tatpādodakajāṃ dhārāṃ patamānāṃ svamūrdhani |
cintayedbrahmarandhreṇa praviśantīṃ svakāṃ tanum || 67 ||
10.d:
तत्पादोदकजां धारां पतमानां स्वमूर्धनि |
चिन्तयेद्ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण प्रविशन्तीं स्वकां तनुम् || 67 ||
10.m: He should contemplate a stream born of the water of His feet falling upon his own head, / entering his own body through the aperture of Brahman. // 67

10.s:
tayā saṃkṣālayetsarvamantardehagataṃ malam |
p. 85) tatkṣaṇādvirajā mantrī jāyate sphaṭikopamaḥ || 68 ||
10.d:
तया संक्षालयेत्सर्वमन्तर्देहगतं मलम् |
प्. 85) तत्क्षणाद्विरजा मन्त्री जायते स्फटिकोपमः || 68 ||
10.m: With that he should wash away all the impurity situated inside the body; / from that moment, the mantra-practitioner becomes free from dust, resembling crystal. // 68

10.s:
idaṃ snānaṃ paraṃ māntrātsnānācchataguṇaṃ smṛtam |
tasmādekatamaṃ kāryaṃ snānaṃ śraddhāpareṇa tu || 69 ||
10.d:
इदं स्नानं परं मान्त्रात्स्नानाच्छतगुणं स्मृतम् |
तस्मादेकतमं कार्यं स्नानं श्रद्धापरेण तु || 69 ||
10.m: This bath is higher than the mantra-bath, remembered as a hundred times greater; / therefore, one single bath should be performed by one devoted to faith. // 69

10.s:
snānapūrvāḥ kriyāssarvā yatassamyakphalapradāḥ |
tasmātsnānaṃ purā kuryādya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ || 70 ||
10.d:
स्नानपूर्वाः क्रियास्सर्वा यतस्सम्यक्फलप्रदाः |
तस्मात्स्नानं पुरा कुर्याद्य इच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः || 70 ||
10.m: Since all rites preceded by bathing bestow their fruit fully, / therefore one who desires his own welfare should first perform bathing. // 70

10.s:
snānena nirmalo jantuḥ kṛtamātreṇa jāyate |
dvijendra nirvivekātmā kiṃ punaryaḥ kriyāparaḥ || 71 ||
10.d:
स्नानेन निर्मलो जन्तुः कृतमात्रेण जायते |
द्विजेन्द्र निर्विवेकात्मा किं पुनर्यः क्रियापरः || 71 ||
10.m: By bathing, a living creature becomes stainless the moment it is done, / O chief of the twice-born, even one lacking discernment; how much more so one devoted to rites, // 71

10.s: varṇadharmakramopetassādhumārgavyavasthitaḥ |
10.d: वर्णधर्मक्रमोपेतस्साधुमार्गव्यवस्थितः |
10.m: endowed with the proper order of caste-duties and established on the path of the virtuous! // 72ab

10.s:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ snānavidhirnāma navamaḥ
paṭalaḥ || 9 ||
10.d:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां स्नानविधिर्नाम नवमः
पटलः || 9 ||
10.m: Thus ends the ninth chapter, named 'The Rule for Bathing', in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the venerable Pāñcarātra. // 9
